data.name: Satisfactory.SetupSteps
data.value:
Gqibezela ukuseta kokuqala kwi-Satisfactory ??s Server Manager kwaye ugcine iseva isebenza nge--NewConsole.
Cofa ngezantsi. I-Synix ithumela umyalelo, ifunda i-token entsha, iqinisekise, kwaye igcine ngokukhuselekileyo. Akukho kukopisha okanye ukuncamathisela.

I-Satisfactory iyibonisa kwi-console yayo kunye ne-log; Gcina ezo ziyimfihlo. Ukususwa konxibelelwano olugcinweyo akuyirhoxisi i-token.

Iimvavanyo zenkcazo zisebenzisa iifayile zesikhashana ezizimeleyo kwaye azikaze zitshintshe iiseva ezifakweyo.

data.name: Settings.Development.Premade.Description
data.value: Yicime le nto ukuze uyeke ukudala ngokuzenzekelayo nokuhlaziya iifayile zokulungelelanisa umdlalo. Iifayile ezikhoyo azicinywa. Khangela amaxabiso e-Synix kwaye isenzo esicacileyo sokulungisa ukucwangcisa sihlala sikhona kumaseva amisiwe.

data.name: Settings.Development.Release.Description
data.value: Jonga iinguqulelo ezihambelanayo, ukupapasha iifayile ezizinzileyo, ukhuseleko lokuphucula i-MSI, ii-hashes ze-SHA-256, kunye neseti yovavanyo ezenzekelayo epheleleyo.

data.name: Settings.Development.Reliability.Description
data.value: Umzekelo wememori yeSynix, izibambo, iintambo, kunye nokuhlolwa kwempilo yokufunda kuphela ngokuhamba kwexesha. Esi sixhobo sokuphuhlisa asiqalisi, asiyeki, asiyifaki okanye sitshintshe iserver.

data.name: GameDefinitions.Builder.Guide
data.value:
Qala Ngokukhawuleza 1. Faka igama elichanekileyo lomdlalo kunye nenombolo ye-Steam server AppID. 2. Faka umzila wokusebenza kweseva ngokunxulumene nefolda yeserver efakiweyo. 3. Faka kuphela umbhalo womyalelo oza emva kwe-executable. Sebenzisa iithegi ezixhaswayo apha ngezantsi apho i-Synix kufuneka ifake isicwangciso somsebenzisi. 4. Khetha indlela umdlalo ufumana ngayo ifayile yocwangciso. Imodi elawulwayo idinga ifayile yokulungelelanisa esebenzayo epheleleyo, hayi umzekelo wenxalenye. 5. Khetha Ukuqinisekisa & Ukujonga kwangaphambili. Lungisa zonke iingxaki ezixelweyo ngaphambi kokuba ugcine imali. 6. Gcina, yenza kwakhona i-Synix, uqhube iimvavanyo ezizenzekelayo, uze uvavanye ukufakelwa/ukuqalisa/ukumisa/ukujonga umdlalo.
Iinkalo ezifunekayo • Igama lomdlalo: igama abasebenzisi abalibonayo kwiSynix. • I-ID yencazelo: i-ID encinane ekhethekileyo; I-Synix iyenzela igama lomdlalo. • I-Steam AppID: i-AppID yomncedisi ozinikeleyo, hayi rhoqo i-AppID yomdlalo womthengi. • Ukucwangciswa kwe-app ye-SteamCMD: ngokuqhelekileyo akukho nto. Iimidlalo ezabelwana ngazo zeGoldSrc AppID 90 zisebenzisa ifom eqinisekisiweyo ethi "90 mod folder", njengokuthi "90 mod cstrike". I-Synix yamkela le fomu ikhuselekileyo kuphela. • Inokuphunyezwa: umzekelo Binaries\Win64\Server.exe. Akubandakanyi ifolda yokufaka. • Izibuko: izibuko zomdlalo kunye nombuzo eziqinisekisiweyo. • Iimephu neendlela zomdlalo: faka ixabiso lomdlalo omnye ngqo kumgca ngamnye. Ezi zizalisa ukhetho oluboniswe xa usenza okanye uhlela umncedisi.
Iinkxalabo zokuqalisa Musa ukungena kwi-executable ngokwayo. Gcina iiflegi zomdlalo ezisisigxina njengombhalo oqhelekileyo kwaye ufake iithegi kuphela kumaxabiso alawulwa yi-Synix. Umzekelo: -port {port} -queryport {query} -name "{ServerName}" -maxplayers {MaxPlayers}
IINKCUKACHA EZISEKELWEYO [LAUNCH_ARGUMENT_TAGS]
RCON RECIPE Faka i-{rcon} kwiingxoxo zokuqalisa apho umyalelo ongakhethwayo we-RCON ungena khona. Kwi-RCON syntax, sebenzisa: [RCON_ARGUMENT_TAGS] Umzekelo RCON syntax: +rcon.port {rcon_port} +rcon.password "{rcon_pass}"
INQAKU ELINGUMXHOLO • Akuqinisekiswanga okwamanje: I-Synix ayiphathi ifayile yokulungelelanisa. • Umdlalo uyidala emva kokuqalisa kokuqala: sebenzisa ulungelelwaniso olupheleleyo olufunyenweyo njenge template yokuhlela nokulungisa. • I-Synix iyidala kwi template: I-Synix ibeka ulungelelwaniso olupheleleyo ngaphambi kokuqala. • Ukuqalisa iingxabano kuphela: umdlalo awudingi ukucwangciswa okulawulwayo kwezi zilungiso.
I-TEMPLATE TAGS {ServerName}, {Password}, {HasPassword}, {AdminPassword}, {MaxPlayers}, {Port}, {QueryPort}, {RCONPort}, {RCONPassword}, {EnableRcon}, {Identity}, {WorldName}, {WorldSeed}, {WorldSize}, {AppPort}, {LocalIP}, {PublicIP}, {IsPvp}, {IsPve}, {GameMode} I-{HasPassword} ibhala ixabiso lokwenyani lenkcazo xa kukho iphasiwedi yomncedisi kunye nexabiso layo eliphosakeleyo xa iphasiwedi ingenanto. Sebenzisa Yongeza iifayile zokulungelelanisa xa umncedisi efuna iifayile ezingaphezu kweyodwa. Khetha ifayile nganye egqibeleleyo yomthombo, emva koko uhlele indawo yayo efakiweyo kwitheyibhile ukuze indlela ihambelane nefolda yeserver. I-Synix iqinisekisa, ifake, ibhale, ilungise kwaye iphucule zonke iifayile ezidwelisiweyo kunye.
Iifayile ezifunwa ngumsebenzisi Faka indlela enye ekhuselekileyo kumgca ngamnye, ngokubhekiselele kwifolda yomncedisi efakiweyo. Iifayile ezifunekayo zivala ukuqalisa kude kube ngoku; iifayile ezingafunekiyo zingangeniswa xa zifunyenwe kodwa zingaze zivimbele ukuqalisa. Xa iifayile ezifunekayo zivela kumdlalo oqhelekileyo, chaza onke amanyathelo omsebenzisi kwimiyalelo yokuseta. I-Synix ayize ikhuphele, igqithe ubunikazi, okanye isasaze kwakhona iifayile zomdlali onelayisensi. Ifolda yedatha yangaphandle ligama lefolda USynix unokukhangela phantsi kwefolda yeDocuments yomsebenzisi. Yishiye ingenanto xa umsebenzisi efuna ukukopa iifayile ngesandla.
ISILUMKISO Sokuqala NESIKHONKO Vumela isilumkiso xa abasebenzisi kufuneka bagqibezele ukucwangcisa ngaphambi kokuthunyelwa kokuqala. Bhala amanyathelo acacileyo uze uchaze nantoni na umsebenzisi amele ayifumane kumdlalo wakhe. I-URL ye icon ayifuneki kwaye kufuneka isebenzise i-HTTPS. I-Synix ibuyela kwi icon esebenzayo yomncedisi efakiweyo xa ingenanto.
UKUHLOKELWA KWAKHO NOKUQINISEKA Qalisa iinkcazo ezintsha kunye neetemplate kwi-revision 1. Yandisa ukuhlaziywa kwenkcazelo nanini na utshintsho kwinkcazelo yomdlalo. Yandisa ukuhlaziywa kwetemplate kuphela xa utshintsho kulungelelwaniso lokulungelelanisa olulawulwayo. I-Synix ayivumi ukubhala ngokugqithisileyo ngaphandle kohlaziyo oluphezulu kwaye igcina i-backups yokuphucula.
I-POST-INSTALL OPTION Vumela i-Steam ikopishe ixesha lokuqhuba kuphela xa umncedisi eqinisekisiwe ukuba uyayifuna. Injongo kufuneka ibe yifolda ehambelana nayo ngaphakathi kolofakelo lwenkonzo. I-Synix ikopa kuphela ii-DLL zayo ezintathu ezivunyelweyo ze-Steam.
Iimfuno zeXesha Cwangcisa inkqubo ubuncinane RAM ukuba 0 xa umdlalo akanayo ubuncinane eqinisekisiweyo. I-Hardware kunye nokuhlolwa kwexesha lokusebenza kwe-Windows kuchaza iimfuno ezingekhoyo ngaphambi kokumiselwa kwaye kuvimbele ukuqaliswa okungakhuselekanga; azitshintshi izilungiso zeWindows. Khetha i- .NET Framework okanye i-Visual C ++ runtime kuphela xa iimfuno ezisemthethweni zomdlalo ziyibona. I-Synix ijonga irekhodi le-Windows kodwa ayize ifake okanye ikhuphele iimfuno ezingaphambili ngokuthula. I-Hyper-V idinga i-Windows Professional okanye ngaphezulu, ngoko ukukhetha i-Hyper-V kukhetha nemfuneko ye-Windows.
INDLELA YOKUQALA Sebenzisa umkhondo oqhelekileyo wenkqubo kwiiseva ezizinikeleyo eziqhelekileyo. Ukusetyenziswa kwangaphandle kusetyenziselwa ukuqalisa kuphela, umatshini obonakalayo, okanye olunye usetyenziso olune-server lifecycle; ikhubaza ngokuzenzekelayo ukujonga imibuzo. Vumela uMlawuli obonakalayo ofunekayo kwimidlalo apho umlawuli weseva esemthethweni kufuneka ahlale evulekile. Oku kususa ukhetho lomsebenzisi lwe-Hidden Console kuphela kule nkcazo. Ukuqalisa okuphakanyisiweyo kuxhaswa kuphela kwiifayile zokuqalisa ze .exe, .bat, kunye .cmd. Vumela ukuthunyelwa kwefayile yokuqalisa kuphela xa umsebenzisi enokudala kwaye aqhube ngokukhuselekileyo ifayile yokuqalisa ehlaziyiweyo ngaphandle kwe-Synix. Umyalezo olungeleyo uboniswa emva kokuphumelela kohlolisiso olukhethekileyo lokulungela umdlalo. Ezi ntsimi zikhetha ukuziphatha kwe-Synix okufakelweyo, okuvunyelweyo kwaye akunakusebenza izicwangciso okanye iiplagi ezizenzekelayo.
ILOG DISCOVERY Faka iindlela ezikhuselekileyo ngokunxulumene nefolda yomncedisi efakiweyo. Sebenzisa * kwicandelo leendlela okanye igama lefayile kunye ** kwiifolda ezidibeneyo. Iindawo ezixhaswayo ze{Identity}, {ServerName}, {WorldName}, {Port}, kunye ne{QueryPort}. Imizekelo: logs\latest.log, Saved\Logs\*.log, profiles\{Identity}\logs\**\*.log. Synix ikhangela ezi ndlela kuphela xa umsebenzisi ecela ukuvula ilog yomdlalo yakutshanje.

data.name: ServerActions.Notification.CrashDetected.Body
data.value: I-Synix yafumanisa ukuba i-{0} yayimile ngokungalindelekanga kwaye izama ukubuyela kwimeko yayo.

data.name: ServerActions.Notification.Stop.AutomaticBody
data.value: I-Synix iyamisa umncedisi ukuze enze isenzo esizenzekelayo.

data.name: Configuration.Backup.NoneAvailable
data.value: Akukho backup yangaphambili yocwangciso olucwangcisiweyo efumanekayo.

data.name: Text.ED08E4C207A6FC2493D7
data.value: ◇ Iindawo ezibuthathaka zilandela imodi yobumfihlo yeSynix.

data.name: Text.4234688FB477D9CF1421
data.value: ◇ Ulawulo olunolwazi lweemodeli: Izilungiso ezingafumanekiyo ziyekiswa ngokuzenzekelayo kumdlalo okhethiweyo.

data.name: Text.1B0142C80D27A3442046
data.value: ⚠ Ukutshintsha le ndawo akuzicimi i-backups kwifolda yangaphambili.

data.name: Text.A9B62C4456D11AE0550C
data.value: 🔒 [REQUIRED] Faka igama lomncedisi uze ukhethe itemplate yomdlalo.

data.name: Text.1A759326BD5A56996BF1
data.value: 1 Iinkcukacha Zakho Zihlala Zihlukile Iiseva, izilungiso, izipele, amaxesha okuqhuba, kunye neSteamCMD zigcinwa phantsi kweC:\Synix ukuze uhlaziyo lwesicelo lungazitshintshi.

data.name: Text.CD33F03B524794FFF78C
data.value: 2 ADD A SERVER Khetha umdlalo, ufake isicwangciso sobuhlobo, uze uvumele i-Synix uyifake. Ubhaliso lweSteam luyacelwa kuphela xa loo mdlalo ulufuna.

data.name: Text.61A00FCEB996AF15FF21
data.value: I-3 Qala, Yima, kwaye QHAYA I-Synix ibonisa iingxabano ezichanekileyo zokuqalisa, iqinisekisa ukuqala, isebenzisa indlela yokumisa ekhuselekileyo apho ixhaswa khona, kwaye igcina iilog zamva nje.

data.name: Text.CA9A7AA7C8AF17BABA8C
data.value: I-4 INTWERK ACCESS Iimvume zeWindows Firewall kunye nokuhanjiswa kwezibuko lomzila kwahlukile. I-Synix ihlola iingxabano zasekuhlaleni, kodwa ayize iguqule umzila wakho.

data.name: Text.C638A97009ED3C9CCB29
data.value: I-5 YOKUPHULA NEMIHLOBO Sebenzisa izicwangciso > Advanced > Troubleshooter ukuze uqinisekise ukuba impilo yakho ikhuselekile. Sebenzisa iiBackups ngaphambi kokuhambisa i-Synix okanye ukwenza utshintsho olukhulu.

data.name: Text.2B2D3EED7C841FFB78AA
data.value: Ulawulo lokufikelela, ukuziphatha kokuqalisa kunye nokudityaniswa

data.name: Text.74ECEE4668229DC04361
data.value: Igama leakhawunti, hayi igama lokubonisa lakho le-Steam

data.name: Text.C404A6A32FD8F56893D3
data.value: Yongeza nayiphi na enye itemplate epheleleyo umdlalo kufuneka. Hlela Indawo efakiweyo ukuze indlela nganye ibhekisele kwifolda yomncedisi efakiweyo.

data.name: Text.8F2ED817BE8BBE23D64C
data.value: Ubungqina obuzenzekelayo buvela kwizenzo zeSynix; iingxoxo zifuna uvavanyo lwe-server yangempela.

data.name: Text.BC489FF2DAD82D69C258
data.value: Uluhlu oluzenzekelayo lokujonga ukhuseleko kunye namanyathelo alandelayo

data.name: Text.A8BC53DE427A5E93DAED
data.value: Yakha ngokuzenzekelayo ifolda ekhuselekileyo yomdlalo/iserver ngaphantsi kwendlela yeMidlalo ehlelwe.

data.name: Text.1232008495CAD0B69745
data.value: Iibhloko ziqalisa ngesikhokelo esicacileyo sokukhuphela i-Microsoft xa ixesha lokuqhuba lingekho.

data.name: Text.AAFE71EF1584DE2CA4E2
data.value: Iibhloko zilungiselelo ngomyalezo ocacileyo xa iprosesa ingaxhasi i-AVX2.

data.name: Text.95E3AA6BFFB7545B20EF
data.value: Jonga amaxesha okuqhuba okwabelwana ngawo, iifayile zeseva, ulungelelwaniso, izibuko, i-Windows Firewall, indawo yediski, iinkqubo eziphazamisekileyo, iilog zamva nje, kunye nemeko yohlaziyo lwe-Synix kwindawo enye.

data.name: Text.37923AD83E636BE4C27F
data.value: Jonga i-SteamCMD ukuze ufumane uhlaziyo ngaphambi kokuqalisa umncedisi.

data.name: Text.6B1DD744008E1B4658A6
data.value: Jonga i-SteamCMD, amaxesha okuqhuba, iifayile zeseva, ulungelelwaniso, izibuko, i-Windows Firewall, indawo yediski, iinkqubo eziphazamisekileyo, iilog zamva nje kunye nemeko yohlaziyo.

data.name: Text.1DF3BE2046D08A780F73
data.value: Khangela imveliso yokupapasha yangempela ngaphandle kokwakha kwakhona i-Synix, ukuqala ukukhululwa, okanye ukufikelela kwi-C:\Synix.

data.name: Text.52A32013E2D94B00DBF7
data.value: Ukujonga ukukhululwa kwe-Windows .NET Framework efakiweyo ngaphambi kokuqalisa kweseva.

data.name: Text.445F89C824FEC1E5E372
data.value: Ukujonga ukuba inkxaso ye-virtualization inikwe amandla kwaye iyafumaneka kwi-Windows.

data.name: Text.58ECD5D931201294DE1E
data.value: Khetha uhlobo lomncedisi ukubonisa imbali yayo yokuqinisekisa yendawo.

data.name: Text.C9F72F8A6A3B6CC20F72
data.value: Khetha kuphela indlela yokuqalisa eyakhelweyo eqinisekisiweyo kule nkonzo inikezelweyo.

data.name: Text.22FCE0291808752AD7BC
data.value: Khetha i-backup ekufuneka ithathe indawo yeefayile zangoku zeseva.

data.name: Text.30F3BBCB43AC48EBFD1C
data.value: Khetha ulwimi olusetyenziswa yi-Synix. Izilungiselelo zomdlalo kunye namaxabiso okucwangcisa ahlala ngesiNgesi.

data.name: Text.54FE09AF7E87A247A21A
data.value: Khetha xa i-Synix kufuneka yenze ukuqala kwakhona kweseva ehleliwe.

data.name: Text.B09F5332EE858BE57F71
data.value: Imiyalelo ihlala kule khompyutha ngaphandle kokuba ucwangcisa uJava RCON ukufikelela kude.

data.name: Text.82A8EB3A96D059596D55
data.value: Gqibezela ukucwangciswa kwefayile efunekayo ngaphambi kokuba iserver ezinikezelweyo iqale.

data.name: Text.F0CDBB393CA93D39DF05
data.value: Indlela yocwangciso ngokubhekiselele kwifolda yomncedisi efakiweyo

data.name: Text.C2BD3BDCD4926716C67B
data.value: Qhubeka kuphela emva kokuba uphonononge amanyathelo afunekayo okuseta.

data.name: Text.07754DEE7F94A6CA31B1
data.value: Khuphela iifayile ze-Steam zexesha lokuqhuba emva kokufakwa

data.name: Text.DA14A0D982E06E70BB06
data.value: Khuphela iifayile ezivunyiweyo ze-Steam zexesha lokuqhuba emva kokufakwa

data.name: Text.A388F0CE16C067DFA8C5
data.value: Igubungela ixesha lokuqhuba elidibeneyo leMicrosoft elisetyenziswa ziiseva zangoku ze2015, 2017, 2019, kunye ne2022.

data.name: Text.2196E21E8E2F8ABE522B
data.value: Yenza isipele somncedisi okhuselweyo ngaphambi kokuqalisa nganye.

data.name: Text.5D45286D0F2A822299E8
data.value: Yenza inkcazo yomdlalo eyakhelweyo ngaphandle kweeplagi okanye iiskripthi. Iinkcazo zigcinwa kwiprojekthi kwaye zifumaneka kuphela emva kokwakhiwa kwakhona kweSynix.

data.name: Text.9F67BB0F58790841820E
data.value: Ukukhubaza umsebenzi oluhleliweyo usebenza kuphela xa i-Synix ivuliwe.

data.name: Text.84A9F83EFC6F8A9F3401
data.value: I-Discord ivuliwe. Khetha i-New Post kwiforum yokubika iimpazamo uze uncamathisele ingxelo ekhutshelweyo.

data.name: Text.0BB9D8B879FB1885FD71
data.value: Musa ukunamathisela amaphasiwedi, ii-webhooks, iidilesi ze-IP, ulungelelwaniso lwabucala, okanye imiyalelo yokuqalisa epheleleyo. I-Synix isusa iimfihlelo eziqhelekileyo ngaphambi kokuthumela.

data.name: Text.89BF7052C30A2A455D98
data.value: Umgaqo ngamnye ukhomba kwi-executable phantsi kwe-C:\Synix\Games\ [Game]\[Server], kodwa loo folda yeseva nganye ayisekho kwaye akukho seva ye-Synix efakiweyo eneendlela.

data.name: Text.46D0E2FA44635045064B
data.value: Hlela i-serverconfig.xml ngokukhuselekileyo ngaphandle kokutshintsha isakhiwo se-XML.

data.name: Text.947BC568AF81FE33EC61
data.value: Vumela kuphela xa ukufakwa okungaziwayo kwe-SteamCMD kusilela kwaye kufuneka iakhawunti ye-Steam.

data.name: Text.2F7C7C280CF67E40627A
data.value: Vumela kuphela xa umncedisi engakwazi ukuqhuba ngokuchanekileyo ngaphandle kwe-Windows ukuphakama.

data.name: Text.615A691F61191EE9C393
data.value: Vumela i-RCON kuphela kwiitemplate zomdlalo ezixhasa imiyalelo ekude ekhuselekileyo.

data.name: Text.59AD73A66B0E19C3759F
data.value: Vumela xa umncedisi enemibuzo eqinisekisiweyo okanye i-sonde yenethiwekhi enokuthi ilandelwe yi-Synix.

data.name: Text.518F7A1D974E46AED149
data.value: Faka ii-ID ngokulandelelana kwazo. Sebenzisa iikholamu, izithuba, okanye isazisi esinye kumgca ngamnye. I-Synix ayidingi database yamagama emodeli.

data.name: Text.E486E8326F69B31FB7D5
data.value: Faka ulwazi lomdlalo, uze uqinisekise ngaphambi kokuba ugcine.

data.name: Text.E83F8984B15353372DF8
data.value: Umzekelo: Umncedisi uvala imizuzwana embalwa emva kokuqalisa

data.name: Text.6F9406E668F812A49DBB
data.value: Ukuhanjiswa kwangaphandle kukuqalisa okanye oomatshini ababonakalayo kwaye kukhubaza ukujonga imibuzo.

data.name: Text.0078A1C33BF28B41D89B
data.value: Ifumana imigaqo esebenzayo eyayiphantsi kwe-C:\Synix\Games\[Game]\[Server], kodwa loo nkonzo ingasagcinwa kwaye ifolda yayo yomncedisi ayisekho. Izibuko kunye neefolda zokufaka ezenziwe ngokwezifiso azifakwanga.

data.name: Text.3BE6A898F14F4D050AF5
data.value: Imodi yomdlalo (ixabiso elinye elichanekileyo kumgca ngamnye)

data.name: Text.88ED3B522C4F0A8BD740
data.value: I-GitHub ayixhunyiwe. Ikopi kunye neDiscord iinketho zisasebenza.

data.name: Text.9942D957346A0E83C15C
data.value: I-GitHub ithumela ngokuthe ngqo ngaphandle kokuvula isikhangeli emva kokuba iakhawunti ixhunyiwe.

data.name: Text.4E4DEFAC10984CADF571
data.value: Fihla iidilesi ze-IP, amaphasiwedi nolunye ulwazi olubucayi ngelixa usasaza isikrini.

data.name: Text.A8578B710044B649B2CD
data.value: Indlela umsebenzisi afumana ngayo kwaye afake iifayile zomdlalo ezifunekayo

data.name: Text.4E469076738CB74F0877
data.value: Ndiqinisekisile igama lomncedisi elibonisiweyo, izibuko, umda womdlali, kunye nawo onke amanye amaxabiso asetyenziswe yile nkcazo, kubandakanywa amaphasiwedi, RCON, imowudi, kunye nemephu / ihlabathi apho kufanelekileyo.

data.name: Text.13F02AECB00BE9833629
data.value: Ulwazi lomntu, ihlabathi, umdlali kunye nenethiwekhi

data.name: Text.5D385B4C5044DA97B77C
data.value: UKUFUNDA Akukho phakheji ikhethiweyo Khetha iphakheji ukubala indawo nexesha.

data.name: Text.44D7882A1ADBECC9092C
data.value: Faka lo mdlalo kwiSynix ngaphambi kokuba uvavanye iingxabano zayo zokuthumela.

data.name: Text.70CAC3F03884A4946236
data.value: Ukufakela, ukuqala, ukumisa, kunye nokubeka iliso kuqinisekiswa ngokuzenzekelayo. Ukuqinisekiswa kwengxoxo kusebenzisa iseva yangempela efakiweyo kunye novavanyo lomyalelo oluhlambulukileyo; ukucwangciswa kuhlala kukuhlolwa kwefayile ngesandla.

data.name: Text.D3F2BA487FAA0A74E4A4
data.value: Ivumela umsebenzisi ukuba enze ifayile yokuqalisa ehlaziyiweyo. Ukukhubaza imiyalelo yokuhambisa ekufuneka ihlale ngaphakathi kweSynix.

data.name: Text.2FD27154D5938042C2FF
data.value: Ukunciphisa inani le-backup egcinwe kumncedisi ngamnye.

data.name: Text.E749931070B84A1593D2
data.value: Ukusebenza okubukhoma kuzo zonke iinkqubo zeseva yomdlalo ezilawulwayo.

data.name: Text.F31BBCEE0082BEEE372A
data.value: Iimephu kunye neendlela zokukhetha zivela ngqo kwi template yomdlalo ekhethiweyo.

data.name: Text.FDA8F741D724B426C343
data.value: Iimephu okanye iimeko (ixabiso elinye elichanekileyo kumgca ngamnye)

data.name: Text.A5C1D46A9B2A472DF537
data.value: Umyalezo oboniswe emva kokugqitywa kohlolo olukhethekileyo lokulungela (ngokuzithandela)

data.name: Text.71F9139AF2A58247E590
data.value: Inkqubo encinci ye-RAM kwi-GB (i-0 ithetha ukuba ayikho ubuncinane)

data.name: Text.0F38AC5E2C273A4B6642
data.value: Khangela izibuko zeseva ezisebenzayo ukuze ubone ukuba kukho izikhukula zeepakethe ezifikayo uze ubonise ukuqhambuka okungaqhelekanga kwezithuthi.

data.name: Text.1C310A469AD1721A3E91
data.value: Landela kwaye ulawule zonke iiseva zomdlalo ukusuka kwindawo enye yokusebenza.

data.name: Text.A6D637EAA965641CEB00
data.value: Yithi igama le ndawo ekuyiwa kuyo, uncamathisele i-webhook yayo ye-Discord, uze ukhethe ngokuchanekileyo ukuba zeziphi iziganeko ze-Synix ezifunyanwa yiyo.

data.name: Text.8DDA097844BB6EDCFA10
data.value: Ayitshintshanga: iifayile zomdlalo, iiseva ezigciniweyo, imithetho yezibuko kuphela, iifolda zokufaka ezenziwe ngokwezifiso, kunye nemithetho yomlilo ngaphandle kwe-C:\Synix\Games.

data.name: Text.4DC50DE227F1D75CFF26
data.value: Kuboniswa kuphela isazisi se-webhook esifihlakeleyo. Vula izicwangciso zeseva ukujonga okanye ukuhlela indawo egciniweyo.

data.name: Text.A8796566765C1117B49C
data.value: Ixabiso olitshintshayo kuphela elibuyiselwayo; izimvo, amacandelo, ukubekwa, izicaphulo, umgama kunye nokulandelelana kwezitshixo zihlala zingenasiphako.

data.name: Text.8736DCB51A77046719F5
data.value: Vula ikhonsoli yomthonyama xa iqalisa umncedisi womdlalo. Ukukhubaza oku ukuze kusebenze iiseva ngokuthula ngasemva.

data.name: Text.656F6C1DD0569874658F
data.value: Iifayile zokungenisa ezingafunekiyo (iindlela ezinxulumene noko, enye kumgca ngamnye)

data.name: Text.CB904327966ABA4B8621
data.value: I-RCON syntax ?? Iingxoxo zokuqalisa kufuneka ziqulethe i-{rcon}

data.name: Text.36B18A6020F2CE06DF28
data.value: Iphelisa ukhetho lwe-Synix lokufihla i-console kwiiseva ezilawulwa ngewindow yazo.

data.name: Text.F2492B6E06AE47BEB928
data.value: Ukufumaneka kwezibuko kuqinisekiswa ngokuzenzekelayo kwiinkqubo eziqhubayo kunye nezinye iiseva zeSynix.

data.name: Text.F13396A9BD6FFF26191D
data.value: Imodi yobumfihlo igubungela le ngcaciso yokufikelela. Ngenisa ikhowudi eyenziwe ngokwezifiso, okanye uyishiye ingenanto xa ufaka okokuqala ukuze i-Windrose yenze enye.

data.name: Text.82F665628E2402225B0F
data.value: Inkqubo yokuchonga kunye nokusetyenziswa kwemithombo ebukhoma kwiseva nganye yomdlalo esebenzayo.

data.name: Text.517D0391800FC8C55AD3
data.value: Ikhuselwe kwiSynix kwaye ifihliwe kwiirekhodi zayo. Iifayile ze-batch ezivelisiweyo ziquka i-token esetyenzisekayo kumbhalo ofundekayo.

data.name: Text.49CDA0DED2FDB6421A49
data.value: Ukupapasha ifolda ekhethiweyo. Hlola xa ukulungele.

data.name: Text.EC423125FB2CAF05C95B
data.value: Imiyalelo ekhawulezayo ?? khetha enye ukuyilungisa, emva koko uyiqwalasele uze uyithumele

data.name: Text.15599B0016F3C3591CF5
data.value: Ixabiso lokufunda kuphela linokukhethwa kwaye likhutshelwe ukuxilongwa

data.name: Text.69EDD9A74D913D8F77D6
data.value: Ukuqinisekiswa kokufunda kuphela kwesakhiwo setemplate, ukuhlaziywa, kunye namaxabiso agcinwe kwiiSethingi zeNkonzo. Ixabiso lephasiwedi alize liboniswe.

data.name: Text.D4BEB0C27C58D53CCFA7
data.value: Ukufunda nokuvavanya iprojekthi yelayibrari yokuchaza umdlalo...

data.name: Text.54C8BBF4B91A6012A87B
data.value: Windows icela imvume yomlawuli kuphela ukuba imithetho kufuneka isuswe.

data.name: Text.2B2FF7B1710C1AE35612
data.value: Ukulungele ukujonga iifayile ezipapashiweyo kunye ne-test receipt eyenziwe ngexesha lokuPapasha.

data.name: Text.FD866259C3EE73E57510
data.value: Lilungele ukuvavanya ithala leencwadi zokuchaza umdlalo.

data.name: Text.C0BAAF3EA26A1A69CE63
data.value: Lilungile. I-30-minute run kunye ne-30-second samples iyacetyiswa ukuba ihlolwe ngokukhawuleza.

data.name: Text.0C10BD130731730DDC5C
data.value: Ukuhlaziya ukulayisha iinkcukacha zomdlali ngqo kwiseva yendawo.

data.name: Text.4CB636A73FAD7D71BC94
data.value: Uvavanyo lokuthembeka luyekisiwe. Zange zitshintshwe izilungiso zeseva.

data.name: Text.FE3F7B0A38B0EEDF20EB
data.value: I-Synix ibonisa ngokuphindaphindiweyo inkumbulo, izibambo, imicu, kunye nokuhlolwa kwempilo yomncedisi wokufunda kuphela. Ayiqalisi, iyeke, ifake, ihlaziye okanye itshintshe umncedisi.

data.name: Text.88E68081C6F4A7C6EEE2
data.value: Funa iwindow yolawulo lomncedisi ukuba ihlale ibonakala

data.name: Text.9E09BE4B90E9259491DD
data.value: Iinkalo ezifunekayo zihlaziywa ngokuzenzekelayo kumdlalo okhethiweyo.

data.name: Text.AD654849FC9CF1C6D997
data.value: Iifayile ezifunekayo kunye neetemplate ezenziwe yi-Synix zivumela isilumkiso ngokuzenzekelayo.

data.name: Text.B0DAEADE1B96AB9F8EB5
data.value: Ifunekayo kwiimpawu ezifana ne-Hyper-V ezingafumanekiyo kwi-Windows Home.

data.name: Text.5BA4DAF696F2453133A8
data.value: Iingxoxo ezifunekayo zokuqalisa zifakwa ngamandla kunye nedatha yakho ethile ngaphambi kokuqalisa. Ungabandakanya nayiphi na imiqondiso eyongezelelweyo yomgca womyalelo engakhuselwa ngumtya ozenzekelayo kwicandelo leengxoxo ezongezelelweyo.

data.name: Text.5DC5CE2CCFBCC1F3AE31
data.value: Iifayile ezifunekayo ezibonelelwe ngumsebenzisi (iindlela ezinxulumene nazo, enye kumgca ngamnye)

data.name: Text.2D41AABA41C2EF3FED5C
data.value: Qalisa kwakhona iintsuku ezikhethiweyo ngexesha elicwangcisiweyo ngelixa ugcina idatha yomhleli wangoku.

data.name: Text.FE8445D560EC3691D1E1
data.value: Jonga indlela i-Synix eyakha ngayo umyalelo osetyenzisiweyo ukuqalisa le nkonzo.

data.name: Text.FC0C7D5D72BB74B7579E
data.value: Jonga imigaqo yelayisensi ngaphambi kokuvumela ukuqaliswa kweseva yokuqala.

data.name: Text.A2CBC7E3EEB055BE8AFC
data.value: Qwalasela ezi mfuno zokucwangcisa ngaphambi kokuqhubeka.

data.name: Text.B38F7F9752C285B4B90B
data.value: Ukuqhuba isakhiwo sephakeji, i-SHA-256, kunye nokuhlolwa kwe-antivirus...

data.name: Text.5D719633D44DEE05A861
data.value: Ukukhangela ngomdlalo, isicatshulwa, okanye imeko yenkxaso...

data.name: Text.4CDDB86B34725DFF943D
data.value: Uhlolisiso lwezokhuseleko luye lwavala iphakheji. Akukho fayile yatshintshwa.

data.name: Text.8C5A71A792CF70840F4B
data.value: Jonga ngokuchanekileyo oko i-Synix inokufaka, ukucwangcisa, ukujonga, kunye nombuzo ngaphambi kokudala iseva.

data.name: Text.339761CAC4ADD79725CB
data.value: Jonga ukuba yeyiphi indawo ye-Discord efumana uhlobo ngalunye lwesaziso se-Synix kule nkonzo.

data.name: Text.FFF9C013BFE465B863CB
data.value: Khetha umdlalo ukuze uhlaziye ubungqina bokuqinisekisa.

data.name: Text.F576F35548B3364CBEDB
data.value: Khetha umncedisi ofakiweyo uze uqinisekise umyalelo wayo.

data.name: Text.DA03B7F52F79500329AF
data.value: Thumela imeko, izipele, ulondolozo, kunye neengxaki kwiziteshi ezahlukeneyo zeDiscord.

data.name: Text.A50A426E7FA853DA7584
data.value: Iindawo zoluhlu lwee-server (indlela enye enxulumene nayo okanye isimboli se-wildcard kumgca ngamnye)

data.name: Text.D72917FA7B697BD4F0E1
data.value: Kuboniswa ukucacisa ukuze uqinisekise ukuba umyalelo wokuqalisa awunazo iingxabano ezifihliweyo.

data.name: Text.20C57F23AC717E8E040D
data.value: Qalisa umncedisi ngeSynix. Ilinde umphulaphuli wayo olungelelanisiweyo ukuba aphendule...

data.name: Text.091C22C7EE122D76DAE4
data.value: Qalisa ukujonga imvelaphi xa ungena kwiWindows. Ukuvala i-Dashboard ye-Synix kuhlala kuphuma i-Synix ngokupheleleyo kwiseshoni yangoku.

data.name: Text.106E51E2A0CD985A0FBC
data.value: I-Steam isalathiso sexesha lokuqhuba (indlela ehambelana nayo)

data.name: Text.AFC6E98203B42710D6D2
data.value: Gcina iifolda ezizenzekelayo nezesandla zeseva kwifolda eyenziwe ngokwezifiso.

data.name: Text.A03EE332F98F4733802C
data.value: Tshintsha ideshibhodi yeSynix phakathi kwemixholo ebonakalayo ekhanyayo nebumnyama.

data.name: Text.1263E823649071566AFC
data.value: I-Synix yakha umyalelo wokwenyani ngezilungiselelo ezigcinwe kule nkonzo, ifihla igama eligqithisiweyo ngalinye, iqale ngokuqhelekileyo, kwaye ilinde ubungqina bokuba umncedisi wamkele ukuqaliswa.

data.name: Text.030EBC77E93FA53151CE
data.value: I-Synix ayivuli izibuko loluntu lokulawula iwebhu. Amaphasiwedi agcinwe yi-Synix akhuselwe kwindawo, kwaye amaxabiso acekecekileyo afihliwe kwiirekhodi zayo zomsebenzi.

data.name: Text.69B1390848A4F53A80A2
data.value: I-Synix ifaka i-server loader ekhethiweyo kunye ne-Java ephathekayo ehambelana nayo. Yongeza iimodyuli zakho emva kokufakwa.

data.name: Text.93F24BC2C28FEF1DDC28
data.value: I-Synix yenzelwe ukwenza ukubanjwa komncedisi womdlalo womntu kuqondwe ngaphandle kokufihla oko kutshintshayo kwikhompyuter yakho.

data.name: Text.DB74849CCDF411527A63
data.value: I-Synix iqinisekisa i-backups eneziqinisekiso zokungaguquguquki, ihlela ngokukhuselekileyo i-archive ekhethiweyo, kwaye ngokuzenzekelayo ibuyela emva xa ukubuyiselwa kuhluleka. I-Synix yokungena kwiseva egciniweyo kunye nezilungiselelo zayo azitshintshwanga.

data.name: Text.F283ABEE58C3C5919882
data.value: I-Synix iqinisekisa isenzo ngasinye ngokuzenzekelayo emva kokuba siphumelele kule PC.

data.name: Text.7083BACCFEE1C7E3CC47
data.value: Sixelele ukuba ucofe ntoni, yintoni eboniswe yiSynix, nendlela yokuyenza yenzeke kwakhona.

data.name: Text.D25BF1DE94C6CFCB40D4
data.value: Ukuvavanya ngokukhuselekileyo zonke iinkcazo ezakhelwe ngaphakathi kunye neetemplate...

data.name: Text.91657E9737A951B3ADA2
data.value: Ukuvavanya yonke imidlalo eyakhelwe-ngaphakathi, ukubopha ukuseta okulawulwayo, itemplate yokulungelelanisa ngokupheleleyo, ukuhlaziywa, indlela, indawo yologi, kunye nesenzo esivunyelweyo emva kofakelo. Iiseva ezifakweyo azitshintshi.

data.name: Text.849FF4D03C300A88F143
data.value: Uxhumano lwasekuhlaleni luye lwasuswa. Cima i-Synix kwiphepha le-GitHub elivulekileyo.

data.name: Text.199AA28C30C28597C6E2
data.value: Ingxelo ehlolwe ngobumfihlo ikhutshwe kwaye ilungele ukunamathela kwiforum ye-Discord.

data.name: Text.0117F5327FA39CD0DABB
data.value: Uhlolisiso lokukhululwa lwalurhoxisiwe. Akukho fayile yokukhululwa yatshintshwa.

data.name: Text.AB89F96B667CE80E48CB
data.value: Ingxelo yokuthembeka iya kuvela emva kokugqitywa komsebenzi oyicelileyo.

data.name: Text.44D8326D9590F71F8B1B
data.value: Umncedisi okhethiweyo ufuna iakhawunti yeSteam yokufakelwa. Faka igama leakhawunti ekufuneka lisetyenziswe yi-SteamCMD.

data.name: Text.D305131EE6798E1D30FA
data.value: Umncedisi kufuneka ahlale emi ngexesha lokubuyisela

data.name: Text.BCB4E85BFE366942E9D4
data.value: Umncedisi wayeka ngaphambi kokuba kuqinisekiswe ukuqalisa. Hlola iingxelo zayo zakutshanje nenkcazelo yazo.

data.name: Text.946FF9E0EB0FA926E2AF
data.value: Umncedisi wovavanyo umisiwe. Ubungqina obugqityiweyo bobungqina bugcinwe.

data.name: Text.7B3AC1F3AD7BA73ED0CC
data.value: Ezi xabiso zinikwe amandla kuphela xa ithemplate yomncedisi ekhethiweyo iyazixhasa.

data.name: Text.7CB94F75343DF207439A
data.value: Lo mbono wolwazi ubonisa iingxoxo ezizenzekelayo ezisetyenziswa yiSynix xa kwakhiwa umyalelo wokuqalisa.

data.name: Text.6440A1A6AB337CD371BA
data.value: Qalisa yonke imihla xa kufuneka uqalise kwakhona.

data.name: Text.A8142050CBD33EE95F3F
data.value: Sebenzisa isantya esipheleleyo okanye umda wokufakwa, ukuhlaziywa, ukulungisa nokuqinisekiswa kweseva yomdlalo.

data.name: Text.60ADFA0715E4E83522DF
data.value: Sebenzisa i-webhook enye kule nkonzo uze ukhethe imiyalezo efunekayo ukuyifumana.

data.name: Text.4910EE68C0A14BD4AF19
data.value: Sebenzisa kuphela xa uvavanyo lubonisa ukuba umncedisi ufuna iifayile ze-Steam DLL ezivunyiweyo. Injongo kufuneka ihlale ngaphakathi kwifolda yomncedisi.

data.name: Text.1433E221238B95E942F7
data.value: Sebenzisa kuphela xa umncedisi esetyenziswa nge-Hyper-V okanye i-Windows.

data.name: Text.F2029FAFB53EFFEE6890
data.value: Usebenzisa ixesha lendawo lekhompyutha kunye nexesha leeyure ze24.

data.name: Text.229193F097F563A43177
data.value: Umgca wokuqinisekisa uvuselelwe kubungqina obugciniweyo beSynix.

data.name: Text.A7678DBAFBD9E2842236
data.value: I-hardware eqinisekisiweyo kunye neemfuno ze-Windows eziqinisekisiweyo ngaphambi kokuba i-Synix ifake okanye iqalise iserver.

data.name: Text.16FB4FBCA9A11AC839AE
data.value: Ukuqinisekisa iindlela zokugcinwa kwee-archive nokuthembeka kweSHA-256...

data.name: Text.29CAE0D1FFE7D67CA266
data.value: Ukulinda isampulu yokuqala • Ukuhlaziya ngokuzenzekelayo yonke imizuzwana ye1

data.name: Text.9B1DF515009197F7B731
data.value: Oko i-Synix ekwaziyo ukufaka, ukucwangcisa, ukuqala, ukujonga nokubuza lo mdlalo.

data.name: Text.DDE7244B8E964BD733E4
data.value: Yintoni eyayenziwa nguSynix xa kwenzeka ingxaki

data.name: Text.C29162E9E78CEEA6A66B
data.value: Xa isebenze, ukususa umncedisi ucela imvume kumlawuli ukususa imithetho yayo yeWindows yeFirewall. Yicime le nto ukuze ungayicoci ngokuzenzekelayo ngexesha lokucima.

data.name: Text.9D352A1132C068237394
data.value: I-Windows icela imvume yomlawuli. Emva koko i-Synix isusa kuphela imigaqo ye-firewall ehambelana neendlela ezichanekileyo eziphunyezwayo apha ngasentla kwaye iskena kwakhona ukuqinisekisa ukucocwa.

data.name: DynamicText.C0DC4B8E2D0B8558D8E2
data.value: • Eli nyathelo lirekhodwa yinkqubo yokusebenza yomncedisi.

data.value: Qinisekisa amaxabiso abonakalayo kumdlalo ngaphambi kokurekhoda ukuqinisekiswa.

data.value: iifayile). Khetha enye ifayile yocwangciso kuluhlu olungentla.
