data.name: DynamicText.CB565F94960FAEEC9A40
data.value: Khetha ifolda esele ikhona ukuze uqhubeke.

data.name: DynamicText.793006985DD52D518C6D
data.value: Khetha ukugcinwa kweseva uze wenze ngokwezifiso iingxoxo zokuqalisa.

data.name: DynamicText.A621C06C3B84375BB5BD
data.value: Khetha apho umncedisi uza kufakwa khona. I-Synix inika iisetingi zokuqalisa ezicetyiswayo.

data.name: DynamicText.36A6C5ECE85999A4BE81
data.value: Ukuqinisekiswa komyalelo akuphumelelanga. Lungisa iimvavanyo ezingaphumelelanga ngaphambi kokuqalisa uvavanyo.

data.name: DynamicText.99916B9A2D79AE0044D5
data.value: Ukuqinisekiswa komyalelo kugqityiwe. Qalisa uvavanyo ukuze ubonise ukuba umncedisi wokwenene uyayamkela.

data.name: DynamicText.7ECD8218EFACE24753CD
data.value: Lungisa inqaku lokutshekisha elivaliweyo ngaphambi kokuqhubeka.

data.name: DynamicText.48E90B62E47904DCCF35
data.value: Ukusetyenziswa kwe-CPU ebukhoma • Ukuhlaziywa kabini ngomzuzwana

data.name: DynamicText.B33FD36A68F065CBBB4C
data.value: Akukho zi-backups zigcinwe zisasele kule nkonzo.

data.name: DynamicText.019DEC65766E8437A2BC
data.value: Akuzange kufunyanwe bungqina obugciniweyo baloo nyathelo.

data.name: DynamicText.4477A4C46D66B4C3CDD3
data.value: Akukho nkonzo isebenzayo exhaswayo efunyenwe kule folda. Zama ifolda esetyenziswa njengendlela yokufaka umncedisi.

data.name: DynamicText.8B700BE01A653A54E743
data.value: Inkqubo yomncedisi iqalile. Ukulinda umphulaphuli wayo olungiselelweyo (

data.name: DynamicText.2963E82CDEB74AF4972B
data.value: I-Synix ifaka umncedisi osemthethweni kunye ne-Java ephathekayo ehambelanayo.

data.name: DynamicText.1EF6387A9E820CAE40CD
data.value: I-Synix iya kuqhubeka ikhangela umncedisi ngokuzenzekelayo ngelixa iqala.

data.name: DynamicText.4135714A2CE40AC94577
data.value: I-Synix ibhala le template epheleleyo ngaphambi kokuqala kokuqala kwaye ilawula amaxabiso ayo axhaswayo.

data.name: DynamicText.7DA57FD83E46D2A235A5
data.value: Umdlalo udala ifayile kuqala. Yongeza ifayile egcinwe ngokupheleleyo ukuze i-Synix isebenzise amaxabiso agciniweyo kwaye ilungise ngokukhuselekileyo emva kokugqitywa kokuqala.

data.name: DynamicText.21E5A037A461B8D029D9
data.value: Le nkqubo isebenza. Ndilinde ukuhlolwa kokuqalisa kwesibini se30 (

data.name: DynamicText.B83EC0A78559E32C96D2
data.value: Lo mdlalo sele unobungqina bempikiswano kule nguqulelo yeSynix okanye inguqulelo yakutshanje.

data.name: DynamicText.2B2D90F9562301F0CDFF
data.value: Le nkqubo inokuthatha ixesha elithile kuxhomekeka kubungakanani bedatha efunekayo ukupakishwa.

data.name: DynamicText.957B6227F5D5D371C582
data.value: Sebenzisa iphasiwedi eyenziwe xa le phakheji yeSynix yathunyelwa ngaphandle.

data.name: DynamicText.521C1B97737D7230C110
data.value: Sebenzisa ii-port zomdlalo ezicetyiswayo kunye nemibuzo. Imodi ephucukileyo yongeza ulawulo lweRCON.

data.name: DynamicText.6D2A0FB0BA7193CDCA30
data.value: Silindele ukuvunywa kweGitHub. Ikhowudi iphelelwa lixesha

data.name: MessageText.44318E7F273C4C1CC8A3
data.value: Ngaba ufuna ukuqhubeka nokwenza iphasiwedi yokudlulisa?

data.name: MessageText.FEEC1973C8CB7222A750
data.value: Ngaba ufuna ukuqhubeka nokuthumela ngaphandle okuqhelekileyo okungakhuselekanga?

data.name: MessageText.7E0290C3557A7F9E0F5F
data.value: Ukukhuphela, ukuhlaziya okanye ukuqinisekisa sele kuqhubeka.

data.name: MessageText.23CBCB62E27C0309918E
data.value:
Ifayile yeqela yenziwe ngempumelelo!
Ukugcinwa ngokuthe ngqo:

data.name: MessageText.248D89E27FEDE5EBBB31
data.value: Ayikwazi ukuvala i-Synix ngelixa iseva ifaka, ihlaziya, yenza isipele, ibuyisela okanye isusa!

data.name: MessageText.2022398CDE720D78BF2A
data.value: Khetha kuqala ifolda equlathe iifayile zeSynix ezipapashiweyo.

data.name: MessageText.C09ACD8E3F4CBB979723
data.value: Qhubeka kuphela ukuba zonke izatifikethi zivela kumthombo omthembileyo.

data.name: MessageText.53B01E5FCFDE56675C9A
data.value:
Ukudibanisa i-GitHub ne-Synix?
I-Synix iya kususa unxibelelwano olucwangcisiweyo olugcinwe kule khompyutha, emva koko ivule i-GitHub ukuze ukwazi ukurhoxisa imvume kwiakhawunti yakho.

data.name: MessageText.1D8A8E332F05698AE41A
data.value: Ngaba ufuna ukwenza ukuthumela ngaphandle okungakhuselekanga?

data.name: MessageText.FBCAED3A43A89EEDF08A
data.value: Ukuthumela ngaphandle ifayile yeBhetshi eneempawu ezifundekayo

data.name: MessageText.FD1FB8A609DE5750E995
data.value: Ufakelo, Ukuqala, Ukuyeka, kunye nobungqina bokulandelela buqokelelwa ngokuzenzekelayo yinkqubo yokusebenza yeseva ye-Synix kwaye ayinakufakwa ngesandla.

data.name: MessageText.51513CCC80231973A886
data.value: Ukuthumela ngaphandle Okuqhelekileyo Akusiyo Imveliso Yobuqu

data.name: MessageText.9B6050841590FD1BB10A
data.value: Nceda umise umncedisi ngaphambi kokuhlela useto lwayo.

data.name: MessageText.D955BE724373ACFC3AD2
data.value:
Ukubuyisela i-Synix entsha?
I-Synix iya kuqala igcine iifayile ezikhoyo ukuze oku kubuyiselwa nako kungabikho.

data.name: MessageText.A36A8AE6C94D6549F743
data.value: Gcina okanye ucime utshintsho kumhleli ngaphambi kokujonga amaxabiso agcinwe kwidiski.

data.name: MessageText.3AA26503CC8EA0B171F1
data.value: Isilumkiso Sokhuseleko: Enye yeempawu zakho ziqulethe oonobumba abangekho mthethweni.

data.name: MessageText.9E4EAF41685A751D0C5D
data.value: Cwangcisa indlela yokulungelelanisa umdlalo uze ungeze nayiphi na inkcazelo efunekayo ye template ngaphambi kokuba uphawule ukulungelelaniswa kwayo njengokuqinisekisiweyo.

data.name: MessageText.37D35536B29E5D04935F
data.value: Yimisa le nkonzo ngaphambi kokuba usethe kwakhona ucwangciso lwayo.

data.name: MessageText.96B14861829C994EDBFF
data.value: Yima le nkonzo ngaphambi kokuba ubuyisele i-backup yocwangciso.

data.name: MessageText.713E1363B1176FB2ABCE
data.value: Beka umncedisi kuqala. Uvavanyo kufuneka lubone ukuqaliswa okutsha okwenziwe kwiingxoxo ezibonisiweyo.

data.name: MessageText.6B5EDE5E1A10BF24CA11
data.value: I-Synix ayifumananga ifolda yeprojekthi. Sebenzisa esi siqinisekisi kwiVisual Studio Build okanye Rebuild yeprojekthi yeSynix.

data.name: MessageText.4AE453C9E5CBA09BFB92
data.value: I-Synix ayikwazanga ukuvula ulwazi olugciniweyo lwe-Discord webhook. Vula izicwangciso zeseva uze ugcine ii-webhooks kwakhona.

data.name: MessageText.1D7E8CD37BFCD097E6DA
data.value: I-Synix ayinayo itemplate yokumisa kwakhona epheleleyo yalo mdlalo.

data.name: MessageText.AA9402AAA45447FCB9A8
data.value: I-Synix izakwakha kwakhona ulungelelwaniso olupheleleyo kwi template yayo ethembekileyo, iphinde isebenzise amaxabiso omncedisi agciniweyo, kwaye igcine isipele. Ukuqhubeka?

data.name: MessageText.3679B9A889A4F6F470DA
data.value: I-add-on ifakiwe kwaye yaqinisekiswa. Qalisa umncedisi xa ulungele.

data.name: MessageText.F23CB309225C503B6D8A
data.value: I-add-on ifakiwe kwaye yaqinisekiswa. Le nkqubo idla ngokuyithwala ngaphandle kokuqalisa kwakhona ngokupheleleyo.

data.name: MessageText.21619FB57FA1E3D42E43
data.value: Umyalelo kufuneka uphumelele zonke iimvavanyo zokuqinisekisa ngaphambi kokuba i-Synix iqale uvavanyo lwempikiswano.

data.name: MessageText.EA2CD9B6AE3E2608F49E
data.value: I-Game Definition Builder ifumaneka kuphela kwizakhiwo zophuhliso.

data.name: MessageText.2A2FCD5BFFF42E6401AE
data.value: Uludwe lweempawu ezichaziweyo zilungile. Umdlalo uza kukhuphela okanye uhlaziye umxholo ophethwe ngumnikezeli xa iserver iqala.

data.name: MessageText.A570646762EA80624E34
data.value: Iphakheji yokudluliselwa ekhethiweyo ayifumanekanga. Khetha kwakhona.

data.name: MessageText.313E93838C2B67200EAB
data.value: Le backup ine-SHA-256 engekho mthethweni kwaye ayinakuphinda ibuyiswe. Khetha enye inkxaso.

data.name: MessageText.379C1CF1A5975C5E0C37
data.value: Le folda ayinalutho. Ukufakela apha kunokubhala ngaphezulu iifayile. Ukuqhubeka?

data.name: MessageText.F94014E8EAE83ED1AC43
data.value: Lo mdlalo ulawulwa ngokupheleleyo ngokusebenzisa iingxabano zokuqalisa, ngoko akukho mfuneko yovavanyo olwahlukileyo lwefayile yocwangco.

data.name: MessageText.AC3B07BB575D129E2A12
data.value:
Oku kuya kwakha kwakhona ulungelelwaniso lomdlalo ukusuka kwi template ye-Synix ephambili kwaye kusetyenziswe amaxabiso agcinwe kwiiSethingi zeNkonzo.
Naliphi na elinye ixabiso lokulungelelanisa elizenzekelayo liya kususwa.

data.name: MessageText.BA03F2AB291E808BE95A
data.value: Linda ukufakelwa okwangoku, ukuhlaziywa, ukugcinwa kwesicatshulwa okanye ukudluliselwa ukuba kugqityiwe ngaphambi kokuqinisekisa iphakheji.

data.name: MessageText.C02FB698977B0364EC82
data.value: I-Windows ayizange ikwazi ukukopa ingxelo yocwangciso.

data.name: MessageText.C4163B7C6E2B1B662C17
data.value: I-Windows ayizange ikwazi ukukopa ingxelo yokukhutshwa.

data.name: MessageText.D08D6AB01BF21D6FCB08
data.value: I-Windows ayikwazanga ukuvula iphepha lokukhululwa kwe-GitHub.

data.name: MessageText.663E3E2D227DB51428B7
data.value: Unotshintsho olungagcinwanga. Ngaba uza kuzilahla uze uzivale?

data.name: MessageText.3B1950A30C957AAF88A2
data.value: Kufuneka umise umncedisi ngaphambi kokuba uyihlaziye.

data.name: MessageText.19580FB3CF2A0F82762D
data.value: Kufuneka umise umncedisi ngaphambi kokuqinisekisa iifayile zomncedisi.

data.name: ModManager.Error.LinkedPath
data.value: Lo msebenzi wongezo usebenzisa ifayile okanye ifolda edibeneyo. Khetha ifolda eqhelekileyo; I-Synix ayiyi kulandela elo nxibelelwano.

data.name: ModManager.Error.PreviousFileMissing
data.value: Ifayile eyongezelelweyo yangaphambili efunekayo ekubuyiselweni ayisekho. Akukho fayile yatshintshwa. Buyisela ifayile yokubuyisela engekhoyo okanye sebenzisa isicwangciso sokusekela umncedisi esiqinisekisiweyo ngaphambi kokuba ususe le add-on.

data.name: ModManager.Error.RecoveryRetained
data.value: Umsebenzi wokongeza awuphumelelanga kwaye ezinye iinguqu azikwazanga ukubuyela umva. Iifayile zokuphilisa zazigcinwe kwi{0}. Gcina umncedisi emi kwaye ubuyisele ezo fayile okanye isiqinisekiso somncedisi sokusekelayo ngaphambi kokuqalisa.

data.name: LaunchCommand.Error.UnsafeBatchValue
data.value: Indawo yokuthumela i-{0} ayikwazi kudlula ngokukhuselekileyo kule nqanawa yokuthumela i-Windows. Iingcaphuno ezifakelweyo eziphindwe kabini, ukuphazamiseka komgca, okanye iinkcazo eziguqukayo azixhaswanga apha. Ixabiso alizange litshintshwe.

data.name: LaunchCommand.Error.UnsafeBatchArguments
data.value: Umyalelo ogqityiweyo webhetshi uquka umyalelo ongakhuselekanga okanye ulwandiso lweenguqu. Ukuhlolisisa amaxabiso okuqalisa kunye nezizathu ezongezelelweyo; Akukho nto yaqalwayo.

data.name: ServerStart.Arguments.CustomHidden
data.value: [Izizathu zenkcubeko ezibonelelweyo; umxholo osusiweyo kwi log]

data.name: Configuration.Editor.Error.YamlUnsupported
data.value: Umgca weYAML {0} awisebenzi okanye usebenzisa into engenakuguqulwa ngokukhuselekileyo ngumhleli. Ukuxhaswa: Uxwebhu olunye olunemaphu/oluhlu oludwelisiweyo kunye namaxabiso omgca omnye. Iingqokelela zokuhamba, amaxabiso emigca emininzi, iithegi, iiankile, kunye ne-alias azixhaswanga. Akukho nto yasindiswayo.

data.name: GameInput.WorldSeed.RequiredNumber
data.value: Imbewu yehlabathi iyafuneka kwi-{0}: sebenzisa inani elipheleleyo ukusuka kwi-{1} ukuya kwi-{2}. Yilungise kwiSeta yeSeva > Isizukulwana sehlabathi.

data.name: ServerSetup.World.Seed.RangeHint
data.value: Inani elipheleleyo ukusuka kwi-{0} ukuya kwi-{1}. Ngenxa yehlabathi elikhoyo, gcina imbewu yalo yokuqala.

data.name: ServerSetup.World.Seed.Hint
data.value: Yenza imbewu yehlabathi elitsha, okanye ungene kwelakho. Ngenxa yehlabathi elikhoyo, gcina imbewu yalo yokuqala.

data.name: EmpyrionMods.Error.Profile
data.value: Olu luhlu lwepakethe luxhaswa kuphela kwiifolda zoMxholo ezichaziweyo ze-Empyrion.

data.name: EmpyrionMods.Error.FolderName
data.value: Sebenzisa igama lefolda eneempawu ze-1–80, ngaphandle kwe-slashes, amagama agciniweyo e-Windows, okanye iindawo eziphambili / ezilandelanayo. Igama lesicwangciso alinakuba yinombolo yeworkshop kuphela.

data.name: EmpyrionMods.Error.Layout
data.value: Khetha isicatshulwa esipheleleyo esikhutshelweyo okanye iphakheji ye-mod yomncedisi eqokelelweyo, hayi ufakelo lomdlalo, ingqokelela yeWorkshop, umzobo, okanye ulawulo lwekhowudi yomthombo.

data.name: EmpyrionMods.Error.ScenarioLayout
data.value: I-gameoptions.yaml kunye ne-Content, Playfields, Sectors, okanye Prefabs asethi zayo kufuneka zibandakanywe kwi-ZIP root okanye ngaphakathi kwefolda ye-Scenario enye.

data.name: EmpyrionMods.Error.ScenarioCode
data.value: Le phakheji yesicatshulwa iqulethe ikhowudi yeDLL, C# okanye JAR. Ngenisa ikhowudi yomncedisi ngokwahlukeneyo ngokusebenzisa ii-mods zomncedisi we-Empyrion emva kokujonga imiyalelo yombhali.

data.name: EmpyrionMods.Error.ModLayout
data.value: Khetha iphakheji ye-mod epheleleyo: Iifayile ze-DLL kunye neefayile zazo ezixhasayo kufuneka zibekwe kwingcambu yepakethe okanye ngaphakathi kweefolda ze-mod nganye. Iifolda ezongezelelweyo ze-wrapper kunye ne-archives epheleleyo yomncedisi azamkelekanga.

data.name: EmpyrionMods.Error.MissingScenario
data.value: Loo meko ayifakwanga. Ngenisa isicatshulwa esipheleleyo kuqala, uze usikhethe kuluhlu olufakiweyo.

data.name: EmpyrionMods.Error.ConfigurationChanged
data.value: Iimeko okanye iisetingi zokugcina zatshintshile ngelixa eli window livulekile. Yicime uze ukhethe imeko kwakhona.

data.name: EmpyrionMods.Error.ExistingSave
data.value: Le nkonzo sele ikhona. Imeko eyahlukileyo idinga igama elitsha, elingasetyenziswanga. I-Synix ayizange ithathe indawo okanye icime ihlabathi elikhoyo.

data.name: EmpyrionMods.Error.Configuration
data.value: I-dedicated.yaml ilahlekile, inkulu kakhulu, okanye ayiqulethi isicwangciso esinye seGameConfig.CustomScenario kunye neGameConfig.GameName. Qalisa ngokulungisa umncedisi kuqala.

data.name: EmpyrionMods.Error.SaveFailed
data.value: I-Synix ayikwazanga ukugcina ukungena kweseva. Ukucwangciswa kwesicatshulwa sangaphambili kubuyiselwe; Amaqela okuxhasa ayagcinwa.

data.name: EmpyrionMods.Error.ProtectedScenario
data.value: I-Synix ayiyi kususa isicatshulwa esikhethiweyo okanye iiasethi zesicatshulwa ngelixa kukho imihlaba egcinwe. Ihlabathi elinjalo lisenokuxhomekeka kwiifayile. Akuzange kususwe iifayile zemiboniso.

data.name: EmpyrionMods.ImportedScenario
data.value: Kwakungeniswa iifayile zesicatshulwa. Ihlabathi langoku kunye nokukhethwa kwesicatshulwa akuzange kutshintshe. Sebenzisa iKhetha iScenario ukukhetha iscenario kunye negama lokugcina. Gcina igama lefolda efanayo xa ungenisa uhlaziyo.

data.name: EmpyrionMods.Picker.ScenarioHelp
data.value: Bhalisa kwi-Steam uze uvumele ukukhuphela kugqitywe, emva koko ukhethe ifolda yesicatshulwa phantsi kwe-steamapps\workshop\content\383120, okanye ukhethe i-ZIP yesicatshulwa esipheleleyo. Oku kungenisa ikopi yasekuhlaleni; I-Steam ayiyi kuhlaziya ikopi yeseva ngokuzenzekelayo.

data.name: EmpyrionMods.Picker.ModHelp
data.value: Khetha i-ZIP epheleleyo yomncedisi we-mod okanye ifolda kumlobi omthembayo. Gcina i-DLLs, i-_Info.yaml (xa inikezelwa), ukuxhomekeka kunye nezinto kunye. I-Synix ayikhangeli ukuxhomekeka okanye iqhube ikhowudi ye-mod ngokwayo.

data.name: EmpyrionMods.Picker.FolderName
data.value: Igama lefolda yesicatshulwa kwiseva (phinda usebenzise eli gama xa uhlaziya)

data.name: EmpyrionMods.Selection.Confirm
EmpyrionMods.Selection.Saved
data.value: Isigcawu kunye nokhetho lokugcina zigcinwe. Qalisa umncedisi xa sele ukulungele, uze uhlole ilog yomdlalo uze uqhagamshelane nomxhasi. Kwagcinwa iifolda zehlabathi ezikhoyo.

data.name: EmpyrionMods.Selection.Help
EmpyrionMods.Selection.SaveName
data.value: Gcina igama (GameConfig.GameName ?? hayi igama lokubonisa lomncedisi)

data.name: EmpyrionMods.Selection.NewSaveNotice
data.value: Kwimeko eyahlukileyo kufuneka kusindiswe umntu omtsha. I-Synix iphakamisa igama elitsha kwaye ayize ilibale okanye ibhale phezu kwehlabathi elikhoyo.

data.name: EmpyrionMods.Support.Scenarios
data.value: Ngenisa ifolda ekhutshwe okanye i-ZIP. Sebenzisa Khetha iScenario emva koko; i-saves ezikhoyo zikhuselwe.

data.name: EmpyrionMods.Support.Mods
data.value: Ngenisa iifolda ze-mod ezigqityiweyo okanye ii-ZIPs. Jonga ukuxhomekeka komlobi; ikhowudi isebenza kwiEmpyrion.

data.name: EmpyrionMods.Remove.Confirm
data.value: Ukuphelisa ukuthunyelwa okuqulethe i{0}? Zonke iifayile ezifakwe yile phakheji ziya kususwa okanye zibuyiselwe kwiikopi zazo zangaphambili, kubandakanywa nezinye iimodyuli kwiphakheji. Iifayile ezitshintshiwe ngaphandle kweSynix ziya kuvala ukubuyela umva. Gcina i-backup epheleleyo yomncedisi ngaphambi kokuba uqhubeke.

data.name: ModPackages.Error.FolderUnsupported
data.value: Le nkqubo eyongezelelweyo ayixhasi ukuthunyelwa kweefolda. Khetha enye yeefayile zepakethe ezixhaswayo.

data.name: ModPackages.Error.Layout
data.value: Khetha ifolda epheleleyo ye-mod okanye yescenario equlathe iifayile zepakethe ezifunekayo, hayi ufakelo lomdlalo okanye ingqokelela yokukhuphela okungahambelaniyo.

data.name: ModPackages.Error.Size
data.value: Iphakheji idlula imida yokungenisa yale nkqubo eyongezelelweyo, okanye umxholo wayo utshintshiwe ngelixa ikhutshelwa. Akukho nto ifakiweyo.

data.name: ModPackages.Picker.Help
data.value: Khetha i-mod ZIP epheleleyo okanye ifolda yomdlalo kunye nesakhelo esikhethiweyo. Gcina i-manifesto yayo efunekayo, ukuxhomekeka kwayo kunye nezinto zayo ndawonye. Jonga indawo ekuyiwa kuyo uze ukhangele iziphumo ngaphambi kokuba ufake.

data.name: ModPackages.Picker.SelectFolder
data.value: Khetha ifolda epheleleyo ye-mod okanye yesicatshulwa, hayi ufakelo lomdlalo

data.name: EmpyrionMods.Import.ExistingScenario
data.value: Le folda yeemeko sele ikhona. Iifayile ezihambelanayo ziya kutshintshwa, ezinokuchaphazela imihlaba esebenzisa le meko. Gcina i-backup epheleleyo yomncedisi kwaye usebenzise igama lefolda eyahlukileyo kwimeko eyahlukileyo. Iifayile ze-Saved World aziyi kutshintshwa.

data.name: ModManager.Error.NewerInstallation
data.value: Ukungeniswa okutsha ngoku kunamafayile kule phakheji. Qalisa ngokubuyisela izinto ezintsha.

data.name: ModManager.Error.PreviousFileChanged
data.value: Ifayile yokuqala egciniweyo itshintshile. Ukubuyela umva kwamiswa ngaphambi kokutshintsha iifayile zeseva. Buyisela isipele esithembekileyo se-server epheleleyo ukuba kuyimfuneko.

data.name: ModManager.Inventory.Search
data.value: Khangela izinto ezongezelelweyo kule ndawo yokufaka...

data.name: ModManager.Inventory.Scanning
data.value: Ukukhangela izinto ezongezelelweyo nokujonga iifayile ezifunyenweyo...

data.name: ModManager.Progress.Installing
data.value: Ukufaka iphakheji ehlaziyiweyo kunye nokugcina iikopi zokubuyela umva...

data.name: ModManager.Progress.Removing
data.value: Ukujonga iphakheji epheleleyo nokubuyisela iifayile zangaphambili...

data.name: ModManager.Progress.Framework
data.value: Ukufakela isakhelo somncedisi. Nceda ugcine le window ivulekile...

data.name: ModManager.Framework.SaveFailed
data.value: Iifayile zesakhelo zifakwe, kodwa i-Synix ayizange ikwazi ukugcina useto lweseva. Jonga iimvume zefolda uze ugcine kwakhona ulungelelwaniso lomncedisi ngaphambi kokuqalisa. Iifayile ezifakweyo azizange zipheliswe.

data.name: ModManager.Progress.Failed
data.value: Umsebenzi awukwazanga ukugqitywa. Hlaziya impazamo, uze uphinde uyenze ngaphambi kokuzama kwakhona.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.OverviewHelp
data.value: Lawula umncedisi okhethiweyo weMinecraft apha. Yiyeke ngaphambi kokuba utshintshe iifayile, imihlaba, iipakethi, okanye ixesha lokuqalisa. Qalisa, uyeke, uze uqalise kwakhona sebenzisa i-Synix yokhuseleko lobomi obuqhelekileyo.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.OverviewValues
MinecraftWorkspace.ScheduleHelp
data.value: Sebenzisa izicwangciso zokuqalisa kwakhona nokugcinwa, kuquka ukulinda abadlali nokwenza isipele esipheleleyo kuqala. Amaxesha asebenzisa ixesha lendawo lePC. I-Synix kufuneka isebenze ukuze ishedyuli yayo iqhube.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.ScheduleValues
MinecraftWorkspace.PlayersHelp
data.value: Ukuhlaziya ukujonga amagama akwi-intanethi kunye noluhlu lokufikelela olugciniweyo. Khetha okanye uthayiphe igama lomdlali, uze uqwalasele isenzo. Imiyalelo idinga umncedisi osebenzayo kunye nonxibelelwano lwekhonsoli esebenzayo. I-Bedrock ayixhasi imiyalelo yokuthintelwa kwe-Java.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.SettingsHelp
data.value: Hlela i-server.properties kunye neefayile zocwangciso lwe-mod/plugin. Amaxabiso asetyenziswa yi-Synix ayavumelaniswa xa i-server.properties igcinwa. Igama elibhengeziweyo / i-MOTD yahlukile kwigama lasekuhlaleni lale ngxelo. Ukuhlaziya ukulayisha ngokutsha ukulungiswa kokulungelelanisa kwangaphandle ngelixa kumisiwe.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.EditorHelp
data.value: Ukugcina kudala iikopi zokubuyisela. Utshintsho kwizibuko, ihlabathi, imbewu, imowudi yomdlalo, umda womdlali, kunye nezilungiso zokulawula ezixhaswayo zeMinecraft nazo zihlaziya i-Synix. I-JSON, i-XML kunye ne-YAML zihlolwe ngaphambi kokulondoloza; ezinye iifomati zifuna ukulungiswa ngononophelo. Gcina iinkcukacha zobungqina ziyimfihlo.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.WorldsHelp
data.value: Ngenisa i-Java okanye i-Bedrock yehlabathi ZIP kwifolda entsha, emva koko ukhethe ukuyisebenzisa. Ihlabathi elikhoyo alizukutshintshwa. Iimpapasho aziguquki. Ukutshintsha akuphuculi, kunciphise okanye kuqinisekise ukuhambelana komdlalo / imo yehlabathi; buyela umva kuqala.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.ModsHelp
data.value: Hlola i-JAR metadata kunye nokuxhomekeka, ukulawula izongezo ezizodwa, okanye ukujonga iphakheji yeseva epheleleyo. Sebenzisa inguqulelo yemidlalo echanekileyo yepakethi kunye nokwakhiwa komthwalo. Uhlolisiso lokuhambelana lucebisa kwaye aluqinisekisi ukuba ikhowudi ikhuselekile okanye ukuba yonke imodeli iya kusebenza.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.BackupsHelp
data.value: I-backups epheleleyo ibandakanya ifolda yeserver, imihlaba, izongezo, kunye nokulungelelaniswa. Beka umncedisi kuqala. Qinisekisa ingqibelelo yakho ngaphambi kokuba uyibuyisele. Ukubuyisela kuthatha indawo yeefayile zeseva; iirekhodi ziqinisekisa ingqibelelo ye-archive, hayi ukuba isipele siqukethe ingxaki esele ikhona.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.RecoveryHelp
data.value: Naluphi na utshintsho lomxholo lugcina iifayile zangaphambili kunye nee-hashes. Khetha utshintsho olusetyenzisiweyo okanye oluphazamisekileyo ukuze ulufumane. Khawucombulule utshintsho olutsha olungafaniyo kuqala. Iifayile ezilungiswe ngaphandle kunye nehlabathi elisebenzayo elithunyelweyo likhuselwe. Gcina isicwangciso esipheleleyo sokuphucula ixesha lokuqhuba / ihlabathi.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.DiagnosticsHelp
data.value: Khangela iingxaki eziqhelekileyo kwilogi yakutshanje yomncedisi nakwingxelo yokugqibela yokungcola. Izinto ezifunyanisiweyo ziingcebiso, kungekhona izizathu eziqinisekisiweyo. Inkqubo CPU/RAM ayikho i-Minecraft TPS/MSPT; Sebenzisa iprofayili ehambelanayo kwi-server xa kuxilongwa ukusebenza kwe-tick.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.ConfirmStop
data.value: Ngaba le nkonzo kufuneka igqitywe yiSynix?

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.ConfirmRestart
data.value: Qalisa kwakhona le nkonzo ngeSynix ngoku?

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.RuntimeNotice
data.value: Ukufaka inguqulelo yomdlalo ekhethiweyo, ukulayisha, nokwakha kwimithombo yabo esemthethweni? Oku kunokukhuphela i-Java kwaye uqhube umfakisi osemthethweni we-Forge / NeoForge. Iifayile zeseva ziqhutywa kuqala; iifayile zangaphambili ezibuyiselweyo zigcinwa ukuze zilungiswe. Ihlabathi kunye nezongezo zigcinwe. Yenza isicatshulwa esipheleleyo ngaphambi kokuba utshintshe iinguqulelo zomdlalo. Akukho nkonzo yomdlalo iqalisiweyo.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.ConfirmPlayer
data.value: Ukuthumela umyalelo womdlali okhethiweyo? Ukufikelela komqhubi kunika ulawulo olubanzi kumncedisi womdlalo.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.ConfirmWorld
data.value: Sebenzisa ihlabathi elikhethiweyo ekuqaleni okulandelayo? Ihlabathi langoku lihlala likwi-disk. Khetha kuphela ihlabathi ehambelanayo le nkonzo inguqulelo, inguqulelo, kwaye mods.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.PackNotice
data.value: Ukungenisa le pakethi yomncedisi ithembekileyo? Iphakheji yeModrinth inokukhuphela iifayile ezibhekiselelwe kwimithombo yeHTTPS evunyiweyo. Iimod kunye nezicwangciso zomdlalo ziqhuba ikhowudi ngaphakathi kweseva yomdlalo. Ukucwangciswa, i-hash, ukuhambelana nokuhlolwa kwe-antivirus akuqinisekisi ukhuseleko. Qwalasela zonke iinguqulelo ngaphambi kokuba uzisebenzise.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.CompatibilityNotice
data.value: Iitsheki zifunda iimetadata ngaphandle kokulayisha ikhowudi ye-mod. Uluhlu lweenguqulelo eziyinkimbinkimbi, ukuxhomekeka okunemibandela, kunye neminye imethadatha ehlanganisiweyo / eyimfuziselo idinga ukuhlaziywa ngesandla. Ezi ziqinisekiso aziqinisekisi ukuhambelana okanye ukungabikho kwe-malware.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.BackupSpace
data.value: Jonga indawo yokugcina izinto kunye nendawo ekhoyo.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.ConfirmBackup
data.value: Ukwenza isipele esipheleleyo sale nkonzo imisiwe?

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.ConfirmRestore
data.value: Ukubuyisela i-backup epheleleyo ekhethiweyo? Iifayile ezikhoyo zeseva ziya kutshintshwa. Qinisekisa i-archive uze ugcine naziphi na iifayile ezikhoyo oza kuzifuna ngaphambi kokuba uqhubeke.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.UndoNotice
data.value: Fumana iifayile zangaphambili zolu tshintsho. Iifayile ezongezwe ngolu tshintsho ziyasuswa kuphela ukuba azitshintshanga. Iifayile ezitshintshiweyo ziyakuthintela ukubuyiswa. Isipele esipheleleyo siyadingeka ukubuyisela umva naluphi na uguqulelo lwehlabathi olwenziwe emva kokuqalisa inguqulelo yomdlalo eyahlukileyo.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.NoLogFindings
data.value: Akukho mzekelo waziwayo ufunyenwe kwiingxelo zakutshanje. Oku akusiyo ukuhlolwa ngokupheleleyo kwempilo. Sebenzisa iReadiness uze ujonge impazamo yokuqala kufutshane nexesha lokusilela.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.PreviewSummary
data.value: Ukuhlaziywa ngaphambi kokufaka isicelo: {0} entsha • {1} itshintshiwe • {2} isuswe. Iifayile zangaphambili zigcinwa ukuze zilungiswe. Akukho nkonzo iqalisiweyo.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.Error.Runtime
data.value: Ukwakhiwa kweserver esizinzileyo okufunwayo okanye imethadatha yayo yokukhuphela ayifumaneki. Vuselela ukhetho lweenguqulelo/ukwakha uze uzame kwakhona.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.Error.Size
data.value: Lo mxholo udlula umda wefayile exhaswayo, i-metadata okanye ubungakanani obupheleleyo.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.Error.Recovery
data.value: Iinkcukacha zokubuyisela zilahlekile okanye azihambelani. Gcina ifolda yokufumana kwakhona uze usebenzise isiqinisekiso esipheleleyo sokusekelayo.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.Error.PendingRecovery
data.value: Umsebenzi wangaphambili womxholo ufuna ukubuyiselwa. Vula utshintsho lokubuyisela kwimeko yesiqhelo uze ulusombulule ngaphambi kokwenza olunye utshintsho.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.Error.Changed
data.value: Ifayile etshintshileyo ukususela ekuhlaziyeni okanye ukususela kulo msebenzi. Ukuhlaziya nokuphonononga kwakhona. Akukho zihlengahlengiso ezingahambelaniyo eziya kugqitywa.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.Error.Layout
data.value: Ulungelelwaniso lwepakethi okanye indlela ayikhuselekanga, ayicacanga okanye ayixhaswanga. Khetha iphakheji ye-server exhaswayo okanye igcino lehlabathi.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.Error.ActiveWorld
data.value: Eli lihlabathi elisebenzayo elingeniswayo. Tshintshela kwelinye ihlabathi ngaphambi kokuba unciphise ukungeniswa kwalo.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.Error.WorldExists
data.value: Eli phepha lehlabathi sele likhona. Khetha igama elitsha lefolda; Ihlabathi elikhoyo alize lixhonywe kukungeniswa.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.Error.WorldLayout
data.value: Khetha i-archive equlathe ihlabathi elinye nge level.dat. I-archives epheleleyo ye-server kunye ne-multi-worlds zisebenzisa i-backup/restore workflow endaweni yoko.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.Error.WorldEdition
data.value: Eli hlabathi alihambelani nohlelo lwe-server okanye alikho ifayile yalo yephondo / yedatha ekulindelekileyo. Ihlabathi leJava neBedrock aliguquki.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.Error.WorldName
data.value: Sebenzisa igama lefolda yehlabathi elikhuselekileyo, ngaphandle kweendlela okanye amagama agciniweyo e-Windows. Kwihlabathi elingeniswayo, sebenzisa oonobumba, amanani, izithuba, amaqhosha, okanye amaphuzu angaphantsi.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.Error.JavaOnly
data.value: Le nkqubo yomsebenzi yenzelwe i-Java server mods/plugins. Sebenzisa inkqubo yokusebenza ye-Bedrock eyakhelweyo; I-Java JARs ayinakusebenza kwi-Bedrock.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.Error.PackEmpty
data.value: Akukho mxholo weserver oxhaswayo wafunyanwa. Izicwangciso zokuqalisa, iifayile zomxhasi, amaxesha okuqhuba, imihlaba, kunye nezilungiselelo zeseva yomthombo azingeniswa yinkqubo yokusebenza ye-modpack.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.Error.LoaderMismatch
data.value: Uhlobo lomxholo aluhambelani nesoftware yomncedisi ekhethiweyo. Iimodeli zifuna ukulayishwa kwemodeli ehambelanayo; Bukkit / Paper plugins kufuneka i-plugin runtime.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.Error.CurseForgeManifest
data.value: Le yincwadi yomxhasi weCurseForge, kungekhona ipakethe epheleleyo yeseva. Khuphela umncedisi womlobi i-ZIP equkethe iimodyuli ezikhoyo kunye nokulungelelaniswa; iifayile ezingafumanekiyo aziphoswa cwaka.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.Error.PackVersion
data.value: Uhlobo lwe-Minecraft lwepakethi kunye nomthwalo / ukwakhiwa kufuneka kuhambelane nale nkonzo. Khetha uze usebenzise ixesha elifanelekileyo lokuqala. Izithuthi zokulayisha ezingaxhaswanga azitshintshelwa.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.Error.DownloadSource
data.value: Umxokozelo okanye ukujikwa kwakhona akusiyo umthombo ovunyiweyo kawonke-wonke weHTTPS. Sebenzisa i-ZIP yesiphakeli sendawo esixhaswa ngumbhali endaweni yoko.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.Error.DownloadHash
data.value: Ifayile ekhutshwe ayihambelani nobungakanani bayo obuchaziweyo okanye i-hash ye-SHA-512. Akukho nto ifakiweyo.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.Error.Properties
data.value: Ixabiso le-Minecraft elisetyenziswa yi-Synix alivumelekanga okanye alivisisani. Jonga izibuko, umda womdlali, imo yomdlalo kunye nezilungiso zolawulo ngaphambi kokuba ugcine.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.Error.SaveEntry
data.value: I-Synix ayizange ikwazi ukugcina ukungena kweseva okuhlaziyiweyo. Umsebenzi awuzange wamkelwe; iifayile zokuphinda zifumaneke zigcinwe xa kuyimfuneko.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.Error.ManagementLocal
data.value: Uxhumano lolawulo lweSynix lweMinecraft kufuneka luhlala kwi-host yendawo. Musa ukutyhila le ndawo yokulawula kwi-Intanethi.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.Error.PortConflict
data.value: I-port egqityiweyo ingomnye umncedisi we-Synix. Khetha indawo eyahlukileyo ngaphambi kokuba ugcine.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.Error.Player
data.value: Khetha isenzo esixhaswayo kunye negama lomdlali elifanelekileyo. Ukuthintelwa kweJava akusiyo imiyalelo yeBedrock.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.Error.StartFailed
data.value: Umncedisi akazange aqale. Jonga Ukulungelelanisa kunye ne log yomsebenzi wedeshibhodi ngaphambi kokuzama kwakhona.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.Check.MetadataUnknown
data.value: I-metadata ayikwazanga ukufundwa ngokupheleleyo. Jonga ifayile kunye neemfuno zokuhambelana nombhali wayo.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.Check.Duplicate
data.value: Zingaphezu kweyodwa iJAR esezingeni eliphezulu eyenza le ngcaciso. Jonga uze ususe ingxelo ephindwe kabini.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.Check.ClientOnly
data.value: Le JAR izibhengeza njengomthengi kuphela. Musa ukuyifaka kumncedisi ozinikeleyo.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.Check.WrongLoader
data.value: I-metadata yale JAR ayihambelani nomthwali/isoftware ekhethiweyo.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.Check.DependencyMissing
data.value: Ukuxhomekeka okufunekayo akufumaneki kwi-metadata ekhutshwe: {0}. Jonga ukuxhomekeka okuhlanganisiweyo okanye okunemibandela ngaphambi kokufaka nantoni na.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.Check.DependencyReview
data.value: Ukujonga ngokuzenzekelayo ukuxhomekeka kwe-{0}: kufuneka i-{1}, i-{2} ihlolwe. Eli nqanaba/inguqulelo ayiqondwa ngokupheleleyo.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.Log.Java
data.value: I-log ibonisa ukungalingani kwe-Java/class-version. Sebenzisa inguqulelo ye-Java efunwa ngumncedisi okhethiweyo kunye nomthumeli we-mod.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.Log.Memory
data.value: I-log ibonisa ukuba i-Java ayikwazi ukuhambisa imemori eyaneleyo. Jonga i-RAM ekhoyo, umda weseva, nokuba ngaba ezinye iiseva ziyayisebenzisa.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.Log.Dependency
data.value: I-log ikhankanya iimfuno zokuncika. Hlola impazamo yokuqala yokulayisha, uze ukhangele imodeli echanekileyo, ukuxhomekeka, inguqulelo yomdlalo kunye nokwakhiwa komthwalo.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.Log.Port
data.value: Ingxelo ibonisa ukuba izibuko sele lisetyenziswa. Jonga ezinye iinkqubo kunye nezibuko ezilungiselelwe le nkonzo; musa ukuvula izibuko zomlilo ezingahambelaniyo.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.Log.Eula
data.value: I-log icela ukwamkelwa kweMinecraft EULA. Funda uze uyamkele kwinkqubo eqhelekileyo yokuqalisa umsebenzi ukuba uyavuma.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.Log.Tick
data.value: Iilebhile zibika ukuhla kweenkomo okanye ixesha lokulinda. Jonga umthwalo weCPU, ukuveliswa kwehlabathi, izidalwa, kunye neemodyuli. Ukongeza i-RAM yodwa kusenokungayi kusombulula le ngxaki.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.Log.Mixin
data.value: Impazamo ye-mixin idla ngokubandakanya indibaniselwano engavumelaniyo ye-mod/loader. Jonga unobangela wokuqala kwingxelo yengozi kunye neenguqulelo ezifunekayo zepakethe.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.Log.World
data.value: I-log ibika iimpazamo zokufunda idatha yehlabathi. Yima umncedisi uze ugcine iifayile ezikhoyo ngaphambi kokuba uzame ukuqinisekisa i-backup ehambelanayo.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.Error.RuntimeRecovery
data.value: Esi sixhobo sakudala asinalo uprofayili wokusebenza obhaliweyo. Sebenzisa isipele esipheleleyo somncedisi ukuze uyibuyisele; I-Synix ayiyi kucinga ngomthwalo wayo wangaphambili kunye nenguqulelo.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.Error.RuntimeMismatch
data.value: Ixesha lokuqalisa elifakelweyo alihambelani nohlobo olukhethiweyo, inguqulelo, umthwalo okanye imfuneko ye-Java. Vula iZiko loLawulo leMinecraft uze usebenzise iApply Runtime ngaphambi kokuqalisa.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.Error.InvalidValue
data.value: Ixabiso le{0} alivumelekanga. Lungisa le setting ngaphambi kokuba ugcine.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.Empty
data.value: Azikho izinto zokubonisa. Ukuhlaziya emva kokongeza umxholo okanye ukutshintsha ukusekwa kwale nkonzo.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.CompatibilitySummary
data.value: {0} add-ons ezichongiweyo • Iziphumo ze{1} eziza kuhlaziywa. Le ngxelo ayitshintshi iifayile.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.NoCompatibilityAddOns
data.value: Akukho zongezo zifunyenweyo kwifolda ye-mods esebenzayo okanye ii-plugins zokucwangcisa le nkonzo.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.NoCompatibilityFindings
data.value: Akukho ngxaki zifunyenwe kwiimethadatha ezikhoyo. Oku akuqinisekisi ukuba yonke imodeli okanye iplagi iya kusebenza kunye.

data.name: AsaPackages.Help
data.value: Khetha i-ZIP ye-ASA Windows-server ekhutshwe okanye ifolda ekhutshwe kuyo. I-Synix ifumana izichazi ze-mod ngaphakathi kwiiphakheji ezithe tyaba, ezipakishwe okanye ezininzi kwaye zilungiselela ii-ID zazo ze-CurseForge ukuze zihlolwe. Iifayile ze-ZIP azikhutshelwa okanye zifakwe. I-ASA ikhuphela kwaye ibhalise ukwakhiwa kweseva yangoku yomnikezeli xa uqalisa iseva; le nto ayithethi nge-ZIP.

data.name: AsaPackages.Choose
data.value: Khetha i-ZIP okanye ifolda oza kuyihlola. Akukho zilungiselelo okanye iifayile zomncedisi ziya kutshintsha de ujonge ngokwahlukeneyo kwaye ugcine uluhlu lwe-ID ye-mod.

data.name: AsaPackages.Trust
data.value: Iipakethe ze-metadata azithembekanga. Ukutyhilwa akufani nokuhlolwa kwe-malware, ukuhlolwa kokuhambelana, okanye ubungqina bobunikazi bomshicileli.

data.name: AsaPackages.Reading
data.value: Ukufunda imethadata yepakethe. Akukho khowudi ye-mod isetyenzisiweyo.

data.name: AsaPackages.Found
data.value: {0} mods ezichaziweyo; I-{1} izikhombisi ezintsha eziza kongezelelwa. Amaxwebhu akhoyo agcina umyalelo wawo. Jonga uluhlu olupheleleyo ngaphambi kokuba ulondoloze.

data.name: AsaPackages.Timeout
data.value: Ukuhlolwa kwephakheji kwacinywa okanye kwathatha ixesha elininzi. Khetha ifolda yepakethe encinane uze uzame kwakhona.

data.name: AsaPackages.Error.Source
data.value: Khetha i-ARK server mod ZIP okanye ifolda ye-mod ekhutshwe. Ezinye iifomathi zovavanyo azixhaswa yile mfundi.

data.name: AsaPackages.Error.Limit
data.value: Iphakheji idlula imida yomfundi we-metadata. Khetha ifolda encinci okanye i-ZIP eneenkcazo ze-100 mod.

data.name: AsaPackages.Error.Layout
data.value: Iphakheji iqulethe iindlela ezingakhuselekanga, amakhonkco, iindlela eziphindaphindiweyo, iifayile eziphikisanayo, okanye iifolda ezininzi kakhulu. Akukho nto yatshintshileyo.

data.name: AsaPackages.Error.Descriptor
data.value: Akukho .uplugin mod descriptor yafunyanwa. Khetha i-mod ZIP okanye ifolda yayo ekhutshwe; kufuneka zifunyanwe kuqala iirekhodi ezibekwe ezindlwini.

data.name: AsaPackages.Error.Metadata
data.value: I-mod descriptor ayivumelekanga, ayicacanga JSON. Akukho nto yatshintshileyo.

data.name: AsaPackages.Error.Game
data.value: Isichazi asichazi iprojekthi yeARK: Survival Ascended CurseForge. I-Synix ayiyi kucinga umdlalo okanye isazisi semodeli.

data.name: AsaPackages.Error.Id
data.value: I-descriptor ayinayo i-ID yeprojekthi enye esebenzayo ye-CurseForge (cf_ugcID). Sebenzisa i-Manage Mod IDs kunye ne-ID evela kwiphepha le-CurseForge lomlobi.

data.name: AsaPackages.Error.ServerBuild
data.value: Imod ayinayo iphakheji yeWindowsServer eyaziwayo okanye ilahlekile ifayile ehambelanayo .ucas/.utoc. Khetha ukulayishwa kweseva yeWindows, hayi ukwakha umxhasi.

data.name: AsaPackages.Error.DuplicateMod
data.value: Iphakheji iqulethe iinkcukacha ezingaphezulu kweyodwa ze-ID yemodeli enye. Khetha enye inguqulelo ye mod nganye uze uphinde uyihlolisise.

data.name: AsePackages.Help
data.value: Khetha i-ARK: Survival Evolved mod ZIP okanye ifolda equlathe .mod descriptor kunye nefolda yayo yokupheka ehambelana nayo. I-Synix ifunda i-Workshop ID kwi-descriptor, hayi igama le-ZIP. Iifayile azikhutshelwa okanye zifakelwe: emva kokuhlolwa, i-Synix ihlaziya i-ActiveMods kunye ne-ModIDS yendlela yokukhuphela ngokuzenzekelayo ye-ARK. Iimephu kunye nokuguqulwa okupheleleyo kunokufuna ukucwangciswa kweserver eyahlukileyo. Iiphakheji ze-ASA CurseForge azihambelani.

data.name: AsePackages.Error.Layout
data.value: Oku akusiyo imodeli ye-ASE egqibeleleyo eyaziwayo yokuthumela ngaphandle. Faka i- .mod descriptor kunye nefolda ye-mod ehambelana ne-mod.info kunye nezixhobo eziphekiweyo. I-ID edibeneyo kufuneka ihambelane nalo naluphi na igama lefayile ye-descriptor yamanani. Ukukhuphela i-Raw Workshop .z ngaphandle kwefayile elungiselelwe .mod akuxhaswa yile mfundi; Sebenzisa i-Manage Mod IDs endaweni yoko.

data.name: ArkPackages.Error.WrongEdition
data.value: Le phakheji iqulethe isalathiso sonye uhlelo lwe-ARK. I-ASE Steam Workshop mods kunye ne-ASA CurseForge mods azifani. Khetha iphakheji kwiseva ekhethiweyo.

data.name: UniversalMods.Locations.Help
data.value: Cwangcisa ifolda ye-mod okanye i-plugin uze wamkele iintlobo eziphambili zeefayile usebenzisa imiyalelo yale game okanye loader. Oku kusebenza kuphela kule nkonzo. Khetha indawo ekhoyo ukuze uyihlaziye; Akukho fayile ye-mod iguqulweyo apha.

data.name: UniversalMods.Locations.Warning
data.value: Ukungeniswa kwefayile akufakanga i-loader okanye ii-mods ezilawulwa ngumboneleli wobhaliso. Jonga imiyalelo yokufakelwa komdlalo.

data.name: UniversalMods.Locations.Ready
data.value: Ukungenisa iifayile ezenziwe ngokwezifiso ?? Ukuhlolwa kweemfuno zokuhambelana

data.name: UniversalMods.Locations.Start
data.value: Sebenzisa iindawo zokungenisa ukuseta ifolda ye-mod okanye i-plugin yale nkonzo. Ukungenisa iifayile akubonisi ukuba umdlalo unokuzilayisha.

data.name: UniversalMods.Import.Help
data.value: Khetha ifolda ngaphakathi kwepakethe enomxholo wayo kwindawo ekhethiweyo yomncedisi. Iifolda ezisezantsi zigcinwe. Ungasusa i-wrappers yokukhuphela ngokukhetha ifolda enzulu. Kuphela ziifayile ezidwelisiweyo eziza kungeniswa; iifayile ezikhoyo zifumana iikopi zokubuyisela. Oku akuguquleli ii-mods ezingahambelaniyo.

data.name: UniversalMods.Import.Reading
data.value: Ukufunda iphakheji nokulungiselela ukubonwa kwangaphambili kwendawo oya kuyo...

data.name: UniversalMods.Import.Summary
data.value: Iifayile ze{0} ezikhethiweyo; Iifayile ezikhoyo ze-{1} ziya kugcinwa ngaphambi kokutshintshwa. Akukho nto ifakiweyo de kuqinisekiswe oku kulandelayo.

data.name: UniversalMods.Error.InvalidLocations
data.value: Iindawo zokungenisa ezigciniweyo azivumelekanga okanye zivela kumdlalo womncedisi ohlukileyo. Akukho fayile yatshintshwa.

data.name: UniversalMods.Error.InstallFolder
data.value: Faka le nkonzo ngaphambi kokulungisa iindawo zokungenisa zasekuhlaleni.

data.name: UniversalMods.Error.LocationLimit
data.value: Umncedisi unokuba neendawo zokungenisa ezenziwe ngokwezifiso ze32.

data.name: UniversalMods.Error.LocationName
data.value: Faka igama lendawo yeempawu ze1–80 uze ukhethe iMod okanye iPlugin.

data.name: UniversalMods.Error.Extensions
data.value: Faka izandiso zefayile eziphambili ze-1–32, kubandakanywa amachaphaza azo, njenge .dll okanye .pak. Iinkqubo zokufakela kunye neenkqubo zemiyalelo aziwamkelwanga.

data.name: UniversalMods.Error.Collision
data.value: Iphakheji inengxaki yefayile/ifolda. Khetha iphakheji epheleleyo, engathethi nto.

data.name: UniversalMods.Error.NoFiles
data.value: Ifolda yepakethe ekhethiweyo ayinazo iintlobo eziphambili zefayile kule ndawo. Khetha enye ifolda yomxholo okanye ujonge iintlobo ezamkelekileyo zendawo.

data.name: UniversalMods.Error.PackageRoot
data.value: Khetha ifolda esebenzayo ngaphakathi kwiphakheji. Iindlela ezingaphandle kwephakheji azamkelekanga.

data.name: UniversalMods.Import.Done
data.value: Iifayile ezithunyelweyo. Kwakugcinwa iikopi zokubuyiselwa ukuze kufakwe iifayile ezitshintshiweyo. Jonga imfuneko yokulayisha nokwenza lo mdlalo ngaphambi kokuba uqalise. Alikho iseva elaqaliswa.

data.name: UniversalMods.Import.Rollback
data.value: Ukubuyisela yonke iphakheji engenisiweyo "{0}" (ifayile ze-{1})? Oku kubuyisela iifayile zayo zangaphambili kwaye kususa iifayile ezongezwe yiphakheji. Oku kuchaphazela yonke impahla, kungekhona kuphela ifayile ekhethiweyo.

data.name: UniversalMods.Wizard.Help
data.value: Khetha i-ZIP, ifayile ye-mod ekhutshelweyo okanye ifolda ekhutshwe kuyo. I-Synix ifunda iphakheji ye-{0} kwaye ibonisa indlela eya kongezelelwa ngayo ngaphambi kokutshintsha nantoni na.

data.name: UniversalMods.Wizard.Empty
data.value: Qala ngokukhetha i-ZIP okanye ifolda oyikhuphileyo. Akunyanzelekanga ukuba ulungiselele iindawo zokungenisa kuqala.

data.name: UniversalMods.Wizard.DestinationHelp
data.value: Khetha ifolda ye-mod ngaphakathi kwale nkonzo, ulandele imiyalelo yofakelo lomdlalo.

data.name: UniversalMods.Wizard.Reading
data.value: Ukufunda iphakheji nokujonga ulungelelwaniso lwayo... akukho fayile yomncedisi iyatshintshwa.

data.name: UniversalMods.Wizard.Unknown
data.value: Funda iifayile ze{0}. I-Synix ayizange ikwazi ukuchonga indawo yokuya kulo mdlalo. Khetha ifolda mod yomncedisi; iintlobo zeefayile zizaliswa ngokuzenzekelayo. Musa ukuqikelela ifolda.

data.name: UniversalMods.Wizard.Ambiguous
data.value: Funda iifayile ze{0}. Iindawo ezingaphezulu kweyodwa zisenokulungelelaniswa. Khetha i-mod okanye inkqubo ye-plugin ehambelana nayo apha ngasentla ukuze uyijonge kwangaphambili.

data.name: UniversalMods.Wizard.Cancelled
data.value: Ukufundwa kwepakethe kukhanselwe. Akukho nto ingeniswayo.

data.name: UniversalMods.Wizard.ProviderDetails
UniversalMods.Wizard.ProviderWarning
data.value: Ndafumanisa ii-ID ze-{0}. Emva koko, khangela uluhlu lweempawu ezichaziweyo. I-ARK ikhuphela ii-mods ekuqaliseni kwayo okulandelayo; oku akusiyo ifayile yendawo yokulayisha. Akukho nkonzo iqala ngokuzenzekelayo.

data.name: UniversalMods.Wizard.LoaderMissing
data.value: Le phakheji idinga umthwalo weserver ofanayo. Cwangcisa i-loader kwizilungiselelo zeseva, uze uphinde uvule ukungenisa. Iifayile azizange zitshintshwe.

data.name: UniversalMods.Wizard.Summary
data.value: Iifayile ze-{0} ziya kungeniswa; Iifayile ezikhoyo ze-{1} ziya kugcinwa ngaphambi kokutshintshwa. Jonga ezi ndawo zilandelayo. Akukho nkonzo iqala ngokuzenzekelayo.

data.name: UniversalMods.Wizard.ManualWarning
data.value: Iifayile ziya kukhutshelwa kwi{0}. Jonga isivakalisi sangaphambili kunye nemiyalelo yomdlalo: ukukhetha ifolda akuyi kufaka umthwali okanye kusebenze iimodyuli ezilawulwa ngumboneleli. Le ndawo iya kukhunjulwa kuphela emva kokuqinisekiswa.

data.name: ModSupport.ImportRules
data.value: I-Synix inemithetho yokungenisa kulo mdlalo. Iphakheji kufuneka ihambelane nomthwali ofakiweyo, inguqulelo yeserver kunye nokuxhomekeka.

data.name: ModSupport.ManualSetup
data.value: Akukho mthetho wokufakela ngokuzenzekelayo okhoyo kulo mdlalo. Funda indlela engezantsi ngaphambi kokuba ukhethe indawo oya kuyo; iifayile zinokufuna ukucwangciswa kuseto okanye kumboneleli.

data.name: ModSupport.EvidenceNote
data.value: Inkxaso eqinisekisiweyo ayisiyo uvavanyo lokuhambelana kweseva ebukhoma. I-mods yomncedisi, i-mods yomxhasi kunye ne-loader installer zihlukile. Akukho nto ikhutshwe, ifakwe okanye iqaliswe kwesi sikhokelo.

data.name: ModSupport.UnverifiedNote
data.value: Akukho ndlela inokuthenjwa yokufakela umncedisi-ngqo iye yaqinisekiswa okwangoku. Oku akuthethi ukuba lo mdlalo awunakulinganiswa. Khetha i-ZIP okanye ifolda ukuze uyihlole, emva koko sebenzisa imiyalelo yesiphakeli somlobi ukuqinisekisa indawo ekuyiwa kuyo kunye nokusebenza.

data.name: ModSupport.GuidedImport
data.value: Iindlela zokusebenza ze-server mod zichazwe. Sebenzisa inkxaso yeMod & Setup ukuze ufumane imiyalelo yokuqalisa, emva koko ungenise i-ZIP / ifolda ukujonga iphakheji yakho.

data.name: ModSupport.UnverifiedImport
data.value: Khetha Import ZIP / ifolda ukuhlola iphakheji. Ukuqinisekiswa kweemfuno zenkxaso yeseva; Inkxaso yeMod & Setup icacisa imida.

data.name: ModSupport.InvalidCatalog
data.value: Ikhathalogu yokuxhaswa kweemod zemidlalo ayikwazanga ukufundwa. Hlola ukuba ufakelo lwakho lweSynix lugqityiwe.

data.name: Configuration.Sync.Changed
data.value: Olu hlengahlengiso lutshintshile ukususela ekuvulweni kwalo. Livule kwakhona ngaphambi kokuba ulondoloze.

data.name: Configuration.Sync.SaveEntry
data.value: I-Synix yokungena kwiseva ayinakugcinwa. Ukucwangciswa nokusekwa kweseva kuye kwabuyiselwa.

data.name: Configuration.Sync.Ambiguous
data.value: Isicwangciso esabelwana ngaso "{0}" sinexabiso eliphindaphindiweyo okanye eliphikisayo. Zisombulule ngaphambi kokuba ugcine ukuze i-Synix ikwazi ukuhlaziya ixabiso lomncedisi elifanelekileyo.

data.name: Configuration.Sync.InvalidValue
data.value: Isicwangciso esabelwana ngaso "{0}" sinentsingiselo engavumelekanga kwi-Synix. Lilungise ngaphambi kokuba ulondoloze.

data.name: Configuration.Sync.RollbackFailed
data.value: Ukugcinwa kwahluleka kwaye ulungelelwaniso lokuqala alukwazanga ukubuyiselwa ngokuzenzekelayo. Musa ukuqala umncedisi de uphonononge ulungelelwaniso kunye nokugcinwa kwayo: {0}

data.name: ModInstallGuide.PendingCompatibility
data.value: Khetha iphakheji kunye nendawo ehambelana nayo ukuze ubone ukuba yintoni enokuqinisekiswa yiSynix.

data.name: ModInstallGuide.PendingDestination
data.value: Akukho ndawo ikhethiweyo. Akukho fayile yomncedisi okanye izilungiso zitshintshiwe.

data.name: ModInstallGuide.PendingActivation
data.value: Ukungenisa akunakuqala umncedisi ngokuzenzekelayo. Ukusebenza kuxhomekeke kumdlalo okhethiweyo kunye nenkqubo ye-mod.

data.name: ModInstallGuide.PendingRecovery
data.value: Qinisekisa umncedisi kunye nehlabathi ngaphambi kokuba usebenzise iimodyuli ezintsha. Indlela ekhethiweyo iya kuchaza oko kunokwenziwa.

data.name: ModInstallGuide.LayoutRecognized
data.value: Indlela yokubeka/yokulayisha iyaziwa. Iinguqulelo zemidlalo, ukuxhomekeka kunye neemfuno zomthengi aziqinisekiswanga ngokupheleleyo apha; khangela iimfuno zombhali.

data.name: ModInstallGuide.ManualCompatibility
data.value: Ukuhambelana kwendawo ekuyiwa kuyo ngesandla akuqinisekiswanga. Ulwandiso lwefayile ehambelanayo alubonisi ukuba le mod iyasebenza kulo mdlalo okanye umthwali.

data.name: ModInstallGuide.LoaderMissing
data.value: Ukungenisa akuvumelekanga: akukho mthwalo ofanelekileyo okanye iphakheji ayihambelani nomthwalo okhethiweyo. Jonga izilungiselelo zeseva kunye nenkxaso yeMod kunye nokuseta.

data.name: ModInstallGuide.ProviderCompatibility
data.value: I-ID yomboneleli kuphela. Iinguqulelo ze-mod, ukuxhomekeka kunye nokuhambelana kweqonga akuqinisekiswa. Qinisekisa ukuba umboneleli ngamnye uxhasa le nkonzo.

data.name: ModInstallGuide.ProviderDestination
data.value: I-Synix igcina uluhlu lwe-ID ye-{0}, hayi iifayile ze-ZIP. Umdlalo / umboneleli ulawula indawo yokukhuphela.

data.name: ModInstallGuide.FileChanges
data.value: iifayile ze-{0} kwisicwangciso; Iifayile ezikhoyo ze-{1} ziya kugcinwa ngaphambi kokutshintshwa.

data.name: ModInstallGuide.FilePreview
data.value: Khetha ifayile ekhohlo ukuze ufumane indawo yayo epheleleyo. Akukho nto ikhutshelweyo de kuqinisekiswe ukuhlaziywa okulandelayo.

data.name: ModInstallGuide.ProviderActivation
data.value: Gcina ii-ID ezicetywayo, emva koko uqalise umncedisi ngokwakho uze ujonge ilog yayo yokukhuphela / yokuqalisa. I-ZIP ekhethiweyo ayifaki inguqulelo ekhutshwe ngumdlalo / umboneleli.

data.name: ModInstallGuide.ManualActivation
data.value: Ukukopisha iifayile akufakanga umthwalo okanye ubhalise / unike amandla i-mod. Landela iMod support & setup kunye nemiyalelo yeserver yombhali, emva koko uqalise iseva ngokwakho kwaye ujonge ilog yayo.

data.name: ModInstallGuide.ScenarioActivation
data.value: Ukungenisa akuguquli ihlabathi elisebenzayo. Sebenzisa Khetha iScenario ukukhetha le meko kunye nokugcina ngaphambi kokuqalisa. Ukugcinwa okhoyo akuguqulwa ngokuzenzekelayo.

data.name: ModInstallGuide.FileActivation
data.value: Umthwali/inkqubo ekhethiweyo ifunda iifayile ezingenisiweyo xa uqalisa umncedisi. Gqibezela imimiselo eyongezelelweyo yombhali kunye neemfuno zomxhasi kuqala, emva koko khangela ilog yokuqalisa. Synix ayiqalisi umncedisi.

data.name: ModInstallGuide.FileRecovery
data.value: Misa umncedisi, khetha into engenisiweyo uze usebenzise Roll Back Import. Oku kubuyisela iifayile ezibuyiselweyo kwaye kususa iifayile ezintsha kwelo khowudi; ukuhlela kamva kunokuthintela ukubuyela umva. Ayilubuyiseli utshintsho lwehlabathi. Yenza i-backup epheleleyo ngaphambi kokuba uqale.

data.name: ModInstallGuide.ProviderRecovery
data.value: Misa umncedisi uze uhlele uluhlu lwe-ID ukuze ususe izongezo okanye ubuyisele umyalelo wayo wangaphambili. Oku akucimi iifayile zomboneleli okanye kubuyisele iinguqulelo ezindala ze-mod / idatha yehlabathi. Gcina uludwe lwangaphambili lwesazisi kunye nesicatshulwa esipheleleyo somncedisi ngaphambi kokuba uqale.

data.name: ModInstallGuide.ScenarioRecovery
data.value: Iscenario esebenzayo okanye ukonga okhoyo kunokuthintela ukususwa.

data.name: Backup.Retention.Warning
data.value: I-backup entsha igcinwe, kodwa ukucoca i-backup kufuna ingqalelo ye-{0}: {1}

data.name: Backup.Creation.Failed
data.value: Amaqela okuxhasa awazange agqibe. Qwalasela i-Activity & Diagnostics ngesizathu ngaphambi kokuqhubeka.

data.name: ServerStart.Maintenance.BackupFailed
data.value: Ukuqalisa kukhanselwe: isiqinisekiso esiceliweyo asizange sigqitywe. Akukho kuhlaziywa okanye ukuqaliswa kweseva okwenziweyo. Jonga impazamo yokulondoloza uze uzame kwakhona.

data.name: ServerStart.Maintenance.UpdateFailed
data.value: Ukuqalisa ukuqala: uhlaziyo olufunwayo aluzange lugqitywe. Umncedisi uhlala emile. Hlola impazamo yohlaziyo ngaphambi kokuba uzame kwakhona.

data.name: ServerActions.Operation.RequiresStopped
data.value: Yimisa umncedisi uze uqinisekise ukuba iinkqubo zayo ziphumile ngaphambi kokuhlaziya okanye ukuqinisekisa iifayile zayo.

data.name: Backup.Error.CustomFolderUnavailable
data.value: Ifolda ekhethiweyo ye-backup ayifumaneki. Qhagamshela kwakhona okanye ukhethe enye ifolda yokusekelayo. I-Synix ayiyi kusebenzisa indawo eyahlukileyo.

data.name: Configuration.Sync.TooLarge
data.value: Ulungelelwaniso olubuyiselweyo lukhulu kakhulu ukuba lungavumelaniswa ngokukhuselekileyo. Jonga ifayile ngaphambi kokuba uqalise umncedisi.

data.name: Backup.Progress.Synchronizing
data.value: Ukuhlaziya izilungiselelo zeSynix ukusuka kulungelelwaniso olubuyiselweyo...

data.name: Backup.Restore.SettingsPending
data.value: Iifayile ezikhuselekileyo zibuyiselwe, kodwa i-Synix ayizange ikwazi ukugqiba ukuhlaziya useto lweseva yayo. Iifayile zokubuyisela ziye zagcinwa. Lungisa ingxaki uze uzame kwakhona Qalisa; Ukuqalisa kuhlala kuvaliwe de ukuvumelanisa kuphumelele. Iinkcukacha: {0}

data.name: Backup.Error.RestartForRecovery
data.value: Ukubuyiselwa kwangaphambili kwaphazamiseka. Qalisa kwakhona i-Synix ukuze uyibuyisele ngaphambi kokuqalisa okanye ukubuyisela le nkonzo.

data.name: Backup.Restore.PreviousPending
data.value: Ukubuyiselwa kwangaphambili kusafuna ingqalelo. Le nkqubo yokubuyisela ayiqalanga. Iinkcukacha: {0}

data.name: Language.PreviewNotice
data.value: Ukuqwalasela kwangaphambili: Ulawulo oluphambili luye lwaguqulelwa. Olunye uncedo nokuxilongwa kusekho ngesiNgesi.

data.name: GameText.Introduction
data.value: I-Synix yamkela umbhalo wamazwe ngamazwe. Indawo nganye engezantsi inemeko yayo yobungqina; inkxaso kwisihloko ayingqina inkxaso yephasiwedi. Ukungaqinisekiswanga akuthethi ukuba akuxhaswanga kwaye akubeki mthetho wesiNgesi kuphela. Uxwebhu alukho uvavanyo lwangempela lwentlobo nganye yomdlalo, ifonti yomxhasi okanye indlela yokungenisa.

data.name: GameText.SafetyNote
data.value: Gcina amaphasiwedi ngokuchanekileyo njengoko efakiweyo: oonobumba abafanayo ngokokubonakalayo banokuba neenkqubo ezahlukeneyo zokubhala. Imida yokudlala ekhoyo kunye nezikhuseli ezivaliweyo zisasebenza. Amathokheni okuqinisekisa, ii-ID, amagama eefolda kunye namagama omsebenzisi womdlali anemithetho eyahlukileyo.

data.name: GameText.UnverifiedNote
data.value: Uphando olwenziwa kwi-Intanethi aluzange lubonise inkxaso yamazwe ngamazwe kweli candelo. Jonga uxwebhu olukhoyo lomdlalo uze uvavanye abalinganiswa abachanekileyo ngaphambi kokuba uthembele kubo. Umhlaba okhubazekileyo kwi-Synix awufanele ungabikho kumdlalo.

data.name: GameText.InvalidUnicode
data.value: I-{0} iqulethe uphawu olungaphelelanga lwe-Unicode. Phinda ungene; I-Synix ayizukutshintsha iphasiwedi okanye oonobumba begama ngokuthula.

data.name: Content.007253C01F3D240BCA85
data.value: I-Euro Truck Simulator 2 kufuneka ithumele iimephu zayo, i-DLC, kunye neefayile zepakethe ye-mod kumdlalo oqhelekileyo ngaphambi kokuba iserver ezinikezelweyo iqale. Landela amanyathelo okuseta aboniswe; I-Synix izakungenisa iifayile ezivelisiweyo kule nkonzo.

data.name: Content.00DEEBB0AC0CF305D39F
data.value: Kukho iimodyuli zekhowudi yecala lomncedisi, kuquka imodyuli yesitokhwe esabiweyo somphuhlisi. Ukucwangciswa kwepakethe, ukuxhomekeka kunye nokusebenza kwehlabathi kuxhomekeke kwinguqulelo yomdlalo / imowudi; akukho ndawo ye-DLL eqhelekileyo icetywayo.

data.name: Content.027ABB3BADA8C0B33854
data.value: Khetha iimodyuli zokulungiswa kwehlabathi/iserver kunokuba ukope i-ZIP eqhelekileyo. I-Steam kunye ne-crosssplay/mod.io iyahluka. I-plugins yomncedisi idinga ukusetyenziswa kweserver ngokuchanekileyo kunye nokwakhiwa kwe-plugin.

data.name: Content.02F77AA927B80C70293F
data.value:
I-Critical SETUP Ifunekayo:
1. Qalisa umncedisi kube kanye ukuze uvelise 'PCServer-UDKGame.ini', uze uyicime.
2. Hlela ifayile ukuze ulawule ukujikeleza kwemephu kunye nemithetho yomonakalo weqela.
3. Uxwebhu olusemthethweni: https://chivalrythegame.com/

data.name: Content.03C3E5851F1A6D5D93B8
data.value: I-Java ine rcon.password; I-Bedrock ayinayo i-Java RCON yokugqibela eyakhelweyo. Inkxaso yocwangciso lwe-UTF-8 ayibeki ukuphatha oonobumba beklayenti nganye ye-RCON. Qinisekisa umncedisi kunye nomxhasi.

data.name: Content.04306C6DCC8E032536F2
data.value: Gcina iphakheji nganye yomxholo kunye nefilelist.xml kunye kwaye unike amandla iipakethe kulungelelwaniso lweseva. Iinkcukacha ezishicilelweyo zesikhokelo zifakwe kwiiflegi ezixhomekeke kwinguqulelo; ukuqinisekisa iindlela ezikhoyo.

data.name: Content.046758F1CA21BD9F666A
data.value:
Sebenzisa esi sikhokelo ukudala umncedisi wakho wokuqala. I-Synix iyasebenza kule PC, ngoko yiyeke ikhompyutha ivuliwe ngoxa abantu bedlala. Akunyanzelekanga ukuba ubhale umyalelo wokuqalisa ukuze usete ngokusesikweni.
1. Vula i-Synix uze uvumele ukuhlolwa kokuxhomekeka kwe-SteamCMD kugqitywe. 2. Khetha Add Server, uze wenze umncedisi omtsha. Ukuba iifayile zeseva sele zikho, khetha ukungenisa iseva ekhoyo endaweni yoko. 3. KwiGeneral, faka igama lomncedisi elikhethekileyo uze ukhethe umdlalo. Khetha uhlelo, inguqulelo yomdlalo okanye umlayishi ukuba ezi zikhetho ziyavela. 4. Gcina amaxabiso acetyiswayo ngaphandle kokuba ufuna into eyahlukileyo. Jonga amaphepha okuseta avumelekileyo uze usombulule umyalezo ofanelekileyo wokuseta emazantsi. 5. Khetha i-Save Server. Oku kwongeza isithuba kwideshibhodi; oko akuthethi ukuba umdlalo ugqityiwe ukufakwa. 6. Khetha eli nqaku uze ukhethe Qalisa. Vumela ukukhuphela nokulungiselela ukuqala kuqala kugqitywe, ulandele naziphi na izicelo eziboniswa yiSynix. 7. Gqibezela naluphi na useto olunikwe ngumdlalo, njengesivumelwano, ukungena kwiakhawunti, okanye ukudala iseshoni kumlawuli weseva yomdlalo. 8. Qhagamshela kule khompyutha okanye kwenye isixhobo kwinethiwekhi yakho yasekhaya. Xa oko kusebenza, yenza isipele ngaphambi kokuba ungeze ii-mods okanye wenze utshintsho olukhulu.
Ukuba Uyakhubeka Vula Ukulungelelanisa kwiseva ekhethiweyo uze ufunde Umsebenzi & Diagnostics. Landela impazamo ethile endaweni yokuchofoza ngokuphindaphindiweyo kuQala. Kwi-Minecraft okanye kwi-Satisfactory, udidi lwezikhokelo zemidlalo luchaza amanyathelo ongezelelweyo.
Ukubamba abantu ngaphandle kwenethiwekhi yakho linyathelo elahlukileyo lenethiwekhi. Qala uqinisekise ukuba umncedisi usebenza kwindawo.

data.name: Content.04A9AB215D19FA573345
data.value:
Uluhlu ngalunye lwebhodi yedashboard kufuneka lube negama kunye nefolda yokufakela. I-Synix iguqula igama lomncedisi libe yi-Windows-ikhuselekileyo yokuchonga iifolda ezixhaswayo kunye nezilungiselelo zokuqalisa. Oku kugcina iziganeko zahlukile ekwabelaneni ngefayile ngaphandle kwenjongo; ayingomatshini obonakalayo okanye umda wokhuseleko.
Iindawo ezingasentla • C:\Synix ?? main Synix data workspace. • C:\Synix\SteamCMD ?? umxokozelo womdlalo owabelwana ngawo. • C:\Synix\Games\<umdlalo>\<server> ?? ukufakwa kweseva okuqhelekileyo. • C:\Synix\BackupGames ?? ingcambu yesiqhelo. • C:\Synix\SynixData\logs ?? Iirekhodi zesicelo kunye neengxelo zengozi.
Iifayile zesicelo ze-MSI zihlala ziphantsi kwe%LocalAppData%\Programs\Synix. Ezinye iinketho kunye namaxabiso akhuselwe yi-Windows nawo angena kwiakhawunti yakho ye-Windows.
IZIKHATHI ZOMTHETHO Sebenzisa Install & Launch xa ukhetha ifolda yomncedisi. Ukufakela okutsha, khetha ifolda engenanto ebhaliweyo enendawo eyaneleyo yomdlalo kunye nohlaziyo. Musa ukukhomba iiprofayili ezimbini kwisalathiso esinye.
Ifolda evulekileyo yomncedisi ibonisa indawo yokwenyani yomncedisi okhethiweyo. Ifolda evulekileyo yokulondoloza ibonisa indawo yayo yokulondoloza; musa ukuqikelela nayiphi na indlela ukusuka igama layo umboniso.
I-SAVES Inokuhlala Kwenye Indawo Umdlalo ungagcina imihlaba kwiAppData, Amaxwebhu, enye idrayivu, okanye inkqubo yayo yokuthumela. Qinisekisa indawo yokugcina yokwenene yomdlalo ngaphambi kokuba uyibuyisele okanye uyitshintshe.
Ukutshintsha amagama okanye ukuhambisa iifolda kwiFayile Explorer akuqinisekisi ukuba yonke indlela egciniweyo iya kuhlaziywa. Sebenzisa i-Synix inkxaso yokungenisa / ukuhambisa ukuhamba komsebenzi kunye neendlela zokujonga ngaphambi kokuqalisa okulandelayo. Iimeko ezahlukileyo zifuna nezibuko zenethiwekhi ezingangqubaniyo.

data.name: Content.04B9D3E7C29AEA747A53
data.value:
I-Critical SETUP Ifunekayo:
1. Qalisa umncedisi kube kanye ukuze uvelise 'UDKDedServerSettings.ini', uze uyicime.
2. Hlela ifayile yokulungelelanisa ukucwangcisa amaphasiwedi akho omncedisi kunye neendlela zokudlala.
3. Uxwebhu olusemthethweni: https://subsistence.fandom.com/wiki/Dedicated_Servers

data.name: Content.05A8CF055143908911B7
data.value:
I-Critical SETUP Ifunekayo:
1. Qalisa umncedisi kube kanye ukwakha 'Engine.ini', uze uyicime.
2. Guqula ifayile ukuze usete amagama omncedisi, ii-ID zendawo yokusebenzela, kunye neendlela zomdlalo.
3. Uxwebhu olusemthethweni: https://harshdoorstop.com/

data.name: Content.07DB28C48D22292BF1AB
data.value: I-Satisfactory isebenzisa i-Server Manager yayo yomdlalo okanye i-HTTPS API yokufuna umncedisi, ukuseta iphasiwedi yomlawuli, ukudala iseshoni kunye nokugcina umthwalo. I-Synix ilawula izibuko lokuqalisa kunye nexabiso le-MaxPlayers elixhaswayo kwi-Game.ini, kodwa umncedisi kufuneka afunyanwe ngumsebenzisi emva kokuqala kwayo.

data.name: Content.08752F01163B69069283
data.value:
I-Critical SETUP Ifunekayo:
1. Qalisa umncedisi kube kanye ukuze uqalise, uyicime uze ulungiselele izilungiso zomncedisi wakho!
2. Yenza uhlengahlengiso kwiGameUserSettings.ini ukuze uchaze iiparameter zakho nezakhiwo zehlabathi.
3. Uxwebhu olusemthethweni: https://starrupture.wiki.gg/wiki/Server_Hosting

data.name: Content.092466FE1253A8AFC4DE
data.value:
I-Critical SETUP Ifunekayo:
1. Qalisa umncedisi kube kanye ukuze udale 'gameserver.conf', uze uyicime.
2. Hlela ifayile yeempawu zokulungelelanisa ukuze uhlengahlengise imida yeseva kunye neempawu zomdlalo.
3. Uxwebhu olusemthethweni: https://wurmpedia.com/index.php/Dedicated_server

data.name: Content.0A3D6FD5368E0F1C5813
data.value:
I-Critical SETUP Ifunekayo:
1. Qalisa umncedisi kanye ukuze wenze 'Engine.ini', uze uyicime.
2. Yenza utshintsho kwiindlela zokulungelelanisa ukuze usete iiparameter zomdlalo ezenziwe ngokwezifiso kunye nenani labadlali.
3. Uxwebhu olusemthethweni: https://readyornot.wiki.gg/wiki/Dedicated_Server

data.name: Content.0AD494C5598090AE9CCD
data.value: I-Space Engineers isebenzisa i-Dedicated Server Manager yayo esemthethweni, ekufuneka i-Synix igcine ibonakala. Xa ivula okokuqala, khetha i-Local/Console, ukhethe i-Continue to server configuration, faka isilungiso seseva kunye nehlabathi, uze ukhethe i-Save & start. Sebenzisa umphathi wezilungiselelo eziphambili, imihlaba, iimood, abalawuli, kunye nekhonsoli yayo. I-Synix igcina lo mzekelo phantsi kwefolda ye-Instance yeseva. Imodi yokuqala ye-Local/Console ayidingi amalungelo omlawuli; ukudala inkonzo yeWindows yenza. Iimfuno ezisemthethweni ze .NET Framework 4.8 okanye zakutshanje, Visual C++ Redistributable 2013 kunye 2017, ubuncinci i-6 GB yenkqubo RAM, kunye ne-UDP port 27016 evunyelwe nge-Windows Firewall kwaye idluliselwe kwi-router yabadlali be-Intanethi. Isikhokelo esisemthethweni: https://www.spaceengineersgame.com/dedicated-servers/

data.name: Content.0B2D550B207DD25F9B2D
data.value:
I-watchdog ijonga iinkqubo zeseva ezaziwayo kwaye inokuqalisa ukubuyisela kwimeko yesiqhelo emva kokuphuma okungalindelekanga okanye ingxaki efunyenweyo.
INDLELA EQHELEKILEYO YOKUSEBENZA Sebenzisa ulawulo lweSynix's Stop and Restart ukuze wenze utshintsho ngamabomu. I-Synix iququzelela ezo zenzo kunye nenja yokulinda ukuze ukuvalwa okuceliweyo kungaqwalaselwa njengengozi.
Ukuvala ifestile yomdlalo, ukuwubulala kwiTask Manager, okanye ukuwuyeka komnye umphathi kusenokubonakala kungalindelekanga kwaye kubangele ukubuyiswa.
UKUQALA NGAPHAKATHWA Yima umncedisi ngeSynix, uze uhlolisise ilog yomdlalo yakutshanje. Lungisa ingxaki yexesha lokuqalisa, ulungelelwaniso, izibuko, inkumbulo okanye imodeli ngaphambi kokuyiqalisa kwakhona. Ukubuyiswa akukwazi ukulungisa i-mod engavumelaniyo okanye isicwangciso somdlalo esingaphelelanga.
Ukusilela kwenkqubo kunye nombuzo ongafumanekiyo ziingxaki ezahlukeneyo. Ixesha lokubuyisela lixhomekeke kumdlalo nakwimeko yangoku, ngoko musa ukufumanisa ukuba kukho ixesha elingakanani.
IMIPHUMO I-Synix ilandelela ii-launcher ezixhaswayo kunye neenkqubo zomntwana eziya kumncedisi. Oomatshini bokwenyani abalawulwa ngaphandle okanye iinkonzo zokuphunyezwa zingaphila ixesha elide kunomqhubi kwaye zifuna ulawulo lomdlalo.
Inja yokulinda ayingena endaweni ye-backups eqinisekisiweyo okanye ukubukela umncedisi osandula ukutshintshwa ngexesha lokuqala lokuqalisa ngempumelelo.

data.name: Content.0CFE5FFBB20EB7A37198
data.value:
I-Critical SETUP Ifunekayo:
1. Qalisa umncedisi ngokupheleleyo ukuze uqalise, uyicime, uze ulungiselele izilungiso zomncedisi wakho!
2. Guqula 'Game.ini' ukuseta imithetho yeseva yesebe endala kunye namaphasiwedi omlawuli.
3. Uxwebhu olusemthethweni: https://theisle.wiki.gg/

data.name: Content.0D2E92094CEB8EC48551
data.value:
Sebenzisa amaqhosha omjikelo wobomi weSynix ekusebenzeni kwesixhobo esiqhelekileyo. Oku kuvumela umlindi ukuba ahlule phakathi kokumisa ngamabomu nokutshatyalaliswa.
QALA Khetha ukungena uze ukhethe Qalisa kanye. I-Synix ijonga iimfuno zangaphambili ezifanelekileyo, iindlela, izibuko, kunye nolondolozo olukhethiweyo ngaphambi kokuqalisa, ilungiselela iifayile ezilahlekileyo ezixhaswayo, kwaye iqalisa umncedisi. Linda isiphumo ngaphambi kokuba uzame kwakhona.
Yima Khetha i-Stop uze uvumele ixesha lomdlalo ukuba ligcine kwaye livale. I-Synix isebenzisa i-shutdown enobubele exhaswayo xa ikhona, emva koko ukubuyela umva kwinqanaba lokuqukumbela inkqubo ukuba kuyimfuneko. Ukuqeshwa ngokunyanzelekileyo kunokulahlekelwa yinkqubela engakhuselekanga.
Qalisa kwakhona Khetha Qalisa kwakhona ukuze umise iqela lenkqubo yangoku uze uqalise umzekelo omtsha. Musa ukuqala enye ikopi ngesandla ngelixa oku kusenzeka.
UKUBA INKONTO AKUKHO Omnye umsebenzi usenokuba sele ungumnini weseva, ukungena kunokuthi kube kwimeko yokutshintsha, okanye loo mdlalo ungasebenzisa ukuthunyelwa kwangaphandle. Funda umyalezo womsebenzi kunye neempawu zeprofayile.
Kuphephe ukubulala umncedisi kuMphathi weMisebenzi okanye ukuyimisa kwisixhobo esingahambelaniyo kulondolozo oluqhelekileyo. Oko kusenokubonakala njengokuphumla okungalindelekanga nokukhokelela ekubuyiselweni.
Imidlalo elawulwa ngemishini ebonakalayo okanye iinkonzo zangaphandle zokuhambisa kufuneka ihlolwe ngokwabo umjikelo wobomi. Ukuvalwa kwesikhululo-mlilo akubonisi ukuba ezi nkonzo ziye zaphela.

data.name: Content.0ECB6A419FB3B353E163
data.value:

data.name: Content.14E361A374F9F14F65DD
data.value:
I-Satisfactory idinga ukusekwa kokuqala kwi-Server Manager yayo yomdlalo. I-Synix inokufaka kwaye iqalise umncedisi ozinikeleyo, kodwa ayithathi indawo yokufuna umncedisi okanye ukudala iseshoni yayo.
Gqibezela UMdlalo 1. Yenza ifayile ye- Satisfactory uze uyiqale kwi- Synix. 2. Lindela ukuba umncedisi ozinikeleyo agqibe ukulayisha. 3. Vula i-Satisfactory's in-game Server Manager uze ungeze okanye ukhethe umncedisi. 4. Yenza isicelo, setha iphasiwedi yomlawuli uze ungene njengomlawuli. 5. Yenza okanye ilayishe iseshoni ofuna ukuyisebenzisa.
I-Synix ilawula amaxabiso okuqalisa/okucwangcisa axhaswayo, kuquka izibuko lokuqalisa kunye neMaxPlayers. Iifayile ezifanelekileyo ziphantsi kwe-FactoryGame\Saved\Config\WindowsServer.
Qhagamshela i-SYNIX 1. Gcina umncedisi eqhuba nge -NewConsole. Khangela amanqaku angenisiweyo okanye amadala; ukuba ukongeza le ngxoxo, qala kwakhona ngokusebenzisa Synix. 2. Sebenzisa inqanaba elifanayo leemvume zeWindows zeSynix kunye neserver, kungcono iimvume zomsebenzisi eziqhelekileyo. 3. Khetha loo nkonzo uze uvule iinketho zeseva → Satisfactory Control Center → Connect API. 4. Khetha Ukudibanisa ngokuzenzekelayo kanye uze ulinde.
I-Synix ithumela i-server.GenerateAPIToken, ifunda imveliso entsha epheleleyo, iqinisekisa i-API yendawo, kwaye igcina i-token ebhaliweyo kwiakhawunti yakho ye-Windows. I-token ivumela ukufikelela komlawuli, kungekhona nje ukulandelela.
Iingxelo zempumelelo I-Token iqinisekisiwe kwaye igcinwe ngokukhuselekileyo kwaye ivula Ukujonga ngokubanzi. Akunyanzelekanga ukuba ukope umgca wekhonsoli okanye uncamathisele ithokheni ngesandla.
Ukuba umzamo awuphumeleli, i-Synix igcina nayiphi na unxibelelwano olugcinwe ngaphambili kwaye ayizami ngokuzenzekelayo umyalelo kwakhona. Funda umphumo ongqalileyo ngaphambi kokuba uzame kwakhona.
Oku kunxibelelana neserver ekhethiweyo kule PC; ayidingi mthetho omtsha womzila weSynix. Ukuqalisa okuqhelekileyo, ukuyeka nokuqalisa kwakhona kusasebenza ngaphandle kwe-API token.

data.name: Content.1734B5184A8732EBE5C7
data.value:
Khetha ideshibhodi uze uvule iinketho zeseva. Kuphela zixhobo ezixhaswa yile profayile kunye nemeko yayo yangoku.
Iifayile NOKUGQIBELA • Ifolda evulekileyo yomncedisi kunye nefolda evulekileyo yokulondoloza ivula iindawo ezikhoyo. • Umhleli wokumisela uvula iifayile zokumisela umdlalo ezixhaswayo. • Ukuhlaziya Umncedisi ukhuphela uhlaziyo lomdlalo oluxhaswayo. • Qinisekisa ukuhlolwa kweFayile yeMidlalo okanye ukulungisa iifayile ezilawulwa ngumfakisi. • Backup and Restore ukugcina okanye ukubuyisela ufakelo olukhethiweyo. • Yenza Ifayile yeBhetshi ithumela ngaphandle iskripthi sokuqalisa xa iphrofayili isixhasa. • I-Delete isusa ingxelo kwaye inikezela kuphela iinketho zokususa iifayile eziboniswe kwinkcazelo yayo.
UKUQHUBELA KWAKHO NAMATHuluzi Omdlalo Ulwazi loqhagamshelwano lubonisa iidilesi, izibuko kunye nezenzo zokukopa. Iimvavanyo zonxibelelwano, uMlawuli weMod & Plugin, izixhobo zeMinecraft, kunye neZiko loLawulo lweSatisfactory zibonakala apho kuxhaswa khona.
HLAWULA UMlungiseleli OQHUBELEKILEYO Cofa kabini kumgca wayo ukuze ufumane iinkcukacha zeseva. Iinkcukacha zeNkqubo ebukhoma zibonisa i-launcher eqinisekisiweyo, ii-hosts zekhonsoli, kunye neenkqubo zomsebenzi ezibandakanya loo ngxelo. Umdlalo weenkqubo ezininzi unokuba ne-ID yenkqubo engaphezu kweyodwa.
Sebenzisa umbonisi wemithombo ukujonga i-CPU yaloo nkonzo kunye nembali yememori. Ezi zifundo zahlukile kwisishwankathelo esipheleleyo sePC kwideshibhodi.
Ukuvala iinkcukacha okanye iwindow yokubeka esweni izixhobo akuyeki umdlalo. Sebenzisa isenzo sokumisa kwideshibhodi xa usenza loo nto.

data.name: Content.18D0D93C3EB881DA2D03
data.value:
Khetha uhlelo lwe-Minecraft ngaphambi kokukhetha ii-mods okanye izilungiselelo zonxibelelwano. I-Java kunye ne-Bedrock ziintlobo ezahlukeneyo zeseva; I-Bedrock ayingomthwalo we-Java.
Cwangcisa ISERVER 1. Yenza i-Minecraft kwaye ukhethe i-Java okanye i-Bedrock. 2. Kwi-Java, khetha i-Minecraft version, loader, kunye ne-loader version ehambelanayo enikezelwa ngabakhethiweyo. 3. Hlola ihlabathi, imo yomdlalo womthonyama, umda womdlali, inkumbulo, izibuko, kunye neenkalo zokhuseleko ezivunyelweyo. 4. Gcina uze uqalise ngeSynix. 5. Funda nasiphi na isivumelwano okanye uqalise kuqala ngaphambi kokuba usamkele. 6. Lindela ukuba ihlabathi ligqibe ukulayisha, uze ujoyine umxhasi olungelelanisiweyo kunye nohlobo. 7. Qinisekisa ukuba usebenza kakuhle ngaphambi kokuba ufake ii-mods.
IJAVA NE-BEDROCK Ukhetho lwe-Java lubandakanya iVanilla, i-Fabric, i-Forge, i-NeoForge, i-Paper, kunye ne-Purpur apho kukho ukwakhiwa. Sebenzisa iinguqulelo uze wenze abakhethiweyo; I-Paper kunye ne-Purpur zisebenzisa iiplagi, ngelixa i-Fabric, i-Forge, kunye ne-NeoForge zisebenzisa ii-mods zazo ezihambelanayo. I-Synix ikhuphela ixesha lokuqhuba elikhethiweyo kumboneleli wayo osemthethweni.
I-Bedrock isebenzisa iphakheji esemthethweni ye-Bedrock yeSeva ezinikezelweyo kwaye ayisebenzisi i-Java.
FANELISA Iindlela Khetha i-loader efunekayo kwiimod zakho. Hlanganisa inguqulelo ye-Minecraft, umthwalo, ukuxhomekeka, kunye naziphi na iimfuno zomxhasi.
Iiphakheji zeFabric, Forge, NeoForge, kunye neeplagi-server azifani. Ukudala ifolda ye-mods okanye iiplagi ayifaki i-loader efunekayo okanye isakhelo seseva. I-Browse Catalog ayiyiyo i-modpack okanye ukufakelwa koxhomekeko oluzenzekelayo.
UMHLABA Ukucwangcisa kulawula i-server.properties kunye nezilungiselelo ezithile zohlelo. I-Java inika nemodi yeSpectator. Ixabiso lobugcisa kunye nemiyalelo igcina ifom Minecraft ulindele.
Ukusuka kwiiNketho zeSeva, vula iZiko loLawulo leMinecraft. Iphepha layo leSethingi libonisa iifayile zokulungelelanisa ezilungiswayo. Ukuhlela Ifayile kunika ukuhlela umbhalo; Umhleli oLungeleleneyo ubonelela ngomhleli okhoyo owaziyo ifomathi. Zombini zigcina utshintsho xa umncedisi emile. Amaxabiso aziwayo e-server.properties afana nezibuko, umda womdlali, umhlaba, imbewu, imowudi, kunye nezilungiselelo zeseyile yomyalelo nazo zihlaziya ukungena okugciniweyo kwe-Synix. Igama elibhengeziweyo/MOTD lihlukile kwigama lokungena lendawo. Izilungiselelo ze-mod ezingaziwayo zihlala kwiifayile zazo.
I-Synix ifunda kwakhona ezi zilungiselelo ngaphambi kokuhlela okanye ukuqala ukungena, kwaye xa i-Refresh isetyenziswa ngelixa imisiwe. Ukuba ulungiso lwangaphandle alulunganga okanye luyangqubana nolunye uxwebhu, lungisa ingxaki enegama endaweni yokuqalisa umncedisi ngokuphindaphindiweyo. Umhleli uyala ukubhala ngaphezulu ifayile etshintshileyo ukususela ekuvulweni kwayo; uyivule kwakhona ukuze ulayishe umxholo omtsha.
UKUTSHINTSHA ISIKHATHI SOKUQALA KWESERVER Gcina i-backup epheleleyo yomncedisi ngaphambi kokutshintsha iinguqulelo okanye abalayishi. Khetha ixesha elitsha lokuqalisa kwiSetup, gcina ingxelo ehlaziyiweyo, emva koko ukhethe Sebenzisa ixesha lokuqalisa kwiMinecraft Control Center. I-Synix ilungiselela ixesha lokusebenza elisemthethweni ngokwahlukeneyo, igcina i-server.properties kunye neefolda zehlabathi, kwaye irekhoda iifayile zexesha lokusebenza ezibuyiselweyo. Ayiqali ngokuzenzekelayo umncedisi. Ukuqalisa kuvaliwe ngelixa ixesha lokuqhuba eliqokelelweyo kunye neprofayile ekhethiweyo zingavumelani.
Ukubuyela umva kwefayile akuziphelisi utshintsho lwehlabathi olwenziwe emva kokuba iserver iqalisiwe. Ungaze ucinge ukuba ihlabathi elivulekileyo ngeMinecraft entsha okanye iimodyuli ezahlukeneyo zinokufakwa ngokukhuselekileyo ngexesha lokuqhuba elidala; buyisela i-back-up epheleleyo ehambelanayo endaweni yoko.
Misa ngaphambi kokuba utshintshe iifayile ezifuna ukuqala kwakhona. Musa ukuthatha indawo yehlabathi elikhoyo nge template entsha njengendlela yokulungisa.
Ukuba abadlali abakwazi ukujoyina Khangela uhlelo, umdlalo / ukulayisha iinguqulelo, iimodyuli ezifunekayo, kunye ne-port/protocol yangempela yohlobo olukhethiweyo. Ukuze uphume kwangethuba, khangela kwi-log yomdlalo ukuze ubone ukuba kukho impazamo yokuvumelana, ixesha lokuqhuba, inkumbulo okanye ukuxhomekeka.

data.name: Content.29DD837D20479ABA0D1B
data.value:
Vula iZiko loLawulo lweSatisfactory emva kokudibanisa i-API yendawo. Khetha ithebhu yomsebenzi oyifunayo.
INQAKU ELINGUMXHOLO Khetha Ukuhlaziya ukuze ufunde igama leseshoni, inani / umda wabadlali abaxhunyiwe, imeko yomdlalo, umyinge we-tick, ixesha lokudlala kunye nenqanaba lobuchwephesha.
Umdlali wedeshibhodi ubala ukuhlaziywa ngokuzenzekelayo ngelixa uqhagamshelo lusempilweni; itheyibhile yoMjikelo iyahlaziywa xa kuceliwe. Le API inika amanani, hayi uluhlu lwabadlali abanamagama. Iseshoni ekhawulezileyo okanye umncedisi olinde iseshoni akusiyo inkqubo emileyo.
IISETINGS ZESERVER Khetha Ukuhlaziya, hlela amaxabiso axhaswayo, uze usebenzise utshintsho. Phinda ujonge amaxabiso alindelekileyo emva kokuhlaziya. Ezinye iinketho zifuna ukuqala kwakhona; ukusetyenziswa kotshintsho akuqali umdlalo ngokuzenzekelayo.
Ukubeka izitshixo kunye namaxabiso amkelweyo kuhlala kusetyenziswa ulwimi lobuchwephesha bomdlalo.
Iimidlalo Ezisindisiweyo • Gcina ngoku: Faka igama okanye usebenzise igama elihlaziyiweyo leSynix. Ukuphinda usebenzise igama kunokubangela ukuba kugqitywe ukusindiswa okhoyo. • Umthwalo ukhethiwe: Jonga isiqinisekiso. I-Synix igcina inkqubela phambili yangoku kuqala xa iseshoni isebenza; ukulayisha kunokuqhawula abadlali. • Ukulayisha ugcino: Yongeza ifayile ekhethiweyo kwaye inokutshintsha ugcino olunegama elifanayo. Ayizukuyithwala ngokuzenzekelayo. • Ukukhuphela okukhethiweyo: Kugcina ikopi kwindlela ekhethwe nguwe.
Gcina i-backup ezimeleyo ngaphambi kokutshintsha okanye ukulayisha ihlabathi elibalulekileyo. Ukugcina ukuhanjiswa kunomda wokhuseleko we-512 MB. I-API isenokungafumaneki okwethutyana ngelixa iseshoni ilayisha.
UKUQHUBELEKILEYO KWEKONSOLO Thumela umyalelo omnye womdlalo oxhaswayo ngexesha uze ufunde isiqinisekiso. Izicatshulwa, imiyalelo ye-token / iphasiwedi, kunye notshintsho lokufikelela olungakhuselekanga luvaliwe apha.
Imiyalelo yokumisa exhaswayo idluliselwa ngokusebenzisa ukuhamba komsebenzi wokumisa kweSynix. Ukuphuma komyalelo kuhlala kule window kunokuba kufakwe kwideshibhodi okanye kwiirekhodi zetekisi ze-Synix; lo mdlalo usenokubhala iirekhodi zawo.

data.name: Content.29E9D2F428F5E2BA4705

data.name: Content.2B0EFE8DBC3E9BEC09E3
data.value:
Iifayile zomdlalo we-MULTIPLAYER ZINOKUDINGEKA:
I-Synix ifaka iphakheji yeserver enikezelweyo kodwa ayikwazi ukukhuphela, ukukopa okanye ukuhambisa kwakhona iifayile ezinelayisensi kumdlalo oqhelekileyo. Ukuba umncedisi uxela ukusilela komxholo womdlali oninzi okanye ukonakala ngelixa ulayisha okanye utshintsha iimephu, faka uMesiya oMnyama we-Might & Magic Multiplayer nge-Steam usebenzisa iakhawunti enayo. Khuphela umxholo we-mpsrc womdlali oninzi ukusuka kuloo ufakelo lomdlalo kule folda ye-server enikezelweyo, kwaye uqiniseke ukuba i-mapcycle.txt kunye ne-maplist.txt ziqulethe iimephu ofuna ukuzisebenzisa.
Eli nyathelo kufuneka ligqitywe ngumsebenzisi ofaka umncedisi. Ixabiso lomdlalo yi0 Deathmatch, 1 Team Deathmatch, 2 Crusade, 3 Capture the Flag, kunye ne4 Colosseum.

data.name: Content.2B637CF2169F0AD865CF
data.value:
Funda iziphumo ze Connect ngokuzenzekelayo ngaphambi kokuba uzame kwakhona. Umyalelo obonakalayo kwikhonsoli yomdlalo awungqina ukuba ukubamba, ukuqinisekisa nokugcina iithokheni kwakuphumelele.
HLOLULA IINKCUKACHA EZIJINGATHELEKILEYO • Ikhonsoli ayifumaneki: Qinisekisa i--NewConsole, umncedisi okhethiweyo, kunye namazinga okuhambelana ne-Windows. • Umyalelo ongaphelelanga kwi-input: Yicime ngokwakho. I-Synix ayiyi kuyibhala ngokugqithiseleyo. • Umyalelo uyasebenza kodwa akukho nto ibambekayo: Vumela ukuqaliswa kugqitywe, khangela iirekhodi zomdlalo ezinokubhalwa, uze uvumele ukuveliswa okutsha okupheleleyo ukuba kufike. • Ukuphazamiseka kweefilitha: Cacisa ukufaka/ukucima iifilitha uze uvumele ikhonsoli iphendule. • Izibuko leAPI liyinxalenye yenkqubo: Lungisa izibuko lomdlalo elungiselelwe umncedisi okhethiweyo. Musa ukuthumela uphawu lwayo kumphulaphuli ongenanto yakwenza. • Ikhonkco elilahliwe okanye eligciniweyo alinakuvalwa: Gqibezela ukucwangciswa komdlalo, emva koko uqhagamshele kwakhona. • API ayifumaneki: Linda ukuqala okanye ugcine ukulayisha uze ujonge ilog yomdlalo.
Impendulo entsha inokuqulatha ixabiso elifanayo le-token njengempendulo yangaphambili. Ukubamba kusebenzisa imveliso eyenziweyo emva komyalelo, hayi i-token endala engafanelekanga kwi-log.
KHAWUKHUSELEKILE UKUZE UYISENZE INDLELA YOKUFUMANA I-Satisfactory iphrinta iithokheni zomlawuli kwikhonsoli yayo kunye neelogi. Zigcine ziyimfihlo uze ususe imigca yeethokheni kwiscreenshots nakwiingxelo.
I-Synix iqinisekisa ukuba iphuzu lokugqibela lasekuhlaleni liyinxalenye yomncedisi okhethiweyo kwaye iphina isatifikethi sayo. Musa ukukhubaza ukuhlolwa kwezatifikethi ukulungisa ukusilela.
Susa i-token egciniweyo isusa uxhulumaniso olugcinwe kwi-Synix; ayiyirhoxisi i-token kumncedisi.
Ukurhoxisa iithokheni zesicelo ezikhoyo, sebenzisa i-server.InvalidateAPITokens kwikhonsoli yeseva ye-Satisfactory okanye kwikhonsoli yoLawulo lweSeva. Oku kuchaphazela nezinye ukudibanisa usebenzisa ezo tokens.
Kwi-akhawunti ye-Windows okanye ufakelo oluhambayo, qhagamshela kwakhona ukuba uqhagamshelwano olukhuselekileyo olugciniweyo alunakusetyenziswa.
