data.name: Content.2E2BBD89AFEC2FD2B678
data.value:
Funda umsebenzi wakutshanje womncedisi okhethiweyo kunye nerekhodi lomdlalo. Khangela ukusilela kokuqala kunokuba ukhangele kuphela umyalezo wokugqibela wokucima.
INQAKU ELINGASEKELWAYO KUKUQALA NOKUHAMBELA KUDALA 1. Qinisekisa ifolda yofakelo ekhethiweyo, i-executable, inguqulelo yomdlalo kunye nomthumeli. 2. Jonga iifayile ezifunekayo, indawo ekhululekile yeRAM / idiski, kunye nezibuko ezihlalayo. 3. Gqibezela nasiphi na isivumelwano, ukubhalisa kwiakhawunti, imfuneko yetokheni, okanye ukusekwa kweseshoni yomdlalo. 4. Kwiimod, thelekisa umdlalo, umthwalo, ukuxhomekeka, kunye neemfuno zomxhasi. 5. Yima kwiSynix ngaphambi kokuba utshintshe iifayile, uze uvavanyo lokuqala.
Umkhombi ophilayo unokuhlala emva kokuba umncedisi wokwenyani eselele. Umncedisi ophilileyo unokulinda ukulayishwa kwehlabathi okanye ube nombuzo ongekhoyo / API. Hlola la mazwe ngokwahlukeneyo.
Ukuyeka Okanye Ukuqalisa Kwakhona Kuthatha Ixesha Imidlalo idinga ixesha lokonga nokuvala iinkqubo zabasebenzi. Linda isiphumo seSynix uze ufunde umyalezo wayo wokuvala. Ukuwa ngokunyanzelekileyo kunokuphelisa inkqubela engakhange igcinwe.
Musa ukubulala iinkqubo ngaxeshanye, qalisa enye ikopi, okanye usebenzise omnye umphathi ngokuchasene nokufakelwa okufanayo.
Isixhobo Okanye Isilungiso Silahlekile Jonga amandla eprofayile kunye nemeko yangoku. Ezinye iinketho zikhubazekile ngenxa yokuba umdlalo ungumnini wazo okanye akukho ndlela yokulawula ixhaswayo ikhona. Idatha yomdlali we-N/A ayiyiyo ngokuzenzekelayo ukusilela kweseva.
Ukuba ingxaki iyaqhubeka, bhala isenzo, impazamo echanekileyo, nesicatshulwa esifutshane ngaphambi kokuba wenze ezinye iinguqu ezingahambelaniyo.

data.name: Content.3111DCC7482FEADC74FC
data.value:
Faka okanye uhlaziye i-MODPACK ye-Server 1. Yenza i-backup epheleleyo yomncedisi uze umise umncedisi. Sebenzisa i-Synix ngeemvume eziqhelekileyo ze-Windows. 2. Cwangcisa uze usebenzise inguqulelo echanekileyo yepakethi yeMinecraft, ukulayisha, kunye nokwakha ukulayisha kuqala. 3. KwiMinecraft Control Center → Mods & Plugins, khetha Import Server Pack. Khetha i-Modrinth .mrpack okanye iseva epheleleyo ye-ZIP equlathe ii-mods / iiplagi kunye neefayile zokulungelelanisa. 4. Iimodeli zeseva ezikhethiweyo ziyashiywa ngaphandle kokuba i-Include option server mods ikhethiwe. Ukufakwa kwe-Modrinth kumxhasi kuphela kunye nokugqitywa komxhasi akungeniswa. 5. Jonga umphumo wokuskena, ukuhlolwa kwemethadatha, umxholo ongekhoyo, kunye neefayile zonke eziza kongezelelwa, zitshintshwe okanye zisuswe. Qinisekisa kuphela ukuba umthombo notshintsho lufanelekile. 6. Qalisa ngesandla emva kokufaka, funda ikhonsoli uze uvavanye uqhagamshelo lomxhasi oluhambelanayo.
Umthengisi akaqhutyelwa izikripthi zokuqalisa ezibonelelwe kwipakethi, atshintshe imihlaba okanye abhale ngaphezulu i-root server.properties. Khuphela iphakheji yeseva epheleleyo yombhali ukuba ukuthumela umthengi weCurseForge kuqukethe kuphela imenyu yokukhuphela. Ukukhuphela kwangasese, ii-hosts ezingaxhaswanga, okanye abalayishi abangaxhaswanga bafuna iifayile zeseva ezixhaswa ngumbhali; I-Synix ayihambisani nezithintelo zabanikezeli.
Ukukhutshelwa kweModrinth kuqinisekisiwe nge-hash. I-metadata ye-JAR exhaswayo ihlolwe kumthwalo, umxholo womxhasi kuphela, ii-ID eziphindaphindiweyo, kunye nokuxhomekeka okubhengeziweyo ngaphandle kokuqhuba i-JAR. I-metadata engaziwayo kunye neendidi zeenguqulelo ezintsonkothileyo zifuna ukuhlaziywa. Ukuhlolwa okucocekileyo okanye ukungabikho kweengxabano ezichaziweyo akuqinisekisi ukuba imodeli ikhuselekile okanye iyahambelana. Ukuxhomekeka okungekhoyo akukhutshelwa cwaka.
Ukungenisa kwakhona iphakheji enegama elifanayo kunokususa ii-JAR zayo eziphethwe ngaphambili ezingasekhoyo, kodwa kuphela xa ezo fayile zisahambelana nee-hashes zazo ezigciniweyo. I-JAR engalawulwayo kunye neefayile zehlabathi azicinywa. Iifayile zokulungelelanisa ezibonelelwe kwipakethi entsha zinokutshintsha ezindala; ukuboniswa kwangaphambi kokuba uqinisekise. Gcina igama elifanayo lefayile ye-server-ZIP xa uhlaziya loo phakheji ukuze ibonwe njengepakheji efanayo.
UKULAWULWA KWEMHLABA Sebenzisa iiHlabathi ukubhalisa imihlaba eyaziwayo. Ukungenisa i-ZIP yeHlabathi ikopi enye yehlabathi elihambelanayo kwifolda entsha enegama; ayibhali phezu kwehlabathi elikhoyo okanye iguqule phakathi kweJava neBedrock. Khetha ihlabathi efakiweyo uze usebenze ihlabathi ukutshintsha inqanaba igama kunye nehlabathi Synix setting kunye. Isiqalo esilandelayo silayisha ihlabathi elikhethiweyo. Ukutshintsha imbewu kuchaphazela ukuveliswa kwehlabathi elitsha, kungekhona umhlaba okhoyo.
INDLELA YOKUPHUMA Ukubuyisela kwakhona kuluhlu lweenguqu zefayile ezenziwe yile ndawo yokusebenza. U-Undo ubuyisela iifayile ezidlulileyo okanye ususe iifayile ezifakwe kolu tshintsho. Shiya kwilizwe elingeniswayo ngaphambi kokuba ulichithe. Ukuba iifayile zahlelwa emva koko, i-Synix iyala ukuzibhala ngaphezulu; gcina ukuhlela kwaye usebenzise isipele esipheleleyo esifanelekileyo ukuba kuyimfuneko.
Ukubuyiselwa okulindelweyo kuvalwa Qalisa de ukubuyiselwa kugqitywe kwaye ifayile egciniweyo iyavumelana neefayile ezibuyiselweyo. Izixhobo ezindala ngaphandle kweprofayili eqingqiweyo yexesha lokuqhuba zifuna isicatshulwa esipheleleyo sokubuyisela ixesha lokuqhuba. Izipele zihlala ziyi-backups epheleleyo yefolda yomncedisi, ngaphandle kweerekhodi zokutshintsha ezizodwa.
Emva kokuphinda kwenziwe i-backup epheleleyo ngempumelelo, iirekhodi ezindala zokutshintsha indawo yokusebenzela ziphawulwe njengezithathelwe indawo yile backup. Zihlala zibonakala ukuze zisetyenziswe kodwa azinakurhoxiswa kwiifayile ezibuyiselweyo. Ukungenisa okanye ukuhlela umxholo emva kokubuyisela kudala iirekhodi ezintsha zokubuyisela.
I-DIAGNOSTICS NE-STEDULES I-diagnostics ifunda iingxelo zamva nje ze-log ne-crash-report zeengxaki eziqhelekileyo ze-Java, inkumbulo, ukuxhomekeka, izibuko, ihlabathi, kunye neengxaki ze-tick time. Ukungabikho komzekelo okufunyenweyo akubungqina bokuba umncedisi uphilile. Ukusebenza kuvula umbonisi wemithombo; Imilinganiselo ye-CPU ne-RAM ayiyi kuthatha indawo yokubeka iiprofayili ze-tick.
I-Schedules ivula izicwangciso ezikhoyo zokuqalisa kwakhona kunye nolondolozo lwe-Synix. Khetha imihla efunekayo, ixesha, ukuziphatha lokulinda komdlali, iinketho zokusekelayo kunye nokuhlaziya, emva koko uphonononge kwaye ugcine. Indawo yokusebenzela ayenzi sicwangciso sesibini okanye itshintshe ishedyuli yakho ngokuzenzekelayo.

data.name: Content.34AD8EEA90B225512F6F
data.value:
Khetha umncedisi weMinecraft, uze uvule iinketho zeseva → iZiko loLawulo lweMinecraft. Amaphepha eConsole kunye nabaDlali agcina umyalelo kunye nezixhobo zomdlali kunye. Amanye amaphepha anikezela ngezilungiselelo, imihlaba, izongezo, ii-backups zeseva epheleleyo, ukucwangcisa kwakhona, ukubuyisela kwimeko yesiqhelo kunye nokuxilongwa.
IIKHONKO ZOMTHETHO Ukucwangciswa okuxhaswayo kungasebenzisa ikhonsoli elawulwa yi-Synix, isiteshi sokulawula i-localhost esixhaswayo, okanye i-RCON ekhethiweyo. Umjelo okhoyo uxhomekeke kuhlelo kunye nokulungelelaniswa kweseva.
Ifestile yemveli efihliweyo isenokushiya isiteshi somyalelo wasekuhlaleni esixhaswayo sikhona. Ukuba ulawulo lukhubazekile, khangela ukuba umncedisi uyasebenza nokuba useto lwayo lolawulo luyasebenza.
IZenzo Ezilungiselelwe Xa kuxhaswa, i-Synix inika izaziso, uluhlu lwabadlali, ukulawula, utshintsho lomqhubi kunye noluhlu lwemvume, ulawulo lwexesha / lwemozulu, kunye nokonga.
Khetha umdlali ocetywayo uze ufunde isenzo ngaphambi kokuqinisekisa oko. Ukunika umqhubi ukufikelela kunika iimvume zomdlalo ezinamandla. Musa ukuyinika nje ukuze usombulule ingxaki yokunxibelelana.
Imiyalelo engekho mthethweni Sebenzisa i-syntax ekulindeleke ukuba yenziwe kuloo nguqulelo. Imiyalelo efana noluhlu kunye nokugcina konke kungena kumdlalo kwaye ayiguqulelwa kwi-interface yeSynix. Jonga imigaqo yomyalelo womdlalo ngaphambi kokuthumela umyalelo otshintsha ihlabathi okanye iimvume.
IMIBHALO NAMagama Umbuzo unokubonelela ngenani labadlali ngaphandle koluhlu olunegama eliqinisekisiweyo. Itheyibhile yamagama engenanto yona ayingqina ukuba akukho mntu unxulumene.
Sebenzisa isicwangciso sokumisa okanye sokuqalisa kwakhona kwideshibhodi yokutshintsha umjikelo wobomi ukuze umlindi azi ukuba ukuvalwa komsebenzi kuyenzeka ngabom.
Gcina i-RCON okanye ii-endpoints zokulawula zikhoyo ngaphandle kokuba unecebo lokulawula kude eliqinisekisiweyo. Ukudlala esidlangalaleni akufuneki kutyhilwe ezo ngcaciso okanye iziphelo.

1. Ubunini
Isofthiwe inelayisensi, ayithengiswa.
UJason Turner ugcina onke amalungelo, izihloko kunye nomdla kwiSoftware, kuquka onke amalungelo obunikazi namanye amalungelo obunikazi bobuchwephesha. Akukho malungelo obunikazi adluliselwa kuwe phantsi kwale layisensi.
2. Isibonelelo seLisensi esilinganiselweyo
Ngokuxhomekeka kuyo yonke imiqathango yale layisensi, unikwa ilayisensi enomda, engapheliyo, engenakudluliselwa, engenalayisensi ngaphantsi, nelinokupheliswa:
- Khuphela uze usebenzise iSoftware kwiinjongo zakho zobuqu, ezingezizo ezorhwebo. - Jonga uze ufunde ikhowudi yomthombo. - Yenza iikopi zokulondoloza ukuze uzisebenzise. - Yenza utshintsho kwikhowudi yomthombo ukuze uyisebenzise. - Qokelela uze uqhube izilungiso zakho zobuqu kwizixhobo onazo okanye ozilawulayo.
Naluphi na ilungelo elingenikwa ngokucacileyo yile layisensi linelungelo lobunikazi.
3. Ukutshintshwa Komntu
Unokuyitshintsha iSoftware ukuze uhlangabezane neemfuno zakho zobuqu.
Izilungiso zobuqu kufuneka zihlale ziyimfihlo ngaphandle kokuba uJason Turner akunike imvume ebhaliweyo kwangaphambili yokuzisasaza.
Awukwazi ukupapasha, ukulayisha, ukwabelana, ukukhupha, ukusasaza, okanye ukwenza ikhowudi yomthombo ehlaziyiweyo okanye ii-binaries ezihlanganisiweyo ezilungisiweyo zifumaneke kuluntu njengenguqulelo eyahlukileyo yeSynix.
4. Imiqathango
Akuvumelekanga, ngaphandle kwemvume ebhaliweyo kaJason Turner:
4.1 Ukusetyenziswa kwezorhwebo
- Ukuthengisa, ukuqesha, ukuqesha, ilayisensi, ilayisensi engezantsi, okanye ukuhlawula iSoftware. - Thengisa okanye usasaze ii-binaries ezihlanganisiweyo ezilungisiweyo okanye ezingafakwanga. - Sebenzisa iSoftware okanye ikhowudi yayo yomthombo njengenxalenye yemveliso ehlawulwayo okanye inkonzo yorhwebo. - Ukufumana inzuzo ngokuthe ngqo okanye ngokungathanga ngqo ngokusasaza, ukugunyazisa, ukutshintsha uphawu lwentengiso okanye ukubonelela ngokufikelela kwiSoftware.
I-4.2 Ukuhanjiswa kwakhona kunye nokusingathwa koluntu
- Khuphela, ubonise okanye ugcine iSoftware kwenye iwebhusayithi, indawo yokugcina izinto, inkonzo yokukhuphela, iqonga lokwabelana ngeefayile okanye ivenkile yezicelo. - Hambisa kwakhona ikhowudi yomthombo okanye ii-binaries ezihlanganisiweyo, nokuba zilungisiwe okanye azilungiswanga. - Yenza okanye upapashe izixhumanisi ezingezizo ezisemthethweni, iiphakheji eziphathwayo, izipili, okanye ukukhuphela. - Shicilela iinguqulelo ezivela kwi-fork okanye ikopi eguqulweyo yeSoftware. - Bonisa i-fork, utshintsho okanye inguqulelo ethatyathwe njengeemveliso ezizimeleyo okanye ezikhuphisanayo.
I-4.3 Ukutshintshwa kwegama kunye nokuhanjiswa
- Susa, ufihle, okanye utshintshe igama leSynix, izaziso zobunikazi, iikhredithi zababhali, izaziso zelayisensi, iilogo, okanye ukubhaliswa. - Ukutshintsha igama okanye ukutshintsha uphawu lweSoftware ukuze ikhutshwe okanye isasazwe esidlangalaleni. - Thetha ukuba nguwe owadala iSoftware yokuqala. - Sebenzisa igama okanye uphawu lwe-Synix ngendlela ebonisa ubuxhasi, ukwamkelwa, ubudlelwane, okanye isimo esisemthethweni.
4.4 Reverse Engineering and Protection Bypass
Ngokwezona nqanaba zivumelekileyo ngumthetho osebenzayo, awukwazi ukubuyisela umva iinjineli, ukuhlaziya, ukudiliza, okanye ukuzama ngenye indlela ukuphepha izaziso zelayisensi, ukwabiwa, iinkalo zokhuseleko, ukuhlolwa kohlaziyo, okanye uphawu olubandakanyiweyo kwinguqulelo esemthethweni eqokelelwe.
Lo mda awukhawulezi naluphi na ilungelo elingenakukhutshwa elinikwe ngokucacileyo ngumthetho osebenzayo.
5. GitHub Iifolokhwe kunye negalelo
Ingxelo esemthethweni yeSynix inokubonwa esidlangalaleni kwiGitHub. Iqonga le-GitHub linokuvumela abasebenzisi ukuba babone kwaye baxhamle indawo yokugcina uluntu ngokusebenzisa ukusebenza kwe-GitHub eyakhelweyo.
I-GitHub fork ayikuniki mvume yokuba:
- Papasha ingxelo engekho semthethweni yeSynix. - Hambisa ii-binaries ezilungisiweyo okanye ezingalunganga. - I-Rebrand Synix. - Sebenzisa iphepha elikhethekileyo lokuzikhuphela esidlangalaleni okanye isipili. - Bonisa i-fork njengesoftware yakho. - Ukuhambisa kwakhona iSoftware ngaphandle komsebenzi omncinci onikezelwa yiGitHub.
Iifolokhwe zeGitHub zingasetyenziswa kuphela ukujonga ikhowudi, ukulungiselela igalelo okanye ukuthunyelwa kwesicelo sokurhoxisa kwindawo yokugcina i-Synix esemthethweni. Izilungiso zobuqu ezingafakwanga njengomnikelo kufuneka zihlale zikhoyo kwaye ziyimfihlo.
Ngokuthumela ikhowudi yomthombo, amaxwebhu, imisebenzi yobugcisa, okanye olunye igalelo kwindawo yogcino olusemthethweni lwe-Synix, ubonisa ukuba unelungelo lokuyithumela kwaye unike uJason Turner ilayisensi engapheliyo, yehlabathi lonke, engenazingcambu, engenakuguqulwa, engenamalungelo okushicilela ukusebenzisa, ukuvelisa, ukutshintsha, ukupapasha, ukuhambisa, ukufaka ilayisensi esezantsi, kunye nokufaka loo negalelo kwi-Synix.
6. I-Synix Igama kunye neBranding
Igama le-Synix, ilogo, isazisi esibonakalayo, kunye nemveliso ehambelana nayo ihlala iyimpahla kaJason Turner.
Akukho uphawu lokuthengisa okanye ilayisensi yokumakisha inikezelwa yile layisensi ngaphandle kokubonisa igama elingaguqukiyo le-Synix kunye nokumakisha ngelixa usebenzisa iSoftware.
Ukusetyenziswa okungagunyaziswanga kwe-Synix branding kunokuphula ilungelo lokushicilela, uphawu lwentengiso, ukhuphiswano olungekho sikweni, okanye eminye imithetho esebenzayo.
7. Ukuqukumbela
Amalungelo akho aphantsi kwale layisensi aphela ngokuzenzekelayo ukuba uphula nawuphi na umgaqo wale layisensi.
Emva kokupheliswa, kufuneka:
- Yeka ukusebenzisa nokuguqula iSoftware. - Yeka ukusasaza okanye ukubonisa nayiphi na ikopi engagunyaziswanga. - Susa iikopi ezingagunyaziswanga zikawonke-wonke, imibhalo-ngqangi, izipili, okanye ukuzikhuphela phantsi kolawulo lwakho. - Cima iikopi zobuqu xa kufunwa ngumthetho.
Amacandelo aphathelele ubunikazi, izithintelo, imirhumo, ukuyeka uxanduva kunye nokukhutshwa komthetho ayasinda ekuphelisweni.

Ukufumana i-Synix kuphela kula mithombo isemthethweni:
- https://github.com/ubidzz/Synix-Control-Panel/releases - https://synix.info
Iikopi ezibonelelwe kwamanye amawebhsayithi aziqinisekiswanga nguJason Turner kwaye zinokuba zingasakhuselekanga, zilungisiwe, ziphelelwe lixesha okanye zidityaniswe nesoftware engafunekiyo. Ukhuseleko lwabo nokuchana kwabo akuqinisekiswa nguJason Turner.
Ukudwelisa i-Synix, ukudibanisa kwi-GitHub, okanye ukunikezela ukukhuphela akudlulisi ubunikazi okanye kubandakanya igunya, unxulumano, ukuqinisekiswa, okanye isimo esisemthethweni. I-Synix ihlala iyimpahla kaJason Turner.
Ukubamba, ukubukela imifanekiso, ukuthumela imiyalezo, ukupakisha kwakhona okanye ukupakisha izinto ezikhutshelweyo kufuna imvume ebhaliweyo. Ikhonkco kumthombo osemthethweni aliboneleli ngaloo mvume.
Icandelo le-4.2 alithinteli amakhonkco aqhelekileyo ngqo kula mithombo esemthethweni echaza ngokuchanekileyo i-Synix kunye noJason Turner. Ezi ziqhagamshelo azenzi iwebhusayithi enxibelelanisa ibe ngumthombo osemthethweni.
Iphakheji ye-WinGet ubidzz.Synix yindlela yokufaka evunyiweyo xa ikhuphela umfakisi ongatshintshanga ngqo kwiinguqulelo ezisemthethweni ze-GitHub. Oku akuvumeli ukusingathwa okanye ukupakishwa ngokutsha.
13. Ukusetyenziswa Komsebenzi Ophilayo Neenkcukacha Zobumfihlo
I-Synix ibandakanya i-counter yokusebenza ebukhoma ekhethwayo eqikelela inani leeseshoni eziqhubayo ze-Synix kwi-https://synix.info. Olu phawu lunikwe amandla ngokungagqibekanga. Ungayicima nangaliphi na ixesha kwiSettings > Privacy & Security > Share active count ngaphandle kokunciphisa ezinye iimpawu zeSynix. I-preference egcinwe ngaphambili iyahlonitshwa.
Ngelixa inikwe amandla, i-Synix ithumela umqondiso wobukho be-HTTPS kwi-https://synix.info/api/presence ngexesha lokuqalisa kwaye malunga nemizuzu nganye ye-10 ngelixa usebenza usetyenziso, kubandakanya nangasemva. Isiginali iqulethe ikhowudi yeseshoni yethutyana kunye ne-generic Synix application identifier, ngaphandle komyalezo womzimba. Ikhowudi yeseshoni igcinwa kuphela kwimemori kwaye ithathelwe indawo xa kuqalisa iseshoni entsha yokunika ingxelo; akusiyo isazisi esisigxina semveliso.
Ikhawuntara ayilayishi igama lakho, idilesi ye-imeyile, amaphasiwedi, umncedisi okanye ulwazi lomdlali, amaxabiso okulungelelanisa, iifayile, okanye izikhombisi zomatshini.
Kwiseshoni nganye, i-counter yewebhsayithi igcina kuphela i-hash yekhowudi yeseshoni kunye nexesha lesiginali yakutshanje. IWebhsayithi kawonke-wonke ibonisa kuphela inani elipheleleyo labantu abasebenzayo, elilinganiso kunokuba libalwe abantu abahlukeneyo. Iseshoni iyeka ukubala emva kwemizuzu ye15 ngaphandle kwesiginali. Iirekhodi ezingasebenziyo ze-counter ziya kuba zifanelekile ukucocwa emva kwemizuzu ye-30 kwaye zisuswe xa izicelo ezilandelayo ze-counter zenza ukucocwa. I-Synix ayidibanisi ezi rekhodi zokubhekisa kwiiakhawunti zomphathi ekude okanye izikhombisi zekhompyuter ezibini.
Ukucima le nkalo kuyamisa ezinye izibonakaliso zobukho kwaye kwenza isicelo esinye sokwenza konke okusemandleni ukususa iseshoni yangoku. Ukuvalwa kwe-Synix kwakhona kuzama ukususwa; ukuba ukususwa akufikeleli kwiwebhusayithi, iseshoni iyeka ukubalwa ngokuzenzekelayo emva kwexesha lokungasebenzi.
Njengalo naluphi na unxibelelwano lwe-Intanethi, iinkonzo zokubamba iwebhusayithi zifumana ulwazi oluqhelekileyo lonxibelelwano, njengedilesi ye-IP yoqobo kunye nexesha lokucela, kwaye zinokuqhubekeka okanye zibhalise phantsi kwemigaqo-nkqubo yazo yobumfihlo. Olu lwazi alugcinwanga kwitheyibhile ye-Synix yokulinganisa imisebenzi okanye iboniswe kulungelelwaniso loluntu.
14. Ukufikelela Okude Ubumfihlo Nokhuseleko
I-14.1 Ukufikelela ngokuzikhethela kunye nokungathengiswa kwedatha
Ulawulo olukude kwi-https://manager.synix.info alufanelekanga kwaye lukhubazekile de unxibelelanise ikhompyuter uze uvume iakhawunti efuna isicelo kwi-app ye-Synix kuloo khompyutha. Ungasebenzisa i-Synix kwindawo yakho ngaphandle kweakhawunti yomphathi. Ikhawuntara yomsebenzi kawonke-wonke yahlukile kwaye inokupheliswa ngokuzimeleyo.
I-Synix ayithengisi, ayiqeshi, ayithengisi okanye idalule ulwazi lwakho lweakhawunti, ulwazi lweekhompyuter ezibini, umsebenzi ekude, okanye ulwazi lweseva kubathengisi okanye kubathengisi bedatha. I-Synix ayisebenzisi le ngcaciso kwintengiso ekujoliswe kuyo okanye yakha iiprofayili zentengiso kuyo. Ulwazi lusetyenziselwa ukubonelela ngeempawu ozikhethileyo, ukuqinisekisa ukufikelela, ukusebenzisa inkonzo nokukhusela ekusetyenzisweni kakubi.
Ukufikelela ekude akusiyo inkonzo yokugcina engenanto. Le nkampani ifuna iirekhodi ezikhawulezileyo zeakhawunti, ukudibanisa, ukusebenza nokhuseleko ezichazwe ngezantsi. Ezi ngxelo azipapashwa kwi-counter yomsebenzi kawonkewonke okanye zivezwe kwezinye iiakhawunti zabaphathi ngenkonzo.
14.2 Yintoni Ehlala Kwikhompyutha Yakho
I-Synix ayilayishi ngokuzenzekelayo imihlaba yomdlalo, iifayile zomncedisi womdlalo, umxholo wefayile yokulungelelanisa, umxholo wokugcina i-archive, imveliso ekrwada yekhonsoli, okanye amaphasiwedi agciniweyo omncedisi womdlalo. Ukugcina i-backup ekude kunye nokubuyisela ukusebenza kwikhompyuter edibeneyo; iifayile zesekhowudi zihlala kwiindawo ezilungiselelwe apho. Ukuba ukhetha ukubetha umyalelo wekhonsoli yomdlalo kwiwebhsayithi, umbhalo wayo uya kuqhutywa uze uthunyelwe kwikhompyutha ehambelanayo, kuquka naziphi na iindleko ezibuthathaka ozifaka kuloo ndinyana. Umphathi akakho kwindawo yokugcina i-cloud backup kwaye akaboneleli ngedesktop ekude engenamda, ukufikelela komyalelo we-Windows, okanye ukuphequlula iifayile ngokubanzi.
I-Synix igcina useto lwayo lwasekuhlaleni, uluhlu lweseva, imbali, i-backup, kunye nemeko yokubambisana kwikhompyuter yakho. Isitshixo sokutyikitya esikwiikhompyutha eziqhotyoshelweyo sihlala kwindawo yokugcina isitshixo seWindows. I-Synix ikhetha ukugcinwa okuxhaswe yi-TPM xa kukho kwaye ngenye indlela ixhasa isitshixo sesoftware esikhuselwe yi-Windows, kubandakanya nee-VM ezihambelanayo. Ukufumaneka kwe-TPM akuqinisekisi ukuba ikhompyutha ayithintelwa.
Ezi ngxelo zichaza ulawulo olukude lweSynix. Imidlalo, i-Steam, ii-mods, ukudityaniswa kwe-Discord, ukuthunyelwa kwamanye amazwe, kunye neengxelo zenkxaso ozikhethelayo ukuba wabelane ngazo zinokuhamba kwedatha yazo. Musa ukubeka amaphasiwedi okanye olunye ulwazi olubucayi kumagama ekhompyutha, amagama omncedisi, okanye amagama eefayile ezikhuselekileyo, kuba ezo ileyibhile zinokubonakala kumphathi.
I-14.3 Ulwazi lweenkqubo kunye neendawo zokugcina
- Iakhawunti kunye nokuqinisekiswa: Igama lomsebenzisi olikhethileyo, isazisi seakhawunti, ixesha lokudala, ukhetho lokhuseleko, i-hash yephasiwedi enetyuwa, imfihlo yokuqinisekisa ekhutshelweyo xa inikwe amandla, iziqinisekiso zikawonke-wonke zesitshixo sokugqitha xa inikwe amandla, kunye neerekhodi zokuqinisekisa/zeseshoni zethutyana. Amaphasiwedi kunye neekhowudi zokuqinisekisa ziqhutywa ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukungena; amaphasiwedi angunaphakade awagcinwanga njengombhalo ofundekayo. I-Synix ayifumani umnwe wakho, umfanekiso wobuso, isitshixo sangasese sepasskey, okanye isitshixo sokusayina sangasese sekhompyuter ehambelanayo. Ubhaliso alufuni igama lokwenene okanye idilesi ye-imeyile. - Ukudibanisa nokuqhagamshela: Ilebheli yekhompyutha oyikhethileyo, isazisi esizenzekelayo sefowuni, isitshixo sayo sokutyikitya esidlangalaleni, unxibelelwano lweakhawunti, uhlobo lomnikezeli wesitshixo ochaziweyo, imeko yokwamkelwa kokudibanisa kunye nexesha lokugqibela lokuqhagamshela. Unxibelelwano oluthe cwaka lwe-relay oluqinisekisiweyo lunokuhlala luvulekile ngelixa i-Synix isebenza ukuze iwebhusayithi ivuse usetyenziso oluhambelanayo kwangoko. I-relay ithwala izilumkiso zokuvusa / ukucima uxhumano kunye nemethadatha yoqhagamshelwano, hayi iifayile zomdlalo okanye iifoto zeserver. - Isimo esibonisiweyo: Izikhombisi zeseva ezinomda, amagama, amagama omdlalo, imeko yokusebenza, inani labadlali, ixesha lokusebenza, iintshukumo ezikhoyo, ixesha lokugcina / imeko, ukufundwa okudibeneyo kwe-CPU kunye ne-RAM evela kwiinkqubo ezisebenzayo zomncedisi womdlalo (kubandakanya abaqalisi kunye nabasebenzi babo abalandelayo), kunye ne-CPU ekhethekileyo yekhompyuter epheleleyo, esetyenzisiweyo / iyonke ye-RAM, kunye namaxabiso okuhambisa / okufumana kwinethiwekhi. Amanani eenethiwekhi zekhompyutha aquka ukugcwala kwe-LAN kwii-adaptha ze-gateway ezisebenzayo; ii-adaptha zokuchonga, iidilesi ze-IP, umxholo wepakethi, kunye neendawo zokukhangela azithunyelwanga ngezi zifundo. I-app ithumela ezi zihlomelo ngelixa ukubonwa komlawuli okuqinisekisiweyo kusebenza. CPU/RAM updates cover paired computers; Ukuhlaziywa okuneenkcukacha kweseva kugubungela ikhompyutha ekhethiweyo. Ukuhlaziywa ngokuqhelekileyo kuqhuba yonke imizuzwana ye-10 kwaye kuyeka emva kokuba ukubonwa okusebenzayo kuvaliwe, kunqunyulwe, kuphelelwe lixesha okanye kufihlwe njengoko kufanelekile. Ezinye iiseshoni zesikhangeli esisebenzayo zinokuzigcina zisebenza. - Izenzo ezicelwayo kunye ne-backups: Izikhombisi zeseva / zesenzo, ixesha lesicelo, inkqubela phambili / isiphumo, kwaye, xa ucela ukhetho lwesikhombisi, izikhombisi zesikhombisi, amagama eefayile, imihla, ubungakanani kunye namathegi obugqibeleleyo. Iziqulatho zokulondoloza kunye neendlela ezipheleleyo zasekuhlaleni azithunyelwa kule nkalo. - Imiyalelo ye-Game Console: Isazisi somdlalo esingacacanga, imvume yokuvula ixesha elifutshane, kunye neetekisi zomyalelo ozithumelayo. Umbhalo olindelweyo ubhaliswe kwiziko ledatha yenkonzo kwaye ususwe kuloo rekhodi xa ukuhanjiswa kugunyazisiwe. Ayibandakanyiwe kuluhlu lwezenzo zakutshanje okanye kwiirekhodi zesaziso seakhawunti. Isiphumo sokuhanjiswa sithetha ukuba isicatshulwa sathunyelwa kumdlalo, kungekhona ukuba lo mdlalo uyamkela okanye uyigqibile. Iimpendulo zomdlalo nomthi wenkqubo wasekuhlaleni azilayishwanga. - Ukhuseleko nokukhuselwa kakubi: Uhlobo lokungena olungaphumelelanga, inani kunye nexesha lokuzama ukudibanisa, uhlobo lomcimbi wokubuyisela / wokhuseleko, kunye neetekiti zekhompyuter ezifanelekileyo. Iirekhodi ezihlala ixesha elifutshane zemida yentlawulo zingasebenzisa i-hashes ekhethiweyo yeedilesi zonxibelelwano ze-IP kunye nezichazi zeakhawunti. Iirekhodi ze-akhawunti ze-Synix azinazo izilumkiso zamaphasiwedi, iikhowudi zokuqinisekisa, iidilesi ze-IP ezingasetyenziswanga, okanye iminwe yesikhangeli. Ababoneleli bokubamba banokucwangcisa ngokwahlukeneyo ulwazi lokuqhagamshelana njengoko kuchaziwe kwiCandelo 14.6.
Le webhusayithi ngokuzenzekelayo icwangcisa izishwankathelo ezivunyelweyo kunye nemiyalelo yokubonelela ngolawulo olukude. I-HTTPS kunye nonxibelelwano lwe-relay olubhaliweyo lukhusela ukugcwala kwabantu; oku akuthethi ukuba inkonzo yokubamba ayikwazi ukucwangcisa idatha.
14.4 Ukugcinwa nokuCinywa
- Iinkcukacha zesazisi kunye nezilungiso zeakhawunti zihlala de iakhawunti icinywe. Iirekhodi zokudibanisa ezivunyiweyo zihlala zikhona de ikhompyutha ingadibani okanye iakhawunti icinywe. - Iifoto zesimo kunye nokufundwa kweCPU/RAM ziguqulwa ngokufundwa okutsha kwaye zifanelekile ukucocwa emva kwemizuzu ye15 ngaphandle kokutshintshwa. Ixesha lokugqibela lokuqhagamshelana lihlala liyinxalenye yerekhodi yokudibanisa. - Iirekhodi zemiyalelo ekude, iziphumo, kunye neenkcukacha-matriki ezibuyiselweyo zokukhetha ukhuphelo ziya kuba zifanelekile ukucocwa emva kweeyure ze24. - Imiyalelo ye-game-console eseleyo iphela emva kwemizuzwana ye30. umbhalo ongakhange uhanjiswe uba nelungelo lokucinywa xa uphelelwa lixesha okanye upheliswa; ukuhanjiswa okuvunyiweyo kuya kuqinisekisa ngoko nangoko. Ukuvunywa kwekhonsoli kuyaphela kwimizuzu emithathu. Isazisi sesenzo kunye nesiphumo sokuhanjiswa esisigxina silandela ixesha lokurekhoda isenzo se-24-iyure. - Iziganeko zokuphilisa/zokhuseleko kunye nezilumkiso zokungena ezingaphumelelanga ziya kuba zifanelekile ukucocwa emva kweentsuku ze90. Ukubhalisa okungaphumelelanga kugcina ubuninzi beqela lakutshanje le100; Ukungaphumeleli okuhambelanayo ngexesha le-10-minute lihlanganiswe kunye. - Iiseshoni zesikhangeli ziphela emva kwemizuzu ye30 ngaphandle kwesicelo somlawuli okanye emva kweeyure ze8 ngokubanzi. Imizamo yokuqinisekisa iphela emva kwemizuzu ye5; ukubuyiswa kwephasiwedi okwethutyana kuphelelwa lixesha kwimizuzu ye-10 kwaye kusetyenziswa kube kanye. Iirekhodi eziphelelwe lixesha zokuqinisekisa, ukubuyisela kwakhona, ukukhuselwa kokuphindaphinda kunye nemida yexabiso ziyacinywa ngexesha lokucoca. Ubhaliso lweakhawunti engaphelelanga lufanelekile ukucocwa emva kweeyure ze-24.
Ukuphelelwa lixesha kuyayeka ukugunyaziswa kwanangaphambi kokuba irekhodi lisuswe ngokwasemzimbeni. Ukuhlanjululwa kwedatha ye-routine kuqhutywa ngexesha lokucela inkonzo elandelayo, ubuninzi kube kanye ngemizuzu ye-10 yokucoca umlawuli, ngoko ke la maxesha angentla ngamaxesha okuphelelwa lixesha okanye amaxesha afanelekileyo okucoca kunokuba sithembise ukucima ngexesha elifanelekileyo. Iirekhodi zabathengisi kunye neekopi zokukhusela zinemijikelezo yobomi eyahlukeneyo.
Unpairing ususa i pairing ekhethiweyo kunye neerekhodi zayo ezikude ezinxulumene nayo kwisiseko sedatha yenkonzo esebenzayo. Imbali yokubuyiselwa kwemali/ixabiso linokuhlala kwiakhawunti yexesha elingentla. Ukucima iakhawunti yomphathi kususa izikhombisi zayo, ukudibanisa, iifoto, imiyalelo, kunye neenkcukacha zokhuseleko / zokubuyisela kwiakhawunti kwisiseko sedatha yenkonzo esebenzayo. Ayicimi iiseva zakho zomdlalo, ihlabathi, izilungiso okanye iifayile zokukhusela. Iirekhodi zokuthintela ukuxhatshazwa kwezinto ezihlala ixesha elifutshane kunye neelogi okanye i-backups ezigcinwe ngumboneleli azicinywa ngoko nangoko nangayiphi na indlela.
14.5 Ulawulo lwakho kunye nokukhuselwa kokungena
Ukungena ngemvume kufuna iphasiwedi yakho kunye nesitshixo sokugqitha esikhoyo okanye umqinisekisi, onje nge-Google Authenticator. Iiakhawunti ezilungiselelwe ukuba zifune zombini iindlela zigcina zombini iimfuno. Ukutshintsha iphasiwedi, ukususa ikhompyutha kwiwebhsayithi nokucima iakhawunti yomphathi kufuna ukuqinisekiswa ngokutsha kolo tshintsho.
Ukuvula i-input ye-game console eyenziwe ngokwezifiso ikwafuna iphasiwedi yeakhawunti yangoku kunye nokuqinisekiswa okutsha ngokweemfuno zendlela ekhoyo yeakhawunti. Ukuvunywa kunxulunyaniswa neseshoni enye yesiphequluli, ikhompyutha ehambelanayo, umncedisi ogciniweyo kunye nomdlalo ophilayo oqhutywa ukuya kuthi ga kwimizuzu emithathu. Ukuyeka, ukuqala kwakhona, ikhonsoli evaliweyo, ukuseta ikhonsoli ekhubazekileyo okanye inkqubo elahlekileyo kuthintela imiyalelo eyongezelelweyo. Ukuqhawula okanye ukufihla ithebhu yomlawuli kuphelisa ukuvunywa kwale tab. Amaqhosha aqhelekileyo okusebenza kweseva agcina iimfuno zawo zangoku zokungena. kuphela izixhumanisi zokungena ezixhaswa ngumdlalo zifanelekile; isazisi esikhethekileyo sodwa asivumeli ukubhala kwi-Windows command prompt.
Ikhompyutha eqhotyoshelweyo evunyiweyo ngaphambili inokukhupha iphasiwedi yethutyana ukuba ulibele iphasiwedi yewebhusayithi yakho. Ayikwazi ukukhetha enye iakhawunti. Iphasiwedi yethutyana ayinakugqitha okanye isuse iimfuno zakho ezikhoyo zephasiwedi / zokuqinisekisa, kwaye kufuneka ukhethe iphasiwedi entsha ngaphambi kokungena kumphathi. Ukugqibezela ukubuyiswa kuphelisa ezinye iiseshoni zesikhangeli sakho.
Umphathi we-Synix ugcina i-login token yesikhangeli sakhe kwimemori yethebhu yangoku, hayi kwiicookies, kwindawo yokugcina indawo, okanye kwindawo yokugcina iseshoni. Ukuhlaziya okanye ukuvala ithebhu kuphelisa ukungena ngemvume. Oku akuthinteli umkhangeli wakho okanye umphathi wephasiwedi ukuba agcine ii-credentials xa ukhetha, kwaye akuchazi ii-cookies ezibekwe ngokwahlukeneyo ngababoneleli bokusingathwa / ukhuseleko okanye inkonzo yokuguqulela iwebhusayithi kawonkewonke.
Ungaphuma, ucime zonke iiseshoni zesikhangeli, okanye unqande ikhompyutha. Uhlelo lokusebenza lwasekuhlaleni lweSynix lunokukhubaza kwaye lungasebenzi uxhulumaniso olukude ngaphandle kokungena kwiwebhusayithi. Xa ungaxhunyiwe kwi-intanethi, uyeka ukufikelela ekude kwindawo kwaye uzama kwakhona ukususa iwebhusayithi xa kukho unxibelelwano. Ukuqalisa kwakhona usetyenziso okanye i-Windows ayibuyiseli ngokuzenzekelayo ukudibanisa okususwe ngokucacileyo. Ukusetyenziswa kwasekuhlaleni kuphela kusekho.
14.6 Ukusingathwa, Amaphepha Oluntu, kunye neMida yoKhuseleko
Iwebhusayithi esemthethweni isebenzisa iiSayithi ze-OpenAI zokubamba kunye neenkonzo ze-Cloudflare zokuhanjiswa, ukugcinwa, ukhuseleko kunye nokukhutshwa. Aba baboneleli baqhuba ulwazi olufunekayo ukubonelela ngezi nkonzo kwaye banokufumana iidilesi ze-IP, bacele iintloko, amaxesha kunye nezinye iinkcukacha-manani zonxibelelwano, okanye bagcine iirekhodi zabo zokusebenza kunye neekopi zokugcina. Imigaqo-nkqubo yabo yobumfihlo iyasebenza ekusetyenzisweni kwabo: https://openai.com/policies/privacy-policy/ kunye nehttps://www.cloudflare.com/privacypolicy/.
Ukuguqulelwa ngokuzenzekelayo kwephepha loluntu kunye nokukhuphela i-GitHub kubandakanya ababoneleli babo. Umphathi wabucala wahlukile kumaphepha karhulumente kwaye akalayishi umboneleli wenguqulelo karhulumente okanye izikripthi zentengiso. I-Synix ayithethi ngokubanzi ukuba ukutyelela nayiphi na iwebhusayithi akuvelisi cookies, ii-logs okanye idatha egcinwe. Ulwazi lunokudluliselwa kwakhona xa kufunwa ngokusemthethweni; Isibophelelo esingathengiswayo esingasentla asithinteli ukusingathwa okuyimfuneko okanye ukubhengezwa okusemthethweni.
I-Synix isebenzisa ukudibanisa okuqinisekisiweyo, izicelo zekhompyuter ezisayinwe, unxibelelwano lwenethiwekhi olubhaliweyo, ukuhlolwa kokufikelela kwiakhawunti, kunye nokuvunywa kwexesha elifutshane ukunciphisa ukufikelela okungagunyaziswanga. Ezi ziqinisekiso azenzi ukuba ukufikelela kude kube semngciphekweni okanye ziqinisekise ukhuseleko ngokuchasene nazo zonke iintlekele, ikhompyutha / isikhangeli esiphazamisekileyo, iindlela zokuqinisekisa ezibiweyo, okanye inkonzo ephazamisekileyo. Gcina i-Synix ne-Windows zihlaziyiwe, khusela iakhawunti yakho kunye neendlela zokuqinisekisa, kwaye wamkele kuphela iikhompyuter kunye neeakhawunti ozilawulayo.
Esi saziso sipapashwe kwi-https://synix.info/license/ kwaye sifakwe kwiziko loncedo kunye nomfaki weapp. Imibuzo yobumfihlo inokuphakanyiswa ngeendlela ezisemthethweni zenkxaso kwihttps://synix.info/support/. Musa ukuthumela amaphasiwedi, iikhowudi zokubuyisela kwimeko yesiqhelo, okanye olunye ulwazi lweakhawunti yabucala kwimiyalezo yenkxaso yoluntu. Ukuhlaziywa kwesi saziso kubandakanya ukuhlaziywa kunye nomhla omtsha.

data.name: Content.3EDF002B53C15DD7A21D
data.value:
Vula izicwangciso → Chaza ingxaki ukuze ulungiselele ingxelo, okanye sebenzisa iinkcukacha zenkxaso ezisezantsi.
Yenza INTO EYENZEKAYO Iphinde Yenzeke Faka indlela yokufaka, iinguqulelo zeSynix kunye neWindows ozisebenzisayo, umdlalo/iprofayili, kunye neenkcukacha ezifanelekileyo zohlelo/umthumeli.
Chaza: • Oko ukuchofozile okanye ukuguquleyo. • Yintoni owayilindele nento eyenzekayo. • Iphutha elichanekileyo kunye nesicatshulwa esifutshane esimalunga nexesha laso. • Ngaba le nkqubo yayisebenza ngaphambili yaye yintoni etshintshileyo.
INQAKU ELINGUMXHOLO NGAPHAMBI KOKWAbelana Susa amaphasiwedi, iithokheni, ii-URL ze-webhook, iindlela zobuqu, nolwazi lwenethiwekhi olungafuniyo ukuba lube loluntu. Imodi yobumfihlo ayizicoci zonke iifayile eziqhotyoshelweyo. Musa ukufaka iirekhodi ezigqibeleleyo okanye iinkqubo zomdlalo ngaphandle kokuzijonga.
Kwiphepha lokuguqulela, faka ulwimi olukhethiweyo, igama lefestile kunye namabinzana acacileyo. Kwingxaki yokuchazwa komdlalo, faka isicwangciso sokufakelwa esilungisiweyo kunye namaxwebhu omdlalo afanelekileyo.
IINKCUKACHA Ezisemthethweni Iingxelo zemveliso: https://github.com/ubidzz/Synix-Control-Panel/issues
Uluntu Discord: https://discord.gg/WduKEU3j8s
Indawo yokugcina iprojekthi: https://github.com/ubidzz/Synix-Control-Panel
Ufakelo okanye ukwakhiwa kwesicelo esiphumeleleyo asikwazi ukuvavanya yonke imidlalo, iimod kunye nemeko yenethiwekhi. Amanyathelo okuvelisa ngokucacileyo anceda ukwahlula ingxaki yeSynix kumdlalo okanye ingxaki yokuseta umamkeli.

data.name: Content.3FCD178C083A4D548FE7
data.value:
Cofa kumgca weserver ngaphambi kokuba usebenzise ulawulo ezantsi. Umgca okhethiweyo uchaza ukuba yeyiphi iseva isenzo esichaphazelayo.
FUNDA INKOSI Sebenzisa ibhokisi yokukhangela ukuhluza ngegama lomdlalo okanye lomncedisi. Inkqubo yokucoca ulwelo iyanciphisa uludwe. Ukuba kukho into ebonakala ingekho, cima zombini iifayile ngaphambi kokuba ucinge ukuba icinywe.
Funda ISIFUNDO • Iiseva ezifakweyo zibala ukungena kweseva okubhalisiweyo. • I-Running Now ibonisa amanqaku okwangoku axelwe njengasebenza. • Ukusetyenziswa kweCPU kunye nokusetyenziswa kweRAM zichaza yonke iPC, hayi i-Synix kuphela. • Idatha yomdlali iyafumaneka kuphela xa umdlalo okhethiweyo ubonisa umthombo oxhaswayo.
UKUHLOLWA Mihla Le • Qalisa, Misa uze Uqale kwakhona ukulawula umncedisi okhethiweyo. • Ukucwangcisa kuvula amasango okucwangcisa. • Ukulungela kuhlolisisa imiba enokuthintela ukuba isebenze. • Iinketho zeseva ziqulethe iifayile, ulondolozo, unxibelelwano kunye nezixhobo ezithile zomdlalo. • Nqakraza kabini kumgca ukuze uhlolisise ngakumbi loo nkonzo.
Umsebenzi & Ukuxilongwa kubonisa inkqubela phambili kunye nezilumkiso ezifanelekileyo. Funda umyalezo wokugqibela ngaphambi kokuba uphinde wenze into. I-CLEAR ikhupha indawo ebonakalayo yomsebenzi; akuyomyalelo wokucima zonke iifayile zoluhlu.
Inkqubo eqhubekayo ayilungiselelwanga abadlali. Ukufakwa, ukulayishwa kwehlabathi, izivumelwano, kunye nokusekwa kwemidlalo kunokuqhubeka emva kokuba inkqubo ivele. Qinisekisa ukulungele kwi-log yomdlalo ngokujoyina.

data.name: Content.3FDD32467F5AC4908CBA
data.value:
Vula iinketho zeseva → Mod & Plugin Manager kwiprofayile exhaswayo. I-Synix ifumanisa umxholo ofakiweyo kunye neendawo ezixhaswayo; asiyoncwadi equkethe zonke iimod.
FAKELISA IPAKHA LOKAL 1. Yenza isiqinisekiso sehlabathi, izongezo ezikhoyo, kunye nokulungelelaniswa okuchaphazelekayo. 2. Yima umncedisi ngeSynix uze ulinde ukuba iqela lenkqubo layo liphume. 3. Jonga inkqubo eyongezelelweyo efunyenweyo, indawo yokufaka kunye noluhlu lokukhusela. 4. Khetha ukufaka kwiFayile okanye ukungenisa iphakheji kwifayile exhaswayo, i-ZIP, okanye ifolda ye-mod epheleleyo. Ukhetho olukhoyo luxhomekeke kwinkqubo yokongeza yomdlalo. 5. Hlola indawo oya kuyo, isiphumo sokukhangela, izilumkiso nokuqinisekisa. 6. Vumela ukucwangcisa, ukuxhasa nokufakela kugqitywe. 7. I-Synix ihlaziya uluhlu xa kugqitywe ukufakelwa. Qalisa kwakhona ukuba kuyimfuneko, emva koko khangela ilog yomdlalo kunye nonxibelelwano lomxhasi.
Olu luhlu lubonisa indawo ekhethiweyo yokufaka. Sebenzisa iSearch ukuze ufumane isongezelelo ngegama, uhlobo, umthombo, okanye indlela. Ukuhlaziya kuskena kwakhona kwaye kugcina into ekhethiweyo xa isekho. Umbono olula ufihla iinkcukacha ezithile zobugcisa ngaphandle kokugqitha ukuhlolwa.
Gcina ifestile ivulekile ngelixa uskena okanye utshintsho luqhubeka. I-Synix ikhubaza imisebenzi engqubanayo de igqibe. Ukuba isenzo asiphumelelanga, funda impazamo yaso uze uhlaziye uluhlu ngaphambi kokuba uzame kwakhona.
Iintlobo zeentshukumo zomsebenzi Iinkqubo zokusebenza ezixhaswayo ziquka iiphakheji ze-Minecraft JAR, iiplagi ze-Rust Oxide / uMod, iiphakheji zasekuhlaleni ze-7 Days to Die, iimeko ze-Empyrion kunye neemodyuli zeseva, ii-ID ze-ARK: Survival Evolved Workshop, kunye nee-ID zomnikezeli we-ARK: Survival Ascended. Ezinye iinkqubo zibonakala kuphela okanye zifuna isakhelo sazo kuqala.
Kwi-ID yomboneleli, i-Synix ilawula ulungelelwaniso oluxhaswayo ngelixa umdlalo / umboneleli ekhupha umxholo. Umxholo ongakhange ulande awukwazi ukuskena kwangaphambi kwendawo.
Oko Iitsheki Zingakwenza Nento Ezingakwaziyo Ukuyenza Ukungenisa ukujonga ulungelelwaniso lwepakethi kunye neendawo eziya kuyo kwaye ukwala iindlela ezingakhuselekanga, amakhonkco, umxholo ongasebenziyo ongavumelekanga, iipakethe ezinkulu, iindawo eziphindaphindiweyo, kunye nokufunyanwa kwe-malware eqinisekisiweyo.
Isikena seDefender esingafumanekiyo okanye esingekhoyo sisilumkiso, kungekhona ubungqina be-malware. Ukuskena okucocekileyo kunye nokurekhodwa kwe-hash akubonisi ukuba iphakheji yomntu wesithathu inokuthenjwa. Iimod zisebenza ngemvume ye-Windows yomncedisi.
IIKATALOG, UKUSUSUSWA KWAKHO NENKQUBO Khangela ikhathalogu ivula iwebhusayithi yomboneleli. Ayisombululi ngokuzenzekelayo ukuxhomekeka okanye ifake i-modpack epheleleyo.
Yima umncedisi ngaphambi kokungenisa kwakhona. Oku kubuyisela umva yonke imveliso ekhethiweyo, enokuthi iquke izongezo ezininzi. Ibuyisela imibhalo-ngqangi egciniweyo ize isuse iifayile ezifakwe ngolu hlobo. Ukubuyela emva kokungeniswa okutsha kuqala xa bekwabelana ngeefayile; I-Synix iyala ukubhala ngaphezulu iifayile ezitshintshiwe ngaphandle kokungenisa okanye ukusetyenziswa kwemibhalo yokuqala egciniweyo engaphumeleli ukuhlolwa kwayo. Iirekhodi ezindala zokungenisa zingabandakanyi ii-hashes zokuqala ezigcinwe.
Kwi-ID elawulwa ngumboneleli, i-Remove Selected isusa loo ID kulawulo oluxhaswayo lwe-Synix; akusiyo iphakheji yasekuhlaleni. I-Synix irekhoda utshintsho oluyenzayo, hayi lonke uhlelo olwenziwa ngesandla. Gcina izipele ezizimeleyo zeseva epheleleyo: ukususa i-mod kunokwenza ihlabathi lingakwazi ukulayishwa okanye ukususa umxholo we-mod.
Itheyibhile engenanto ithetha ukuba akukho zongezo zixhaswayo ezihambelana nendawo ekhethiweyo yokufaka kunye nokukhangela. Vula uKhangela uze ukhangele iprofayile, ifolda kunye nesakhelo ngaphambi kokuba ucinge ukuba zonke iifayile ezikwi-disk zikhangelwe.

data.name: Content.3FFA3E0258F2F0369B0C
data.value:
Vula i-Add Server → Game Support Catalog ukujonga oko uSynix akwaziyo ngomdlalo ngaphambi kokwenza idatha. Ikhathalogu isebenzisa iinkcazo ezifakwe kwisicelo sakho esifakiweyo.
1. Khangela igama lomdlalo. 2. Sebenzisa ulungelelwaniso, idatha yomdlali, ukudlala ngokudibeneyo, ukuhambelana, okanye ukuqinisekiswa kweefilitha ukunciphisa uluhlu. 3. Khetha umdlalo uze uvule iinkcukacha zawo, okanye ucofe kabini kumgca wawo. 4. Funda isicwangciso esixhaswayo, inkqubo yeserver, imfuneko esisiseko kunye nolwazi lokuqinisekisa.
Cima iifilitha ukuba umdlalo awukabikho. I-Minecraft's Java kunye ne-Bedrock ukhetho luyinxalenye yokuhamba komsebenzi wokuseta endaweni yeenkqubo ezimbini zokutshintshiselana.
Funda IZIKHONZO ZAKHO NGOKUQINISEKILEYO Iprofayili inokubonelela ngokulungiswa okulawulwayo, ukucwangciswa okukhokelwayo, izilungiselelo zokuqalisa, okanye inkxaso elinganiselweyo / esisiseko. I-Executable edwelisiweyo okanye i-Steam AppID ichaza indlela yokusebenza kofakelo; ayiqinisekisi zonke iinguqulelo zemidlalo.
Imfuneko ye-SteamCMD eqinisekisiweyo ithetha ukuba iprofayile icela ukufikelela kwiakhawunti. Ukuba ngumnini womdlalo nemithetho yomshicileli inokubeka iimfuno ezongezelelweyo.
IMIPHUMO YENKQUBO AKUKHO Uhlolisiso Lomlilo Ixabiso le-query-port eligcinweyo alibonisi ukuba umphulaphuli we-query ukhona okanye ukuba kufuneka abonakaliswe. Sebenzisa ulwakhiwo lomdlalo kunye neemfuno zeprotocol.
Ikhathalogu yindawo yokujonga iinkcazo ezifakweyo. Iirekhodi zokuqinisekisa zasekuhlaleni zibonisa oko kuye kwabonwa kule PC, kungekhona iziphumo eziqhelekileyo kumatshini ngamnye okanye kumxube weemod.

data.name: Content.45EB10CB4237CAC4A2E5
data.value:
Vula i icon gear kwi dashboard ukuze izicwangciso isicelo-wide. Sebenzisa iqhosha lokuCwangcisa lomncedisi kwizilungiselelo ezingowomncedisi kuphela.
I-GENERAL • Bonisa ulawulo lweWindows Server Console ukuba ngaba iiseva ezixhaswayo zibonisa ikhonsoli yazo. Ifestile efihliweyo ayithethi ukuba umncedisi uvaliwe. • Imodi emnyama itshintsha umxholo wesicelo. • I-SteamCMD Ukukhuphela Isantya sikhetha isantya esipheleleyo okanye umda wokukhuphela oxhaswayo. • Iinguqu zolwimi zixhaswa ziilebheli ze-interface, iid dialogs kunye nemiyalezo yesimo.
Amanye amaphepha aqukethe iindawo zokusekelayo kunye nokudluliselwa, iinketho zobumfihlo/zokhuseleko, iingxelo zeengxaki, kunye nezilungiselelo eziphambili/zasemva. Akunyanzelekanga ukuba unike amandla iinketho eziphambili ukudala umncedisi oqhelekileyo.
INDLELA YOKUZITHETHA Khetha phakathi kweelwimi ezikhethiweyo. Ulawulo lweSynix, amanqaku okunceda kunye nemiyalezo eyenziwe yi-app isebenzisa ulwimi olukhethiweyo. Imiyalelo yomdlalo, amaxabiso okulungelelanisa kunye nokuphuma kweseva yoqobo akuguqulelwa. Iifayile zeengxelo zobugcisa zigcina amagama azo okuxilonga.
Umbhalo ojongene nomdlalo awuguqulelwa: imiyalelo, izitshixo zokulungelelanisa kunye namaxabiso, amagama emephu, iindlela, amagama eefayile, iingxabano zokuqalisa, izikhombisi, kunye neetekisi zokuchonga imveliso kufuneka zihlale ngendlela umdlalo olindele ngayo.
Ukutshintsha ulwimi lomdibaniso akutshintshi isicatshulwa semiyalelo yomdlalo okanye ukuguqulela imveliso yekhonsoli. Ukuba itheyibhile eqhelekileyo yeSynix ayizange iguqulelwe ngokungalindelekanga, chaza indlela echazwe ngayo, ifestile kunye nolwimi olukhethiweyo.

data.name: Content.493BAB772B40AABA8979
data.value:
Vula izicwangciso → Ubumfihlo & Ukhuseleko ngaphambi kokwabelana ngesikrini okanye ukujonga iinketho zokhuseleko.
INDLELA YOKUPHILA Iimaski zendlela yobumfihlo zixhasa ukuboniswa okubuthathaka, njengedilesi kunye neenkcukacha. Ayitshintshi i-IP yakho kawonke-wonke, ibonakalise ukugcwala kwenethiwekhi, okanye ihlambulule yonke ilog yomdlalo kunye neefayile zokulungelelanisa.
Hlola umfanekiso wesikrini ngaphambi kokuba wabelane ngawo. Isenzo sokukopa kwintsimi efihliweyo sisenokukopa ixabiso lokwenyani.
Amaphasiwedi neeTokeni Ezihlangulwe I-Synix ikhusela amaphasiwedi agciniweyo axhaswayo, iithokheni kunye namaxabiso e-webhook kumsebenzisi wangoku we-Windows. Umdlalo usenokufuna izatifikethi ezifundekayo kwisakhiwo sayo okanye iingxoxo zokuqalisa.
Ikopi yefolda eqhelekileyo kwenye i-akhawunti ye-Windows ayiqinisekisi ukuba loo maxabiso akhuselweyo angavulwa. Sebenzisa inkqubo yokusebenza yokudluliselwa okufihliweyo yokufuduka kwee-credentials ezixhaswayo.
IINKCWADI ZOKUVUMELWA Qhuba i-Synix kunye nee-server zomdlalo eziqhelekileyo ezineemvume eziqhelekileyo ze-Windows. utshintsho lwenkqubo ethile okanye isibhengezo somdlalo sinokucela ukuphakama ngokwahlukeneyo; akukho sizathu sokusebenzisa yonke into ngokusisigxina njengomlawuli.
Iingxaki zokucoca i-firewall ezingacwangciswanga zixhaswa yimithetho elahlukileyo yeSynix. Ukuhlolisisa imigaqo ecetywayo ngaphambi kokwamkela ukususwa. Aliphathi zonke iifolda ezenziwe ngokwezifiso okanye avumele ukususwa kwemithetho ye-firewall engathandekiyo.
Ukuba imfihlelo ityhilwa, mayitshintshwe okanye icitshwe kwinkonzo eyayinikayo. Ukufihla intsimi okanye ukususa ikopi egciniweyo yeSynix akuyitshintshi loo ngcaciso kwenye indawo.

data.name: Content.5157BE079A5B48521112
data.value:
Ukuvala ifestile yomntwana, ukunciphisa i-Synix, nokuphuma ngokucacileyo kwisicelo zizenzo ezahlukeneyo. Hlola indlela oziphethe ngayo uze uphume.
Ukuvula Iphaneli Yokulawula I-Synix inokuqonda iinkqubo zeseva ezixhaswayo ezisasebenza kwaye ibuyisele ubunikazi bazo. Vumela ukuhlolwa kwenkqubo yokuqala ukuba kugqitywe ngaphambi kokuqala esinye isiganeko.
Ukuchongwa kwenkqubo kufuneka kuhambelane nokufakelwa okukhethiweyo, kungekhona nje igama eliqhelekileyo. Ukupakisha ngokwezifiso okanye iinkonzo ezilawulwa ngaphandle kusenokufuna ingqalelo eyongezelelweyo.
Iinkqubo Zasemva Izicwangciso zokuqalisa / ze-arhente yangasemva ezizikhethelayo zixhasa ulawulo kwi-Windows yokungena ngemvume. Abafuneki ukuba benze umncedisi wakho wokuqala.
Umsebenzi ocwangcisiweyo udinga inkqubo efanelekileyo ye-Synix okanye i-agent, iseshoni ekhoyo ye-Windows, kunye ne-PC evukile. Ukuqalisa ukungena ngemvume akusithembisi ukuba umsebenzi uza kuqhuba ngoxa umatshini uvaliwe.
NGAPHAMBI kokuba uphinde uqale iifestile Gqibezela ukuzikhuphela, ukukhuphela nokudlulisela. Yima imidlalo ngokusebenzisa Synix ukuze bakwazi ukulondoloza ngokuqhelekileyo, uze uphume okanye uqalise kwakhona Windows.
Musa ukucinga ukuba ikhonsoli yemidlalo efihliweyo iyekile okanye ukuba ukuvala iwindow yokubeka iliso kuvala umdlalo wayo. Jonga ideshibhodi uze usebenzise ulawulo lomjikelo wobomi.

data.name: Content.57A2257D55B43047831A
data.value:
Vula isiphumo sokulungela komncedisi okhethiweyo ukuze ubone imfuneko engekhoyo. Ixesha lokuqhuba elibandakanyiweyo neSynix alithathi indawo yeemfuno ezizodwa zomdlalo.
IMISEBENZI EYAKHALAYO Iimpazamo ezikhankanya i-MSVCP140.dll okanye i-VCRUNTIME140.dll ngokuqhelekileyo zibonisa imfuneko yexesha lokuqhuba le-Visual C ++. Sebenzisa imiyalelo yomdlalo kunye ne-Microsoft ehambelana nokuxhaswa kwakhona.
Iinkcukacha ezingasasazwayo zeMicrosoft: https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/cpp/windows/latest-supported-vc-redist
Musa ukukhuphela iifayile ze-DLL ezizodwa kwiiwebhusayithi ezingaqhelekanga okanye ukubeka ii-DLL ezingahambelaniyo ecaleni kweseva esebenzayo.
Ezinye iimfuno Umdlalo unokufuna iakhawunti, ilungelo lomncedisi, ixesha elithile lokuqhuba leJava, inqaku leWindows, okanye izixhobo ezixhaswayo. Gcwalisa ezi mfuno ngaphambi kokuba utshintshe izibuko ezingahambelaniyo okanye usethe kwakhona ulungelelwaniso.
Kwi-Minecraft Java, sebenzisa indibaniselwano ye-version/loader exhaswayo kwizikhethi ze-Synix. I-Bedrock ayisebenzisi i-Java.
Kwintsebenzo efuna i-Hyper-V okanye i-hardware virtualization, khangela iimvavanyo zayo zokulungela umdlalo. Musa ukuvumela iimpawu zenkqubo okanye uqhube zonke iiseva njengomlawuli nje ukuze ugqithe isilumkiso.
Emva kokulungisa imfuneko, yenza enye ukuqala kwakhona kwaye uphonononge impazamo yokuqala enentsingiselo ye-log yomdlalo ukuba isilela.

data.name: Content.5C88F49381905FBD8C70
data.value:
I-Critical SETUP Ifunekayo:
1. I-Synix ivula uMphathi weSeva ozinikeleyo we-Space Engineers kwaye ihlala ibonakala.
2. Khetha 'Local/Console', khetha 'Continue to server configuration', faka isilungiso somncedisi nehlabathi, uze ukhethe 'Save & start'.
3. Sebenzisa umphathi wezilungiselelo eziphambili, imihlaba, iimodyuli, abalawuli, kunye nekhonsoli ephilayo. Idatha yomncedisi igcinwa ngaphakathi kwale fayile yeSynix yomncedisi weInstance.
4. Imodi yangaphambili yeLocal/Console ayidingi amalungelo omlawuli. Imodi yenkonzo yeWindows iyasebenza.
5. Iimfuno: .NET Framework 4.8 okanye zakutshanje, Visual C++ Redistributable 2013 kunye 2017, ubuncinane 6 GB yenkqubo RAM, kunye UDP port 27016 evunyelwe nge-Windows Firewall kwaye idluliselwe kubadlali be-Intanethi.
6. Uxwebhu olusemthethweni: https://www.spaceengineersgame.com/dedicated-servers/

Vala umdlalo, uze ucofe uQala kwiSynix kwakhona. I-Synix izakungenisa iifayile ezivelisiweyo ngokuzenzekelayo.

data.value:
Sebenzisa esi sikhokelo xa ukudlala kwe-LAN kusebenza kodwa uvavanyo lwedilesi yoluntu alusebenzi.
IINKCUKACHA ZAKHO ZOKUTHETHA Ezinye ii-routers azixhasi i-NAT loopback, ekwabizwa ngokuba yi-hairpinning. Unxibelelwano oluphuma ngaphakathi kwekhaya ukuya kwidilesi yalo kawonke-wonke lunokungaphumeleli naxa abadlali bangaphandle benokujoyina.
Sebenzisa idilesi ye-LAN ekhaya uze ucele omnye umntu onolunye uqhagamshelo lwe-intanethi ukuba ahlole idilesi yoluntu. Ukungaphumeleli kwe-PC WAN probe yodwa akungobungqina bokuphazamiseka kwe-intanethi.
UKUHAMBELA phambili Akwenza Umahluko Khangela omnye umzila upstream, kabini NAT, okanye umqhubi-grade NAT (CGNAT). Thelekisa ulwazi lwe-WAN ye-router kunye nedilesi yoluntu kwaye ubuze i-ISP ukuba ngaba unxibelelwano olungenayo luyaxhaswa.
Umgaqo wokuhambisa kwi-router yakho awukwazi ukuvula i-ISP elawulwa yi-NAT. Kuxhomekeka kunxibelelwano, kusenokufuneka inkonzo yedilesi yoluntu, i-VPN / itunnel efanelekileyo, okanye iseva ebanjwe. Ezi zilungiselelo zangaphandle, kungekhona iimpawu ze-Synix ezakhelwe ngaphakathi.
Musa ukudibanisa ulawulo kunye nokufikelela komdlali Uxhumano lokulawula umgama kunye noxhumano lomdlali womdlalo ziindlela ezahlukileyo. Ukuvumela izaziso zendawo ze-API okanye ze-Discord akuwenzi umdlalo ufumaneke ngokuzenzekelayo kwi-intanethi.
Gcina naziphi na iimvavanyo zenethiwekhi zilinganiselwe ngokuqinileyo kwizibuko lokwenyani lomdlalo kunye neprotocol. Musa ukupapasha amaphasiwedi, iithokheni, imifanekiso yesikrini se-router okanye iinkcukacha zenethiwekhi xa ucela uncedo.

data.name: Content.6B534A2A8D64DD2115B8
data.value:
Sebenzisa ilogo ekuloo nxalenye yaphosakeleyo.
ISICHUKO SYNIX I-Activity & Diagnostics ibonisa inkqubela phambili kunye nezilumkiso ezifanelekileyo kumsebenzisi kwideshibhodi. Ukucoca loo ndawo kucoca kuphela imiyalezo ebonakalayo; ayizicimi zonke izifo ezigcinwe.
I-LOGS yesicelo I-Synix iirekhodi zetekisi kunye neengxelo zengozi ezibulalayo zihlala phantsi: C:\Synix\SynixData\logs
I-dialog ye-crash inokuba negama lefayile ethile. Sebenzisa loo ndlela kunye nexesha lokungafumani into efanelekileyo.
Ukungabikho kokuxilongwa okuphathwayo kunokubhalwa kwi-log yombhalo ngaphandle kokuvela kwideshibhodi. Ukungabikho okubhalwe phantsi okuphathwayo akubonisi ngokuzenzekelayo ukuphazamiseka kwesicelo.
I-GAME LOGS Sebenzisa ilog yomdlalo yokwenyani yeserver ekhethiweyo ukuze ufumane iimpazamo zokulayisha umhlaba, ukucwangciswa, i-mod kunye nexesha lokusebenza komdlalo. Indawo yayo ixhomekeke kumdlalo kwaye inokuba ngaphandle kwengcambu yofakelo.
Funda NGOKUQHELEKILEYO Phawula isenzo nexesha, uze uhlolisise imiyalezo ejikeleze ukusilela kokuqala okunentsingiselo. Umgca wokuvala ekupheleni unokuba sisiphumo kunokuba ube ngunobangela.
Ngaphambi kokuba wabelane ngayo nayiphi na inxalenye, susa amaphasiwedi, iithokheni, ii-webhooks, iidilesi zabucala neendlela zobuqu. I-Satisfactory's own console/log may contain an administrator token. Gcina iirekhodi zangasese zokuqala zophando lwakho.

data.name: Content.72F10866249FA31A6B09
data.value:
Ukubuyisela kunokutshintsha umxholo wokufakwa kweseva ekhethiweyo. Khetha umncedisi ofanelekileyo uze ugcine nantoni na entsha ngaphambi kokuba uqhubeke.
1. Yima umncedisi uze wenze ikopi eyahlukileyo yeefayile ezikhoyo onokuzifuna. 2. Vula i- Restore backup workflow kwiiNketho zeSeva. 3. Khetha i-archive efunekayo uze ujonge umncedisi wayo, umhla, ubungakanani kunye nemeko yokungafihlisi. 4. Qinisekisa ngaphambi kokuba uyibuyisele. Iziqinisekiso zeSynix ezineengxelo zeSHA-256 zinokuhlolwa ngokuchasene nezo ngxelo; ii-archives ezindala zinokuchongwa njengelifa. 5. Funda isilumkiso sokutshintsha uze uqinisekise kuphela ukuba le yindawo oyifunayo. 6. Vumela ukucwangciswa kunye nokubuyiselwa kugqitywe ngaphandle kokuvala i-Synix okanye ukucima ukugcinwa. 7. Qalisa umncedisi uze uqinisekise ukuba ihlabathi elicetywayo nezilungiselelo zibuyiselwe.
OKUFUNDISWA YIBHAYIBHILE Ukuhlolwa kokungaguquguqukiyo kufumanisa utshintsho oluhambelana nentlawulo. Ayingqina ukuba umhlaba wawusempilweni xa wawusindiswa okanye ukuba amagqabantshintshi avela komnye umntu anokuthenjwa.
UKUBA INKONZO YOKUTYHUBELA ISENZEKILE Gcina i-archive kunye naziphi na iifayile zokubuyela umva okanye ukubuyisela kwakhona. Funda umyalezo wokubuyisela ngaphambi kokuba uzame enye ukubuyisela okanye ukususa iifayile.
Musa ukukhupha i-ZIP kwi-server esebenzayo. Ukuba umdlalo ugcina ulondolozo ngaphandle kwefolda yofakelo, zibuyisele ngokwahlukeneyo ngenkqubo yomdlalo exhaswayo.
Gcina isipele sokuqala de uvavanye iserver ebuyiselweyo kunye nonxibelelwano lomxhasi.

data.name: Content.730545B3639C062E1741
data.value: Iimodeli ezihlanganisiweyo ezihambelanayo zihamba kwiiMods / iCode yoMsebenzisi. Ukufanisa i-Eco kunye ne-API version kwaye ugcine iiasethi ezihambelanayo ezifunekayo.

data.name: Content.74448A2C2CBD821D56C4
data.value:
Ukungenisa iSeva esele ikhona ibhalisa ufakelo oluxhaswayo esele lukwi disk. Akusiyo ukufakwa kwakhona kwaye yahlukile ekungeniseni iphakheji epheleleyo yokudlulisa i-Synix.
NGAPHAMBI kokuba ungenise Yenza isipele esahlukileyo, kubandakanywa naluphi na ugcino ngaphandle kwefolda yofakelo. Yima umncedisi uze ucime omnye umphathi okanye umcwangcisi onokuyiqalisa ngelixa i-Synix iyilawula.
Bhalisa Ufakelo 1. Khetha Add Server → Import Server ekhoyo. 2. Khetha ifolda yokufakelwa kweseva, hayi indlela emfutshane, ifayile ye-ZIP, okanye ifolda yomxhasi womdlalo. 3. Vumela i-Synix ayihlole, emva koko qinisekisa umdlalo ofunyenweyo, uhlelo, isebenze kunye nezilungiso. 4. Nika ingxelo igama elikhethekileyo kwaye ugcwalise nayiphi na ixabiso elilahlekileyo. 5. Gqibezela ukungenisa, uvule iConfigure uze ujonge iindlela nezibuko zayo. 6. Qalisa ukulungelelanisa, uze uqalise ngokuzenzekelayo. Qinisekisa ukuba ihlabathi kunye nokulungelelaniswa okucetywayo kulayishwe.
Yintoni EYatshintshayo? Ubhaliso aluhambisi ufakelo, aluzikhuphe kwakhona okanye lutshintshe iifayile zalo zokulungelelanisa. Izenzo ezilandelayo ozikhethileyo ngokucacileyo, ezinjengokuhlaziya, ukuqinisekisa okanye ukulungisa ulungelelwaniso, zinokutshintsha iifayile.
Iipakethi zokuqalisa ezenziwe ngokwezifiso, ii-modpacks, amaphasiwedi kunye nokugcinwa kwangaphandle kusenokungabonakali ngokuzenzekelayo. Indlela enye yokufakelwa ayikwazi ukubhaliswa kabini.
UKUBA UKUFUMANA AKUKHALI Qinisekisa ukuba ukhethe ufakelo lweserver enikezelweyo exhaswa yiprofayili ekhethiweyo. Musa ukutshintsha igama le-executable engathandekiyo ukuze unyanzelise ukudibana. Chaza umdlalo kunye nesakhiwo sefolda esilungisiweyo ukuze kuqinisekiswe inkcazo yayo.

data.name: Content.749F8256FE4490AB39C8
data.value:
Sebenzisa esi sikhokelo xa umhleli wokulungelelanisa ebika intsimi elawulwayo engekhoyo, isakhiwo esingasebenziyo okanye ukungalingani kwetemplate.
Qonda UKUKHETHA • Ukugcina ngokuqhelekileyo ukuhlaziywa kwamaxabiso axhaswayo kulawulo olukhethiweyo. • Ukulungiswa kusombulula ingxaki exhaswayo. • Ukuseta kwakhona kubuyisela izicwangciso ezizenzekelayo ze template kwaye kunokususa useto olwenziwe ngokwezifiso.
Ukuqalisa kwakhona akusiso isinyathelo sokuqala sokungaphumeleli kweseva nganye. Ixesha lokudlala elilahlekileyo, izibuko ezihlalayo, kunye neemood ezonakeleyo azilungiswa ngokutshintsha iifayile zokulungelelanisa ngokuphindaphindiweyo.
NGAPHAMBI kokuba kulungiswe Yeka ukudlala, gcina ikopi engathintwanga yeefayile ezichaphazelekayo, uze ufunde utshintsho olucetywayo. Ezinye iiprofayili zineetemplate ezipheleleyo; abanye balindele ukuba lo mdlalo uvelise iifayile xa uqala okanye ufuna ukucwangciswa ngesandla.
I-Synix ixela ukulahleka kwamathegi afunekayo endaweni yokucinga ukuba inokutshintsha yonke imigca ngokukhuselekileyo. Ukusebenzisa ukuhlaziywa kwetemplate elawulwayo kungagcina ikopi enye enegama .synix.before-template-v<revision>.bak.
NGAPHAMBI KOKUGQIBELA OKUNYE NENKCUKACHA Gcina naziphi na iifayile zokusekelayo okanye zokubuyisela kwaye ufunde umyalezo wokubuyisela. Thelekisa ulungelelwaniso lokuqala nolutshintshileyo ngaphambi kokuba ukhethe into oza kuyibuyisela. Musa ukucima ubungqina ngokuzama ukubuyisela kwakhona ngokuphindaphindiweyo.
Emva kokuphiliswa, qalisa kanye uze ujonge ingxelo yomdlalo. Qinisekisa ukuba ufunda indlela echanekileyo nokuba izilungiselelo ezenziwe ngokwezifiso ozifunayo zisekhona.

data.value:
I-Critical SETUP Ifunekayo:

data.name: Content.7871EA5C906D13E02997
data.value:
I-Dune isebenzisa inkqubo yokuthumela yangaphandle kunye nemishini ebonakalayo yomdlalo kunye nesimo seqela lokulwa. Ayingomncedisi womdlalo oqhelekileyo onenkqubo enye.
Iimfuneko Funda ukuhlolwa kokulungela kwe-Synix kwimemori yenkqubo, i-AVX2, i-hardware virtualization, i-Hyper-V, kunye ne-Professional- okanye i-Windows ephezulu exhaswayo. Iimfuno zememori zixhomekeka kwiqela lokulwa nakwiimephu ozisebenzisayo.
I-Synix ayivumeli ukufakelwa okanye ukufakwa kwe-Hyper-V. Gqibezela imfuneko esemthethweni yomdlalo ngaphambi kokuthunyelwa.
Ukufakela nokuqalisa 1. Yenza ifayile ye-Dune: Awakening kwaye ujonge iimfuno zayo kunye nefolda yokufaka. 2. Gcina uze uqalise. 3. I-Synix iqalisa isixhobo esisemthethweni se-battlegroup.bat kunye nesikhokelo somlawuli esifunwa lolo hlelo. 4. Khetha i-initial-setup kwisixhobo somdlalo uze unikeze i-Self-Host Token yakho. 5. Gqibezela i-VM, inethiwekhi kunye nokumiselwa kweqela lemfazwe kweso sixhobo.
Fumana i-Self-Host Token ngeportal esemthethweni yeakhawunti yeFuncom usebenzisa inkqubo yayo yokufaneleka / yokuseta: https://account.duneawakening.com/
Gcina i-token iyimfihlo. Ukuphakanyiswa kwesi sixhobo sokuphunyezwa akuthethi ukuba zonke iiseva zeSynix kufuneka zisebenze njengomlawuli.
IINKCUKACHA ZENETWERKING NOKULAWULA Sebenzisa ulwakhiwo lwenethiwekhi ye-host/VM yokuthumela kunye nezibuko ezifunekayo. I-metadata yendawo yombuzo kwi-Synix imele i-RMQ, hayi umphulaphuli oqhelekileyo wombuzo we-A2S.
Ifestile yokuqalisa evaliweyo ayingqina ukuba ii-VM zayo ziyekile. Qinisekisa imeko yokusebenza uze wenze imisebenzi yeqela lokulwa usebenzisa ulawulo lokuhambisa lomdlalo.
I-Synix inokufaka, ukuhlaziya, ukuqalisa kunye nokwenza isipele kwifolda yofakelo ekhethiweyo. Musa ukucinga ukuba ukugqitywa kwenkqubo eqhelekileyo, imibuzo yomdlali, okanye ukubuyiswa kwe-watchdog kulawula ngokupheleleyo ukuthunyelwa kwangaphandle. Ukuthumela iifayile zokuqalisa akubonelelwa kule profile.
Sebenzisa iinkqubo zokucima ezixhaswa ngumdlalo kunye nokwenza isipele kwidatha ye-VM / yedatha eqhubekayo. I-ZIP yefolda yokuhambisa yodwa ayisiyo i-backup eqinisekisiweyo ehambelana nayo.

data.name: Content.7B4987810DD3E78752A5
data.value:
Lo mbandela wenzelwe abasebenzisi abaphambili kunye nabaxhasi. Awudingi zixhobo zophuhlisi ukudala umncedisi kwiprofayile exhaswayo.
INDLELA EYASEBENZEKA NGAYO Iinkcazo Iinkcazo zomdlalo ezakhelwe ngaphakathi zichaza ukhuphelo, izinto ezinokwenziwa, ii-Steam AppIDs kunye neemfuno zokungena ngemvume, iingxoxo zokuqalisa, izibuko, indlela yokuziphatha yocwangciso, iimfuno zangaphambili, kunye nezakhono zilawuli.
Iinkcazo zikhethe ukuziphatha okuxhaswayo. Azithwali ngokuzenzekelayo iziphethe, iindibano okanye izikripthi ezikhutshelweyo. Ukulahla ifayile ye-JSON kwifolda yesicelo efakiweyo akuyongezi iprofayili entsha yomdlalo.
Lungisa Okanye Wongeze Iprofayile 1. Qala ngezikhokelo ezisemthethweni zeseva ezinikezelweyo kunye neefayile zokulungelelanisa ezivelisiweyo. 2. Sebenzisa iindlela ezinxulumene nesiseko somncedisi xa kuyimfuneko kunye nezichazi ezichanekileyo ezijongene nomdlalo. 3. Faka iitemplate ezixhaswe ngokupheleleyo kwiindawo zazo ezifakwe kakuhle. 4. Ukuhlaziya iinguqulelo ezifanelekileyo zentsingiselo / ulungelelwaniso / itemplate. 5. Ukuqinisekisa ithala leencwadi, ukwakha ngeSDK efunwa yiprojekthi, uze uqhube iimvavanyo ezifanelekileyo. 6. Ukuvavanya ukufakwa, ukuqala, ukumisa, kunye nokubeka iliso ngomdlalo wokwenyani ngaphambi kokurekhoda ukuqinisekiswa.
I-Definition Builder sisixhobo sokwakha uphuhliso, hayi imfuneko eqhelekileyo yokukhululwa.
UMTHETHO WEMithombo • UI: Iifestile zeempawu. • I-ServerHandler: abalawuli bomdlalo kunye nokudityaniswa kweseva. • I-SynixEngine: Umjikelo wobomi wesicelo, ulondolozo, ukusebenzisana, ukubhekabheka nokhuseleko. • Uyilo: Iimpawu zokulawula, imixholo kunye nezixhobo zokulungiselela. • Isiseko sedatha/Iinkcazo zemidlalo: Iiprofayili zemidlalo kunye neetemplate. • Isiseko sedatha/ModSystems: Iinkqubo zokusebenza ezongezelelweyo ezixhaswayo. • Indawo: Iikhathalogu ze-interface kunye neejenereyitha. • Uvavanyo: Uvavanyo olujolise kwiimpawu.
Ukuguqulela, hlaziya zonke iikhathalogu zeelwimi uze ugcine iindawo zokuzikhethela. Quka amanqaku ancedisayo, ukuxilongwa, isicatshulwa sokufikeleleka, kunye neenkcazo ezixhasa imidlalo. Musa ukuguqulela imiyalelo, izitshixo, amathokheni, amaxabiso omsebenzisi, okanye amanqaku okuqonda imveliso. Iirekhodi zokuxilonga zangaphambili azitshintshanga.
Funda iMigqaliselo yeLayisensi & yepropati ngaphambi kokuba usasaze ikhowudi okanye ukwakha. Gcina izikhokelo zokwenyani kunye neelogi zangasese ngaphandle kwegalelo kunye nezixhobo.

data.name: Content.7C1660167D3419DD05A4
data.value:
Cwangcisa ishedyuli yesondlo somncedisi kuphela emva kokuba uvavanye ukuzenzekelayo kwayo okuqhelekileyo, ukuhlaziya, ukumisa nokuqalisa ukuziphatha.
1. Vula izilungiselelo zayo zokuzenzekelayo/zocwangciso uze unike amandla ucwangciso. 2. Khetha imihla nexesha. 3. Cwangcisa ulondolozo oluhlakaniphile uze ukhethe iinketho ezikhoyo zokulondoloza / ukuhlaziya. 4. Yenza isigqibo sokuba uza kulinda na abadlali uze ubeke ixesha lokulibaziseka. 5. Gcina uze uvavanye ngexesha lokugcinwa onokukhangela ngalo.
Iiseshoni zisebenzisa ixesha lasekuhlaleni lePC. Gcina ixesha kunye neendawo zayo zexesha zichanekile.
Xa UMHLABATHO UGqibile I-Synix inokulinda abadlali abaxhunyiwe, emva koko ilungelelanise ukumisa iqela lenkqubo eqinisekisiweyo, ukwenza isipele ngelixa limisiwe, ukuhlaziya nokuqalisa kwakhona ngokweendlela ezikhethiweyo.
Ukulibaziseka okuphezulu ngumda, kungekhona isithembiso sokulinda ngonaphakade. Ulondolozo lunokuqhubeka xa luphela nokuba abadlali bahlala. Ukulibaziseka okungekhoyo kunika ixesha lokulinda.
Ulwazi lomdlali lunemida Ukulinda kuxhomekeke kulwazi olunokwenziwa ngumdlalo okhethiweyo. Umncedisi we-API onxulumene ne-Satisfactory uphatha amanani aphelelwe lixesha okanye angafumanekiyo ngexesha lokulinda elilungiselelwe. Oko akwenzi idatha yombuzo engakhange ixhaswe ithembeke.
Xelela abadlali kusengaphambili uze ufunde imiyalezo yomsebenzi. Izilumkiso ze-Discord zinokuxela iziganeko zolondolozo ezixhaswayo xa iindlela zazo zilungiselelwe.
I-PC kufuneka ivuke kwaye inkqubo efanelekileyo ye-Synix okanye i-agent yangasemva kufuneka isebenze. Ikhompyutha evaliweyo okanye eleleyo ayinakwenza ukukhuphela okucwangciselweyo nokuqalisa kwakhona.

data.name: Content.8579FAD0312C27797E9E
data.value:
Vula i-Windows Terminal okanye i-PowerShell kwaye usebenzise isazisi esichanekileyo sephakeji apha ngezantsi. Le miyalelo ilawula i-Synix ngokwayo, kungekhona amaseva omdlalo ngamnye.
Ukufakela winget install --exact --id ubidzz.Synix
HLOLULA IPAKHA ELIFakiweyo winget list --exact --id ubidzz.Synix
UPDATE Vala i-Synix uze ugqibe umsebenzi wayo ngaphambi kokuba usebenzise: winget upgrade --exact --id ubidzz.Synix
SUKELA UMSEBENZI winget uninstall --exact --id ubidzz.Synix
Gcina Iinkcukacha Zakho Ukufakwa kweseva, ukugcinwa, kunye nokukhuselwa kwee-backups zihlukile kwiphakheji yesicelo. Musa ukucima i-C:\Synix okanye naziphi na iifolda zedatha ezenzelwe wena ngaphandle kokuba ufuna ukuzisusa ngabom ezo datha.
UKUBA UMyalelo Uyasilela Funda isizathu esichaziweyo. Ukuba i-WinGet ibika ukungalingani kwe-hash yomfaki, yeka kwaye ubike; musa ukuphepha ukuqinisekiswa kwe-hash. Ukuhlaziywa okungekhoyo kunokuthetha ukuba i-repository ayikashicileli ipakethi entsha okwamanje.
Ukuvunywa kwe-WinGet kunye ne-hash yokukhuphela ehambelana nayo ayityikityi ikhowudi ye-Synix okanye isiqinisekiso sokuba isoftware yokhuseleko ye-Windows iya kuyithemba.

data.name: Content.89E9CF0E65B8EACE25DF
data.value:
Okokuqala, bonisa ukuba lo mdlalo uyasebenza kwinethiwekhi yakho. Ukutshintshwa komzila akukwazi ukulungisa umdlalo ongaqalanga okanye ogqibile ukufakwa kwawo kokuqala.
KHANGELA INDLELA ELUNGILEYO YOKUTHETHA • Kwi-PC yomncedisi: Sebenzisa unxibelelwano lwasekuhlaleni oluxhaswa ngumdlalo okanye ukubuyela umva. • Kwelinye isixhobo senethiwekhi yasekhaya: Sebenzisa idilesi ye-LAN yomncedisi wePC. • Ngaphandle kwenethiwekhi yakho yasekhaya: Sebenzisa idilesi yakho kawonke-wonke okanye indlela yomdlalo yokufumana/ukujoyina.
Vula Inkcazelo yoQhagamshelwano kwingeniso ekhethiweyo ukuze uhlolisise iziphelo zayo. Idilesi ye-LAN yabucala ayinakusetyenziswa ngokuthe ngqo ngabadlali be-intanethi.
UVavanyo Lwasekuhlaleni 1. Linda de umdlalo ugqibe ukulayisha. 2. Jonga izibuko elilungisiweyo kunye neziphumo zokulungela kweseva. 3. Qhagamshela kwi-PC yomncedisi, emva koko ukusuka kwenye isixhobo se-LAN. 4. Ukuba ukufikelela kwe-LAN kusilela, khangela ilog yomdlalo kunye nokufikelela kwi-Windows Firewall kwiseva esebenzayo.
Vumela abadlali be-Intanethi 1. Nika umgcini idilesi ye-LAN ezinzileyo, ngokuqhelekileyo kunye ne-router DHCP. 2. Chaza izibuko ezifunekayo kunye neeprotokholi zeTCP/UDP zokulungiswa komdlalo. 3. Dlulisa kuphela ezo ziphelo kwidilesi ye-LAN yomgcini. 4. Vumela ukuhambelana kwendlela yomdlalo ngeWindows Firewall kwiiprofayili zenethiwekhi oyisebenzisayo. 5. Uvavanyo olwenziwe kumnxibelelwano we-intanethi owahlukileyo.
Musa ukuvula umzila we-DMZ, ukhubaze i-firewall, okanye ubonise zonke izibuko zolawulo njengesixazululo esiqhelekileyo. Gcina izikhokelo zendlela yokuhambisa ziyimfihlo.
I-Synix ngumphathi wedesktop wasekuhlaleni. Ayibandakanyi iphaneli yewebhu okanye i-relay yoluntu eyenza ezi mfuno zenethiwekhi ziphele.

data.value: Iimeko kunye nee-mod ze-API ziinkqubo ezahlukileyo. Iimeko zifuna ifolda yazo epheleleyo kwaye ugcine ukhetho; Imifanekiso yeworkshop ayizizo ii-mods ze-API zeseva ezinikezelweyo.

data.name: Content.8B70E3569A9351B28D08
data.value:
I-SteamCMD ikhuphela kwaye ihlaziya iifayile zeseva ezinikezelweyo zemidlalo ye-Steam exhaswayo. I-Synix ilungiselela ikopi yayo ekwabelwana ngayo ngokuzenzekelayo; ukucwangciswa kweseva eqhelekileyo akufuneki ithebhu eyahlukileyo yeSteamCMD.
LANDELA INDLELA YOKUPHUMA Khetha umncedisi uze ufunde Umsebenzi & Diagnostics. I-dashboard animation ibonisa ukuba umsebenzi wokufakela uyaqhubeka. I-SteamCMD inokutshintsha phakathi kokukhuphela, ukwahlula, ukupakisha, kunye nokuqinisekisa, ngoko imveliso yayo ayisoloko ibonelela ngepesenti eqinileyo okanye ixesha elithembekileyo eliseleyo.
Vumela ukusebenza kwediski kugqitywe naxa ukugcwala kwenethiwekhi kuncipha. Funda umyalezo wokugqibela wempumelelo okanye wokungaphumeleli ngaphambi kokuba uqalise omnye umsebenzi.
I-LIMIT ISIPHELO SOKUKhuphela Vula izicwangciso → Jikelele → SteamCMD Ukukhuphela Isantya. Khetha imowudi elawulwayo uze ufake isantya esibonisiweyo, okanye ukhethe isantya esipheleleyo.
Oku kuchaphazela ukulayishwa kweSteamCMD, hayi ububanzi bebhanti yabadlali, umxokozelo womdlalo ngamnye ongekhoyo weSteam, okanye zonke izithuthi kwiPC.
I-SIGN-IN NE-FALLS Ezinye iiprofayili zemidlalo zifuna iakhawunti egunyazisiweyo ye-Steam kunye nokuqinisekiswa kwe-Steam Guard. Sebenzisa umyalelo wokungena kwi-Synix; musa ukubeka i-account credentials kwizikripthi okanye iingxelo zikawonkewonke.
Ukufumana umxokozelo ongaphumelelanga, funda iimpazamo ezichanekileyo zeSteamCMD uze ujonge indawo yediski ekhululekile, ukufikelela kwifolda, ukufikelela kwinethiwekhi, kunye naziphi na iimfuno zeakhawunti. Ukuqinisekiswa kunokukhuphela kwakhona iifayile ezilawulwa ngumfakisi, ngoko gcina utshintsho olwenziwe ngokwezifiso ngaphambi kokuyisebenzisa.

data.name: Content.8B7975E13D85AB64E0E6
data.value: I-plugin_list_file (ngokuzenzekelayo i-default_plugins.txt) ekhethiweyo ikhetha iiplagi ze-AngelScript. Ukukopisha iskripthi akuyongezi kolu luhlu; gcina iifayile zenkxaso yemephu / yesikripthi kwaye zihambelane nenguqulelo yeseva.

data.name: Content.8CA9126D6BF48BF6086B
data.value: Iiphakheji zihamba kwisalathiso sePhakheji somncedisi ngefayile nganye yePhakheji, Client kunye Shared. Index.lua kunye nolwakhiwo lwepakethi luchaza ukulayishwa; khetha iiphakheji ezivunyelweyo kulungelelwaniso lweseva.

I--workshopdir igqithisa indlela kwaye i--NoMods ikhubaza ii-mods. Umdlalo usebenza imigaqo yokufaka; I-Synix ayisebenzi imiyalelo yepakethe.

data.name: Content.9A49DE43F45C43C2D5A1
data.value: Ifuna i-SML ehambelanayo kunye neeseva ezinikezelweyo zokwakha ii-mods kunye nokuxhomekeka. Iiphakheji ezipheleleyo zisebenzisa iFactoryGame/Mods. Iiphakheji zabathengi kuphela aziyi kusebenza; Inkxaso ye-mod ye-server-platform kufuneka ihlolwe.

data.name: Content.9C3A77D42EDA0BF1010D
data.value:
Iimeko zeEmpyrion kunye nee-mods zekhowudi yomncedisi zahlukile. Kwi-Server Options → Mod & Plugin Manager, khetha i-Empyrion scenarios okanye i-Empyrion server mods. Yima umncedisi uze ugcine isipele esipheleleyo somncedisi ngaphambi kokwenza utshintsho.
FUNDA isicatshulwa 1. I-Browse Catalog ivula i-Steam Workshop. Bhalisela isicatshulwa uze ulinde ukuba i-Steam igqibe ukuyikhuphela. Iiplani kunye neengqokelela zeworkshop azizizo iimeko zeseva. 2. Khetha iphakheji yokungenisa, uze ukhethe ifolda. Khetha ifolda yesicatshulwa ngasinye ngaphakathi kwefolda yeSteam yelayibrari yakho yesteamapps\workshop\content\383120. Unokukhetha nesicatshulwa esipheleleyo seZIP. 3. Faka igama lefolda yeemeko ezaziwayo. Musa ukusebenzisa i-ID ye-Workshop kuphela. Gcina igama elifanayo lefolda ukuze uhlaziye kamva. 4. Jonga ukuhlolwa kwepakethi kunye nendawo ekuyiwa kuyo, emva koko qinisekisa ukungeniswa. I-Synix ikopa isicatshulwa esipheleleyo kwi-Content\Scenarios ngaphandle kokuyisebenzisa okanye ukutshintsha ihlabathi. 5. Khetha iScenario uluhlu lweemeko ezifakelweyo. Khetha enye uze ujonge igama lokugcina elahlukileyo. Ukutshintshela kwisicatshulwa esahlukileyo kufuna igama lokugcina elitsha, elingasetyenziswanga; I-Synix iphakamisa enye kwaye ishiya i-saves ekhoyo ingathintwanga. 6. Sebenzisa ukhetho, qalisa umncedisi, uze ujonge ilog yayo kunye nonxibelelwano lomxhasi. Ezinye iimeko zineemeko ezongezelelweyo okanye iimfuno ezichazwe ngumbhali wazo.
Igama lemeko yi GameConfig.CustomScenario; igama lehlabathi eligciniweyo yiGameConfig.GameName. I-Synix isekela i-dedicated.yaml ngaphambi kokutshintsha la masimi kwaye igcina ukungena kwiseva kuvumelanisiwe. Ayibeki imbewu, amaphasiwedi, okanye useto olungahambelaniyo.
Faka iimowudi zeseva Sebenzisa iphrofayili ye-Empyrion server mods kunye nePhakheji yokungenisa ukukhetha i-mod ZIP ehlanganisiweyo okanye ifolda epheleleyo ye-mod. Quka ii-DLL zayo, iiasethi ezixhasayo, ukuxhomekeka kwayo, kunye ne_Info.yaml xa zibonelelwa. Synix ifaka ezi phantsi kwe-Content\Mods; umdlalo ulayisha ikhowudi xa uqalisa. Ukukhuphela ikhowudi yomthombo kunye nabafaki abazimeleyo akuxhaswa ziiphakheji.
I-Synix ayifaki umthwalo we-mod okanye ivule i-mod engavumelekanga ngokuzenzekelayo. Landela iimfuno zombhali, kuquka nayiphi na into yokulayisha eyongezelelweyo, ulungelelwaniso kunye nokumiselwa komxhasi. Ukungenisa ngempumelelo akubonisi ukuba i-mod iyahambelana nomdlalo wangoku okanye ezinye iimodyuli ezifakiweyo.
I-UPDATES NENKQUBO I-Steam ihlaziya ikopi yayo yeWorkshop, hayi ikopi yeseva engeniswe yi-Synix. Ukuhlaziya, yima umncedisi uze ungenise iphakheji ehlaziyiweyo usebenzisa igama lefolda yesicatshulwa esifanayo. Hlola ukuba umbhali ufuna ugcino olutsha. Iifayile ezibuyiselweyo zifumana iikopi zokubuyela umva; Ukungenisa uhlaziyo akusiyo ukufakela ngokutsha okucocekileyo kwaye akususi iifayile ezingekhoyo kwiphakheji entsha.
Ukuhlaziya uluhlu lweepakethe ezipheleleyo kunento nganye. Ukufakelwa (kungakhange kuqinisekiswe kwakhona) kuthetha ukuba ukungeniswa kuye kwabhalwa, hayi ukuba zonke iifayile ezifakiweyo zisandula ukuhlolwa kwakhona. Roll Back Import iguqula lonke ukungeniswa ekhethiweyo, kuquka nezinye mods kwipakethe enye, kwaye uyala ukubuyisela iifayile ezitshintshiwe ngaphandle Synix. Iimeko ezikhethiweyo kunye nezinto ezifunwa ngamazwe agcinwe zikhuselwe ekususweni; Ukuhlaziywa kwesicatshulwa esirekhodiweyo kusenokubuyiselwa kwiifayile zayo zangaphambili.

data.name: Content.9CA409AF86EBA5BEC5C1
data.value:
Vula Ukucwangcisa → Inethiwekhi & RCON ukujonga amanqaku okugqibela axhaswa ngumdlalo okhethiweyo. Sebenzisa ulungelelwaniso lokwenyani lomdlalo, kungekhona uluhlu oluthe ngqo lwezibuko.
I-PORT ROLES • Iphothifoliyo yomdlalo: Ukuhamba komdlali. • I-port yombuzo: Ulwazi lwe-server okanye ukufunyanwa, ukuba le protocol yombuzo iyaxhaswa. • I-RCON/admin port: Isiteshi sokulawula esikhethiweyo. • I-App/API port: Isikhokelo somdlalo okanye inkonzo yolawulo.
I-TCP kunye ne-UDP ziprotocol ezahlukeneyo. Iiprotocol ezimbini ezahlukeneyo zingasebenzisa inombolo enye yezibuko, kodwa ii-server ezimbini azikwazi ukwabelana nge-endpoint yokumamela engqubanayo. I-Synix ikwahlola iiprofayili ezigcinwe kwiingxabano zezibuko, kubandakanya ukungena okuyekisiweyo.
Gcina ii-endpoints ezivunyelweyo ziyingqayizivele kwiimeko ezahlukeneyo kwaye ugcine naluphi na ulwalamano olufunekayo kumdlalo phakathi kwamazibuko. Musa ukucinga ukuba yonke umdlalo yiUDP okanye ukuba yonke indawo yombuzo imele umphulaphuli wokwenene.
UKULAWULA AKUYINTO YOKudlala Abadlali abadingi ukufikelela kwi-RCON okanye kwenye indawo yokugqibela yomlawuli. Gcina ulawulo lwasekuhlaleni ngaphandle kokuba unecebo elikhuselekileyo lolawulo olukude.
Imizekelo yeMidlalo • I-Minecraft i-Java ne-Bedrock zisebenzisa indlela eyahlukileyo yokudibanisa; landela uhlelo olukhethiweyo. • I-Satisfactory yendawo ye-API isebenzisa i-port yayo yomdlalo / ye-API; ixabiso layo elidala le-query field aliyonto eyongezelelweyo ye-Synix. • I-Dune's query field metadata imele i-RMQ deployment port yayo, hayi inkonzo eqhelekileyo ye-Steam A2S yombuzo. • I-Rust+ isebenzisa isiphelo sayo esihambelanayo ukongeza kumdlalo.
Iimodeli ezizenzekelayo zeetemplate zixabiso lokuqalisa, hayi uluhlu olubanzi lokujonga ukuvula umzila. Jonga umphulaphuli wangempela ngaphambi kokuba utshintshe umthetho womlilo.

data.name: Content.9D05F59E4F03A202388D
data.value: I-Dune: Awakening isebenzisa inkqubo esemthethweni yokuhanjiswa kweseva ezinikezelweyo. I-Hyper-V kunye ne-hardware virtualization kufuneka inikwe amandla, kwaye i-Windows Pro okanye i-Enterprise iyafuneka. Ekuqalisweni kokuqala, i-Synix iqala i-battlegroup.bat njengoMlawuli. Khetha i-initial-setup uze ulungiselele i-Self-Host Token yakho. I-Synix ingakwazi ukufaka, ukuhlaziya, ukwenza isipele nokuqalisa ukuthunyelwa, kodwa umdlalo ungumnini woomatshini ababonakalayo kunye nesimo sabo sokusebenza. Isikhokelo esisemthethweni: https://duneawakening.com/en/news/dedicated-server-how-to-guide

data.name: Content.A2B1D27FE31D2DC1D587
data.value:
I-Discord webhooks ithumela iziganeko ezikhethiweyo zeseva kwisitishi. Zizilumkiso, hayi i-bot ye-Discord yokulawula kude i-Synix.
BEKA INKCUKACHA 1. Yenza okanye ufumane i-webhook yesiteshi ogunyazisiweyo ukuba usilawule. 2. Vula iphepha lokuCwangcisa → Discord lomncedisi okhethiweyo. 3. Ngena kwi-webhook uze ukhethe iinketho ezikhoyo zokuhambisa iziganeko. 4. Gcina ulwakhiwo. 5. Sebenzisa isenzo sokuvavanya ukuba sinikezelwa, okanye uqinisekise ukuhanjiswa ngexesha lomsitho ocwangcisiweyo.
Ukuqalisa, ukucima, ukubuyisa, ukubuyisela umva, kunye nokugcinwa imiyalezo kuxhomekeke kwiindlela ezivunyelweyo nokuba ngaba ukusebenza kwenzeka ngokwenene.
Khusela I-URL I-URL ye-webhook iqulethe isaziso sokuposa. Nabani na oyifumanayo usenokukwazi ukuthumela imiyalezo kuloo ndlela. Musa ukuyibeka kwiscreen esikhutshwe esidlangalaleni, kwimibandela, kwizikripthi nakwiincoko.
I-Synix ikhusela i-webhook yayo egciniweyo kumsebenzisi we-Windows. Ukuba i-URL ibonakalisiwe, yijikeleze okanye uyicime kwi-Discord, emva koko uhlaziye indawo ekuyiwa kuyo i-Synix. Jonga amagama omncedisi kunye neenkcukacha zesiganeko ezithunyelwe kwisiteshi esabelwana ngaso.
Ukuba Imiyalezo Ayifiki Jonga indlela yomsitho ekhethiweyo, i-URL, ukufumaneka kwesiteshi / i-webhook, nokuba ngaba i-PC inokufikelela kwi-Discord. Hlola impazamo ebikiwe ngaphandle kokupapasha i-URL epheleleyo.
Izilumkiso zisebenzisa unxibelelwano oluphumayo kwi-Discord. Abafuni ukuvula i-inbound router control port.
