data.name: Content.A63ABCB912E7792C3276
data.value: Umphuhlisi uqinisekisa isicatshulwa sephasiwedi, kodwa akaqinisekisi indlela yokuchonga umlinganiswa wamazwe ngamazwe.

data.name: Content.A9DFF42CEEBFF58460BE
data.value: Isiqinisekisi sephasiwedi somqhubi sifaka iphasiwedi egqityiweyo nge-UTF-8 ngaphambi kokutyiwa / ukuthelekiswa. Oku kuxhasa umbhalo wamazwe ngamazwe kwicala lomncedisi; olu hlaziyo aluzange luvavanye zonke iinkqubo zomxhasi/zokungenisa. Amaphasiwedi kufuneka ahambelane ngokuchanekileyo, kuquka oonobumba abahlanganisiweyo.

data.name: Content.AA512DBD74E382E3BFBB
data.value: Umphuhlisi uchaza ngokucacileyo imifanekiso yeUTF-8 kumagama omncedisi kwaye ubonise isicatshulwa esingeyiyo isiLatin. igama lomncedisi linqunyelwe kwiimpawu ze260 kuquka ukufomatha; servername_short ukuya 128. Ukukhuselwa kwefonti kusexhomekeke kumthengi.

data.name: Content.AAA2663038ABA16D9037
data.value: Ukuba iifayile zenziwe kwenye ikhompyutha, zikopishe kule folda yeseva yeSynix ngaphambi kokuyiqalisa.

data.name: Content.AB86AD203BD5F34E025B
data.value: Ezi zifuna iinkqubo ezahlukeneyo zokuphunyezwa kweseva. I-tModLoader isebenzisa iiphakheji ze-mod kunye noluhlu olunikwe amandla; I-TShock ilayisha i-DLL ehambelana ne-API kwii-ServerPlugins. I-Vanilla Terraria nayo ayithwali. Sombulula indlela esebenzayo yokuguqula / yokugcina ngaphambi kokungenisa.

data.name: Content.AC2F6ED0F16118E96232
data.value:
Yenza isigqibo sokuba ususa kuphela iphaneli yokulawula okanye kwakhona ususe ngokusisigxina iiseva zakho ezibanjwe. Ezi zizenzo ezahlukileyo.
Susa Uhlelo lokusebenza Kuphela 1. Gqibezela naluphi na ufakelo, ukudluliselwa, okanye ukubuyisela kwimeko yesiqhelo olusebenzayo. 2. Yima iiseva zakho ngeSynix, ulinde ukuba zigqibe ukugcina, uze uphume kwiSynix. 3. Gcina ikopi eqinisekisiweyo yehlabathi elibalulekileyo, iifayile zokucwangcisa, neenkcukacha. 4. Ukukhupha i-Synix ngokusebenzisa ii-apps ezifakwe kwi-Windows okanye umphathi wakho weepakethi.
Gcina i-C:\Synix, iifolda zeseva ezenziwe ngokwezifiso, ii-saves zangaphandle zomdlalo, kunye neendawo zokwenza isipele ukuba ufuna ukuzisebenzisa kwakhona. Ukufakela kwakhona isicelo akufuneki ukuba ususe ezi folda.
Susa ISERVER ENTRY Sebenzisa isenzo Susa kwiseva ekhethiweyo kwi-Synix uze ufunde isiqinisekiso. Ukususwa kwengxelo yedashboard akufani nokuvuma ukucima iifayile zokufakela okanye i-backup. Qinisekisa ukuba zeziphi iinkcukacha eziza kususwa.
Musa ukusebenzisa ukususwa njengendlela yokucombulula ingxaki. I-backup egcinwe kuphela ngaphakathi kwefolda oyisusileyo ayisiyo ikopi yokufumana kwakhona.
Ukuba utshintshela kwelinye iphaneli yokulawula, qinisekisa ukuba inokuqalisa ukufakelwa ngokuchanekileyo kwaye ilayishe ihlabathi elicetywayo ngaphambi kokuba ususe idatha yakho endala.

data.name: Content.ACCA8A557F449B6ECF0A
data.value: Isikhokelo esixhaswe ngabaphuhlisi sichaza i-sServerPassword njengokwamkela ukudityaniswa kweempawu kwipaneli yolawulo. Ayibeki ngokucacileyo i-Unicode, kwaye oku akufuneki kuphazanyiswe njengesiqinisekiso sephasiwedi edibeneyo.

data.name: Content.B4F7813ACC4371C7ADEF
data.value:
Khetha umxholo ekhohlo ukuze ufunde imiyalelo yawo. Onke amanqaku aluncedo asebenza ngaphandle kweintanethi ngolwimi olukhethileyo.
INQAKU ELINGUMXHOLO? Vula Isikhokelo sokuseta okokuqala kwi- Getting Started & Setup.
NGABA UYIPHUME iSeva? Khetha udidi lomsebenzi, njengokucwangcisa, ukwenza uthungelwano, ukubuyisela umva, okanye ulawulo oluthile lomdlalo.
Ngaba Ufuna Impazamo? Cofa uCtrl+F uze ukhangele umxholo, umdlalo okanye inxalenye emfutshane yomyalezo. Ukukhangela kujonga izihloko zezahluko kunye neetekisi ezipheleleyo uze ubonise umbhalo ofanayo.
Sebenzisa iqhosha lokukhangela ukuze ubuyele kuzo zonke izihloko. Khuphela uze uxhase amakhonkco avulekileyo kwisikhangeli sakho kuphela xa ukhetha.

data.value:

2. Hlaziya iiparameter zeINI ukuze utshintshe imigaqo yokuveliswa kweplanethi nemithetho yeseva.
3. Uxwebhu olusemthethweni: https://playgrav.com/

data.name: Content.B6FC67DB36AEA1C2C9E1
data.value: I-ATLAS ifuna i-grid yeseva ethunyelwe ngaphandle kunye nedatha yeRedis efakiweyo ngaphambi kokuba i-ShooterGameServer.exe iqaliswe. I-Synix iya kuvala ukuqala de i-ShooterGame\ServerGrid.json kunye ne-ShooterGame\ServerGrid.ServerOnly.json zibekho. Yenza igridi ngeGrapeshot Games ServerGridEditor esemthethweni, faka zombini iifayile kwifolda ye-ShooterGame, kwaye uqalise i-AtlasTools\RedisDatabase\redis-server_start.bat ngaphambi kokuqalisa iseva ye-ATLAS. I-Redis kufuneka ihlale yindawo kwi-127.0.0.1 kwaye izibuko le-6379 alifuneki libekwe kwi-Intanethi.

data.name: Content.B759954CBA493D979D4B

3. Uxwebhu olusemthethweni: https://medievaldynasty.wiki.gg/wiki/Dedicated_Servers

data.name: Content.B8658090CFB2DBC3C506
data.value: Izakhiwo zakutshanje zisebenzisa ii-ID ze-Workshop kwi-mods.txt. Qinisekisa ukuhambelana kwe-CTE/release version kunye neserver/client mod ngaphambi kokwenza utshintsho.

data.name: Content.B9AD3A6BF122B35896B1
data.value:
Khetha umncedisi kwaye usebenzise izixhobo zokuvavanya uxhumano okanye zomdlali xa zikhoyo. I-Synix ikhetha ukuhlolwa ngokuhambelana nombuzo oxhaswayo womdlalo, i-TCP / UDP / HTTP, i-API yendawo, kunye nezakhono zenkqubo.
OKUTHETHWA YISIZATHU Impendulo yokunxibelelana kwinqanaba eliphantsi ayingqina ukuba umdlali unokuqinisekisa kwaye ajoyine. Inkqubo ebukhoma nayo ayingqina ukuba inkonzo yayo yombuzo ilungile.
Ukubalwa kwabadlali namagama abadlali zizakhono ezahlukileyo. Umncedisi unokuxela ukuba bangaphi abadlali abaxhunyiwe ngaphandle kokutyhila uluhlu olunegama. Uludwe olungenanto aluyiluhlu lwabadlali abangekhoyo.
Izixhobo ezifihliweyo okanye i-N/A Ezinye iindlela ze-EOS kuphela okanye zokudlala ngokudibeneyo azibonakalisi umbuzo onokuthenjwa oxhaswayo okanye isiteshi sokulawula umdlali. I-Synix inokubonisa i-N/A okanye ilahle uvavanyo endaweni yokubonisa isiphumo esilahlekisayo.
Jonga uhlelo olukhethiweyo kunye nejelo lolawulo elilungiselelwe i-Minecraft. Ukubalwa komdlali weSatisfactory kuxhomekeke kunxibelelwano lwasekhaya lweAPI olukhethiweyo. Musa ukuzenzela iziqinisekiso ze-EOS zabaphuhlisi kuphela ukuze unyanzele uvavanyo.
ISERVER-BROWSER LISTINGS Imidlalo emininzi yeSteam isebenzisa imibuzo ye-A2S, kodwa oku akuyona into eqhelekileyo. Ubhaliso, izilungiso zomdlalo kunye nenkonzo yesikhangeli zichaphazela ukubonakala, yaye akukho xesha lokufakwa kuluhlu eliqinisekisiweyo.
Ukuba umncedisi akakho kwisikhangeli, hlola indlela yomdlalo yokunxibelelana ngokuthe ngqo uze ujonge ilog yayo. Ukutshintsha izibuko zemibuzo ezingahambelaniyo ngokuphindaphindiweyo kunokuzisa iingxaki ezongezelelweyo.

data.name: Content.BA3B0E6A0EE6ED1D981D
data.value:
I-Critical SETUP Ifunekayo:

2. Hlela 'dedicatedServerConfig.xml' ukuze uchaze iipasiwedi zomlawuli wewebhu kunye nee-ID zokugcina ifama.
3. Uxwebhu olusemthethweni: https://farming-simulator.com/

data.name: Content.BB037060CAFF94F24E5C
data.value: I-Rust ilungele ukuqalisa. Ukuba i-Oxide ikhethiwe, i-Synix ifake kuphela ixesha lokuqhuba le-Oxide elisemthethweni emva kweefayile ze-Steam. I-Synix ayiyikhuphela, ayifaki, ayihlaziyi okanye ayithembi iiplagi; Yongeza kwaye ulawule iiplagi zakho kwi-oxide\plugins. Emva kohlaziyo ngalunye lwe-Rust okanye ukuqinisekiswa kwayo, i-Synix iphinda isebenzise ixesha lokugqibela lokusebenza kwe-Oxide esemthethweni ngaphambi kokuqalisa kweseva.

data.name: Content.BDCE626AE85DA5ADC9CD
data.value:
Sebenzisa Ukucwangcisa kwiinkalo eziqhelekileyo ezilawulwa yiSynix. Sebenzisa umhleli wefayile yocwangciso kwiiNketho zeNkonzo xa ufuna ukujonga okanye ukutshintsha ulungelelwaniso lokwenyani lomdlalo.
1. Yima umncedisi ukuba ufunda ifayile xa iqalisa okanye uyibhala kwakhona xa isebenza. 2. Yenza isipele uze uqinisekise umncedisi kunye nefayile ekhethiweyo. 3. Funda amaxabiso kunye nezimvo ezikhoyo. 4. Guqula kuphela izicwangciso ofuna ukuzitshintsha. 5. Lungisa iimpazamo zokuqinisekisa zomhleli uze uhlolisise izilumkiso zakhe. 6. Gcina, qalisa umncedisi nge-Synix, uze ukhangele ilog yomdlalo yakutshanje.
Iifomathi ezixhaswayo I-Synix inika ukuphathwa kwefomathi eyaziwayo ye-INI / iipropati ezixhaswayo, i-JSON, i-XML, i-YAML, kunye nezinye iifomathi ezithile zeprofayile. Akuzizo zonke iifayile okanye iinketho ezinomhleli olawulwayo. Ukuhlela i-YAML ixhasa useto oluhleliweyo, uluhlu oludwelisiweyo, kunye namaxabiso omgca omnye ngelixa ugcina izimvo kunye nokudweliswa. Iimpawu eziyinkimbinkimbi ze-YAML ezinje nge-anchors, ii-aliases, iiqoqo zangaphakathi, kunye namaxabiso e-multiline ayaliwa ngaphandle kokugcina.
Gcina izitshixo zocwangciso, amaxabiso amkelweyo, amagama emephu, nemiyalelo kanye njengoko umdlalo ulindele. Musa ukuyiguqulela ukuze ihambelane nolwimi lwe-interface.
UKUQINISEKA AKUKO UVAvanyo Lokudlala Ifayile eyakhiwe kakuhle isenokuba nezilungiselelo ezingahambelaniyo. Iimod okanye uhlaziyo lwemidlalo lunokongeza iinketho ezingaziwa ngumhleli. Qinisekisa ukuba umdlalo ulayishe ifayile efunekayo kunye nehlabathi emva kokuqalisa kwakhona.
Ukuba omnye umhleli okanye umdlalo utshintsha ifayile ngelixa ivuliwe, phinda ulayishe uze uthelekise ngaphambi kokuba uyigcine. Iifayile zomdlalo zinokuqulatha amaphasiwedi afundekayo okanye ii-tokens; ziqwalasele uze uzilungise ngaphambi kokuba wabelane ngazo.
Iinketho ze-Satisfactory eziphilayo ze-API zikwindawo yoLawulo lwazo kwaye zihlukile ekuhleleni iifayile zokulungelelanisa kwi-disk.

data.name: Content.BF54C92F82C7F28A3016
data.value: Inkqubo yokufakelwa kwe-mod/plugin ekhethekileyo kumncedisi ayikaqinisekiswa ngokusekwe kumaxwebhu athembekileyo. Iziphumo zokukhangela lo mdlalo zahlaziywa; iimodyuli zeklayenti, iimephu ngaphandle kwemiyalelo yokuhanjiswa kweserver kunye nezongezo zepaneli yokulawula azikho ubungqina obaneleyo. Sebenzisa imiyalelo yepakethe yomlobi ngaphambi kokukhetha indawo oya kuyo.

data.name: Content.C21CA4A9BEBAA889949B
data.value: Sebenzisa ii-ID zeprojekthi ze-CurseForge ezicwangciselweyo kunye nengxoxo ye--mods yomdlalo. Iiphakheji eziphekiweyo zeWindowsServer kunye nolwazi lomnikezeli kufuneka zihambelane; ukukopisha ifolda ye .uplugin yodwa akubhalisi i-mod elawulwa ngumboneleli.

data.name: Content.C2BD3BDCD4926716C67B
data.value: Qhubeka kuphela emva kokuba uphonononge amanyathelo afunekayo okuseta.

data.name: Content.C3732C45553C69AA02C1
data.value:
Khetha Ukucwangcisa umncedisi okhoyo, okanye sebenzisa ifestile yokuseta xa udala enye. Guqula kuphela amasimi asebenza kumdlalo wakho.
Iindlela Zokuqala Neziphambili Imodi yokuqalisa igxininisa izilungiselelo eziqhelekileyo kunye nomyalelo wokuqalisa ocetyiswayo. Imodi ephucukileyo ityhila ulawulo olongezelelweyo lobuchwephesha, kubandakanya i-RCON exhaswayo kunye neendlela zokuqalisa ezingafunekiyo. Ukutshintsha iindlela akucimi amaxabiso agciniweyo. Discord izaziso ziyafumaneka kuzo zombini iindlela.
OKUQHELEKILEYO KWEPhepha LONKE • Jikelele: Igama lomncedisi, umdlalo, uhlelo / inguqulelo, kunye nokukhethwa kweprofayile yomdlalo exhaswayo. • Ukhuseleko: Amaphasiwedi kunye nezinye izilungiselelo zokufikelela ezixhaswa yi template. • Isizukulwana sehlabathi: Igama lehlabathi, imbewu, ubungakanani, neendlela ezikhoyo ehlabathini. • Inethiwekhi & RCON: Inkxaso yokudlala, imibuzo, umhlobo / API, kunye neendawo zokugqibela zolawulo. • Ukuzenzekelayo: Isipele/ukuhlaziywa kokuqalisa kunye nolondolozo oluhleliweyo. • I-Discord: Iindawo zokunxibelelana neziganeko. • Faka & Qalisa: Ifolda yokufakela kunye neendlela zokuqalisa ezixhaswayo.
Iinkalo ezikhubazekileyo zomdlalo zenzelwe ngabom. Umdlalo unokuba ngumnini waloo nto okanye ungaxhaswa; ukunyanzelisa iingxoxo ezongezelelweyo kumyalelo akusiyo indawo ekhuselekileyo.
IINKCUKACHA EZINE Iinkcukacha zeseva → Izilungiselelo ezifunekayo → Ukuphononongwa → Gcina iseva
Ezi umkhondo ukulungela uqwalaselo, hayi ukukhuphela okanye ufakelo inkqubela. Nje ukuba iisetingi ezifunekayo zidlulise ukuqinisekiswa, i-Synix ivula inyathelo 3 ukuze ukwazi ukujonga ukhetho lwakho, emva koko ikhuphe i-Save Server. Ukutshintsha isicwangciso sokutshixa Gcina kwakhona de ukhetho oluhlaziyiweyo luboniswe kwi- Review. Kufuneka ukhethe Ukuzigcina; ukuvula Ukuhlaziywa akuze kugcine ngokuzenzekelayo. Funda umyalezo osemazantsi xa kukho into efuna ingqalelo.
Xa uhlela umncedisi, uyeke kuqala ukuba utshintsho luchaphazela iifayile okanye iinketho ezifundwa ngexesha lokuqalisa. Ukugcina utshintsho kuhlaziya iprofayile yayo; ayithembisi ukuba umdlalo oqhubayo uyisebenzise loo migaqo. Qalisa kwakhona ngeSynix xa umdlalo ufuna njalo.

data.name: Content.CBFC11B8C03869110CF7
data.value:
Vula ukucwangcisa → Ukuzenzekelayo ukuze umncedisi okhethiweyo akhethe umsebenzi owenzekayo ngaphambi kokuqalisa okuxhaswayo.
Ukubuyela Ekuqaliseni Yenza oku ukuze wenze i-back-up ye-stop-server ngaphambi kokuqalisa okusebenzayo. Cwangcisa ingcambu yokulondoloza kunye nokugcinwa kwiZilungiselelo zesicelo → Izipele.
Ukuphiliswa kweemeko eziphazamisayo kuqalisa ngokuqhelanayo ukungahambi ngendlela yesiqhelo. I-backups yokuqalisa ngokuzenzekelayo ayiyi kuthatha indawo yokugcina amanqaku okubuyisela kwimeko yesiqhelo ngaphambi kokutshintsha okukhulu.
UPDATE ON START Yenza oku ukuze uqinisekise ukuhlaziywa komdlalo oxhaswayo ngaphambi kokuqalisa. Ihlaziya iifayile zomncedisi womdlalo, hayi isicelo seSynix.
Ukuhlolwa kohlaziyo akusisithembiso sokuba zonke iziqalo ziyakhuphela iifayile. I-SteamCMD kunye nomfakisicelo womdlalo bagqiba ngento efunekayo.
I-VALIDATION NE-Customs FILES Inkqubo yokuqinisekisa ngesandla inokulungisa okanye ukulayisha kwakhona iifayile ezilawulwa ngumfakisi. Gcina utshintsho ngaphambi kokuba luhlaziywe okanye luqinisekiswe; musa ukucinga ukuba iifayile ezenziwe ngokwezifiso zihlala zingathintwanga.
Hlola UKUKHETHA Kwakho Gcina iisetingi uze uqalise ngokucwangcisa. Funda iziphumo zomsebenzi ukuze wenze isipele, uhlaziye uze uqalise. Ukukhutshwa okugqityiweyo akubonisi ukuba lo mdlalo ulayishe ihlabathi lawo ngempumelelo.
Vumela indawo eyaneleyo yokugcina izinto, yokukhuphela izinto, iifayile zethutyana nomdlalo ofakiweyo. Ukuba umsebenzi wangaphambi kokuqalisa uxela ukusilela, phanda isizathu esichaziweyo kunokuba uqalise umncedisi ofanayo ngaphandle kweSynix ukuyigqitha.

data.name: Content.CD4007BB408F0C6825C6
data.value: Vula i-Documents\American Truck Simulator\config.cfg uze usete i-g_console "1". Qalisa umdlalo oqhelekileyo weAmerican Truck Simulator, ulayishe iprofayile yakho kunye nemephu, cinezela ~ ukuvula ikhonsoli, uze uqhube i-export_server_packages. Vala umdlalo, uze ucofe uQala kwiSynix kwakhona. I-Synix izakungenisa iifayile ezivelisiweyo ngokuzenzekelayo.

data.name: Content.CEBB295EB1521FABB36D
data.value:
Vula Ukulungela kwiseva ekhethiweyo ngaphambi kokuqalisa kwayo okokuqala okanye xa kukho into engahambi kakuhle. Iqokelela iitsheki ezixhaswa yile profayile, ezinje ngeefayile, amaxesha okuqhuba, ulungelelwaniso, indawo yediski, izibuko, imeko yenkqubo, kunye neelogi ezifanelekileyo.
KHAWUCINGE NGOKUQHELEKILEYO • Ukulungele: Akuzange kufunyanwe ngxaki yokuvimba kwiitsheki ezikhoyo. • Ukuhlolisisa: Funda oko kufunyanisiweyo uze uthathe isigqibo sokuba kukho into ekufuneka yenziwe. • Ukuvalwa: Sombulula ingxaki ngaphambi kokuba uqhubeke.
Ukulungela akusebenzi ngokuzenzekelayo kuzo zonke izilungiso ezicetywayo. Hlola isenzo esicetywayo kunye nokuqinisekiswa kwaso.
Emva KOKUGQIBELA Iprofayile Entsha I-Start yokuqala inokukhuphela iifayile, ifake ixesha lokuqhuba elixhaswayo, ivelise ulungelelwaniso, kwaye ilinde ukuqala komdlalo. Landela ulwalathiso lokuqala lokuqalisa kunye ne-Activity & Diagnostics kunokuba uphathe ukungena kwedeshibhodi egciniweyo njengomdlalo ofakiweyo.
Eminye imidlalo idinga isivumelwano, ukuqinisekiswa, okanye ukusekwa kwesicelo / iseshoni yomdlalo ngaphambi kokuba nabani na angangena. Gqibezela eli nyathelo kwindawo efunwa ngumdlalo.
UQINISELO LOKUHAMBANA Faka, Qalisa, Yima, kwaye Monitoring iziphumo ukurekhoda imisebenzi Synix uye waqaphela. Ukungakhange kuqinisekiswe kodwa kuthetha ukuba akukho ziphumo zibhaliweyo; oko akuthethi ukuba umdlalo uyaziwa ukuba uphukile.
Isiphumo esilungiselelwe okanye ukuqinisekiswa kwasekuhlaleni okuphumelelayo akuqinisekisi ukufikelela kwi-intanethi, iimodyuli ezisempilweni, okanye ukuhambelana nomxhasi ngamnye. Qukumbela ngokuvavanya unxibelelwano olucetywayo kunye nehlabathi.

data.name: Content.D04B8B2F340C3B82596E
data.value:
I-backup ye-server ekhethiweyo igcina iifayile kwifolda yokufakelwa kweso seva. Jonga apho umdlalo usindisa khona umhlaba wawo ngaphambi kokuba uthembele kuwo.
Yenza Umzamo Wokubuyisa 1. Yima umncedisi ngeSynix uze ulinde ukuba iinkqubo zayo ziphume. 2. Khetha isenzo sokusekelayo kwiiNketho zeSeva. 3. Hlola umthombo, indawo ekuyiwa kuyo, ubungakanani obuqikelelweyo nendawo yediski ekhoyo. 4. Qinisekisa uze ulinde ukugqitywa. 5. Khetha ifolda evulekileyo yokulondoloza ukuze ufumane i-archive. Gcina irisithi yayo yokuthembeka nayo.
INQAKU ELINGUMXHA Isipele siquka ifolda yokufakela, kungekhona nje ifolda encinane yokugcina. Imidlalo emikhulu inokufuna ixesha elininzi kunye nokugcina izinto.
Ukugcina kwi-AppData, Amaxwebhu, enye idrayivu, okanye umatshini we-virtual womdlalo unokuba ngaphandle kwaloo folda. Zikhusele ngokwahlukeneyo usebenzisa indlela yomdlalo.
Indawo YAKHO NENDLELA YOKUGQIBELA Ingcambu yesiqhelo ye-backup yi-C:\Synix\BackupGames. Iisetingi → Izipele zikuvumela ukuba ukhethe enye ingcambu kwaye usete umda wokugcina.
Indawo ekuyiwa kuyo kufuneka ingaphandle kwefolda yomncedisi womthombo. Ukutshintsha ingcambu yokulondoloza ayishintshi okanye isuse iirekhodi ezikhoyo; khangela indawo endala ukuze ufumane i-backup endala.
Ukugcinwa kususa i-archive endala xa umda ogqityiweyo ugqitywe ngexesha lokudala i-backup. Gcina amanqaku okubuyisela kwimeko yesiqhelo ngaphandle kwendawo yokulondoloza.
Gcina enye ikopi eqinisekisiweyo yehlabathi elibalulekileyo kwindawo eyahlukileyo yokugcina. Idiski engakhange isebenze inokubhubhisa zombini umncedisi kunye neekopi ezigcinwe kwidiski enye. I-ZIP yefolda yokuthumela yangaphandle ayiyiyo ngokuzenzekelayo i-VM ehambelanayo okanye isipele sedatha.

data.name: Content.D2EE952679F0F36E81E6
data.value:
Funda umyalezo weWindows ngaphambi kokuba uthathe isigqibo sokuba ufanele utshintshe ntoni. Inkqubo evaliweyo, impazamo yokufikelela kwifayile, nexesha lokudlala elilahlekileyo ziingxaki ezahlukahlukeneyo.
I-SYNIX Ayiyi Kufakwa Okanye Ivuleke Sebenzisa ingxelo esemthethweni okanye iphakheji echanekileyo yeWinGet ubidzz.Synix. Ukuba ukutshintshwa kwefayile kunika ingxelo yokuba ukufikelela akuvumelekanga, vala umzekeliso weSynix usebenzisa loo ndlela ngokuqhelekileyo uze uzame kwakhona. Jonga ukufikelela kwifolda kunye nemiyalezo yesofthiwe yokhuseleko ukuba ingxaki iyaqhubeka.
Musa ukucima idatha yomncedisi okanye ukukhubaza ukhuseleko njengendlela yokulungisa ngokubanzi.
ISIMARTSCREEN Isilumkiso sedumela sinokubonelela ngeenkcukacha ezithe kratya → Qhuba nangayiphi na indlela, kuxhomekeke kumgaqo-nkqubo weWindows. Ubukho baloo ndlela abubungqina bokuba ifayile ikhuselekile. Qinisekisa umthombo osemthethweni uze uhlolisise isilumkiso ngaphambi kokuba uthathe isigqibo sokuba uza kuqhubeka na.
I-Smart APP CONTROL Oku kunokuthintela usetyenziso xa i-Windows ingakwazi ukuseka ukuthembela okwaneleyo. Ayinayo i-bypass yeapp nganye enokuthelekiswa ne-SmartScreen's Run kunjalo. Musa ukukhubaza iimpawu zokhuseleko ze-Windows kuphela ukuqhuba i-Synix.
I-ANTIVIRUS OR HASH FAIL Phanda ngokuchanekileyo ukufunyanwa kunye nefayile. Musa ukucinga ukuba isilumkiso sisiphumo esibuxoki kuba ifayile ibizwa ngokuba yiSynix. I-hash ye-SHA-256 ehambelana nayo ichaza ifayile ekhutshelweyo; ayisekeleli ukuthembela okanye ukusayinwa kwekhowudi.
Chaza indlela echanekileyo yokulumkisa nokufakela kunye neenkcukacha ezifihlakeleyo ezisusiweyo. Kuphephe ukukhanyela okuqhelekileyo okanye ukuphepha ukuqinisekiswa kwe-hash yomfaki.

data.name: Content.DEF7504305FCA62C7644
data.value:
Sebenzisa i-Settings → Backups kwi-Synix epheleleyo yokuthumela/yokungenisa. Oku kwahlukile ekubhaliseni ifolda enye esele ikhona.
Hlola Oko Kufuneka Kuqhutywe Iipakethe zokuthumela ngaphandle zifaka umthi ophambili weC:\Synix. Umncedisi ozenzekelayo okanye iifolda zokulondoloza ngaphandle kwayo kunye nokugcinwa komdlalo wangaphandle kufuna ukuphathwa ngokwahlukileyo. Bhala phantsi iindlela zabo ngaphambi kokuba baqalise. Iintandokazi eziqhelekileyo zeWindows nazo zinokufuna ukuhlaziywa kwindawo ekuyiwa kuyo.
Ukuthumela ngaphandle 1. Yima iiseva uze ugqibezele ulondolozo olusebenzayo, ukukhuphela nokwenza i-backup. 2. Khetha ukuthumela ngaphandle okufihliweyo okanye okuqhelekileyo. 3. Khetha indawo ekuyiwa kuyo ngaphandle komthi womthombo uze ujonge ubungakanani kunye neemfuno zendawo yethutyana. 4. Ukuthumela ngaphandle okufihliweyo, khetha iphasiwedi yokudlulisa enamandla uze uyigcine ngokwahlukeneyo. 5. Lindela ukuba iphakheji ye .synixbackup igqibe, uze uyiqinisekise.
KHANGELA UKUKHUSELWA OKUFanelekileyo Ukuthumela ngaphandle okufihliweyo kukhusela iphakheji kwaye kuxhasa ukuhanjiswa kweempawu ezixhaswayo kwiakhawunti ye-Windows ekuyiwa kuyo.
Ukuthumela ngaphandle okuqhelekileyo akubhalwanga. Iifayile zemidlalo kunye neelogi ezikuyo zinokubonisa iimfihlelo. Ukukopisha amaxabiso afakwe kwi-Windows akuzenzi zisebenze kwenye iakhawunti.
Ukungenisa 1. Qala ngokukhusela idatha yangoku yeSynix kwindawo oya kuyo. 2. Vula ulawulo lokungenisa/lokuqinisekisa uze ukhethe iphakheji ecetywayo. 3. Nceda unikezele ngephasiwedi yokudluliselwa xa uceliwe kwaye uqinisekise iphakheji. 4. Hlola indawo ekuyiwa kuyo, iimfuno zediski uze ubhale phantsi izilumkiso. 5. Makugqitywe ukufakelwa kwinqanaba, ukuqinisekiswa nokubuyiselwa kwakhona. 6. Jonga iindlela zeseva, izibuko, izicwangciso, iindawo zokuzikhusela, kunye neenkcukacha ngaphambi kokuba uqale nantoni na.
Qhagamshela kwakhona i-Satisfactory ukuba isazisi sendawo yayo okanye uqhagamshelo olukhuselekileyo aluhambelani. Gcina iphakheji yokuqala kunye nedatha endala de iiseva ezithunyelweyo zivavanywe.
Ukufuduka kwedatha okuxhaswayo kugcina ikopi yedatha yangaphambi kokufuduka. Ukuba ukungenisa okanye ukufuduka akuphumelelanga, gcina loo khophi kunye nomyalezo wokubuyisela endaweni yokutshintsha isiseko sedatha esebenzayo ngelixa i-Synix isebenza.

data.name: Content.E03D856AEDD6B1B81DFD
data.value:
Faka & Qalisa iqulethe ifolda yomncedisi ekhethiweyo kunye neendlela zayo zokuqalisa ezixhaswayo. Gcina umyalelo ocetyiswayo ngaphandle kokuba uyayiqonda intetho yomdlalo.
IINGCUKACHA ZOKUHLAYA Sebenzisa imowudi ephucukileyo xa kufuneka iingxabano ezingafunekiyo. Hlola iingcaphuno, iindlela ezinokwenziwa, namagama okhetho afunekayo kumdlalo. I-Synix sele ibonelela ngeengxoxo ezilawulwayo; ukongeza enye ikopi kunokuvelisa izicwangciso eziphikisanayo.
Musa ukuguqulela izitshintshi okanye ukubuyisela ixabiso lobuchwephesha elilindelweyo ngelebheli yalo eguquliweyo. Ungaze wongeze amaxwebhu kumyalelo nje ukuze ube lula ukuwakhuphela.
Iifayile zokuqalisa ezikhutshwe kwamanye amazwe Kwiiprofayili ezixhaswayo, iinketho zeseva → Yenza Ifayile yeBhetshi ibhala umyalelo wokuqalisa osonjululwe kwisicatshulwa.
Le fayile inokuba namaphasiwedi afundekayo okanye iithokheni zenkonzo ukuze isebenze ngokuzimeleyo. Yigcine iyimfihlo uze uyihlolisise ngaphambi kokuba uyisasaze okanye uyihambise.
Ukuqhuba iskripthi ngaphandle kwe-Synix akuboneleli zonke izitshixo zokusebenza ze-Synix, ulungelelwaniso lwe-watchdog, izipele, okanye ulondolozo olucwangcisiweyo. Musa ukuyisebenzisa ngelixa i-Synix sele isebenza loo nkonzo.
IZITHUBO ZANGaphandle Ezinye iiprofayili zemidlalo ziqalisa izixhobo zazo zokuhambisa endaweni yenkqubo enye yesiqhelo yeseva. Ezi zixhobo zingadinga imvume eyahlukileyo kwaye zingakwazi ukuxhasa ukuthunyelwa kwefayile yokuqalisa. Landela isikhokelo somdlalo kwiprofayili kunokuba utshintshe enye i-executable okanye umqulu.

data.name: Content.EA307763F93AA4306555
data.value:
Sebenzisa iphakheji yokukhululwa esemthethweni. Iquka ixesha lokuqhuba .NET elifunwa yi-Synix; Iiseva zemidlalo zisenokufuna imfuneko yazo.
Khetha Indlela Yokufaka • MSI: Khuphela i-SynixSetup.msi, uyiqhube, uze uvule iPhaneli yoLawulo ye-Synix kwimenyu yokuqalisa. Indawo eqhelekileyo yesicelo somsebenzisi yi %LocalAppData%\Programs\Synix. • WinGet: Sebenzisa iphakheji ngqo ubidzz.Synix. Inqaku WinGet Ukufakwa kunye nohlaziyo iqulethe imiyalelo. • Isebenza ngokuzenzekelayo: Beka umxokozelo osemthethweni wokuzenzekelayo kwifolda enokubhalwa uze uyisebenzise apho. Ukuhambisa eso sixhobo asiyondlela yokudluliselwa ngokupheleleyo kweeseva zakho.
Ukukhuphela ngokusemthethweni: https://github.com/ubidzz/Synix-Control-Panel/releases/latest
HLAWULA ISIKHALISO 1. Gqibezela ukukhuphela, ukuzikhusela nokugcina izinto. 2. Yima iiseva zakho zomdlalo ngeSynix uze uvale iSynix ngokuqhelekileyo. 3. Sebenzisa i-updater okanye umfakisi wendlela oyikhethileyo yokufaka. 4. Vula kwakhona i-Synix uze uqinisekise ukuba izithuba zakho zeseva kunye neendlela zichanekile.
Ukuba utshintsha ufakelo oludala olusekwe kwi-EXE nge-MSI, susa uhlelo lokusebenza oludala kuqala. Gcina idatha yomncedisi kunye neefolda zomncedisi ezenzelwe wena. Musa ukucima i-C:\Synix ukuze uhlaziye inkqubo.
Ukuhlaziywa kwesicelo akuhlaziyi imidlalo oyisebenzisayo. Sebenzisa isenzo sokuhlaziya kwiseva ekhethiweyo ukuze wenze oko.
Ukuba i-Windows ixela ukuba ukufikelela kunqatshelwe ngelixa utshintsha i-executable, khangela ukuba ikopi etshintshwayo ayisasebenzi. Musa ukubhala ngaphezulu usetyenziso olusebenzayo okanye ususe idatha yeserver ukuze usebenze ngemposiso.

data.name: Content.F77CEDCB39BB6AFDDB17
data.value:
I-Synix ihlolisisa uxinzelelo lwezixhobo ngaphambi kokuthunyelwa okuthile ukunciphisa ithuba lokugqithisa umkhosi. Ukuba ukuqala kuyalibaziseka okanye kuvinjelwe, funda ingxaki yemithombo ekhankanyiweyo.
Gcina Igumbi LOMBONISI Vumela imemori yeWindows kunye nezicelo zemvelaphi kunye nomdlalo. Gcina indawo kwidiski ukuze ufumane uhlaziyo, iifayile zethutyana, ugcine uze wenze i-backup.
Umda wememori ye-Minecraft ogqityiweyo uchaphazela ixesha layo lokudlala / lokusebenza. Ayisiyondawo enzima yendawo yonke kwinkqubo nganye eqaliswe ngumdlalo ngamnye.
Ukuhlolwa kwemithombo akubeki umncedisi kwisitya seCPU/RAM okanye ukuqinisekisa ukuba i-Windows ayinakuze iphele imithombo. Sebenzisa umboniso wemithombo kunye nesishwankathelo sebhodi yedeshi yePC yonke ukuqonda umthwalo wokwenyani.
INETWERK GUARD Inqaku lokulumkisa kwenethiwekhi lokuzama lijonga iimeko ezingaqhelekanga zobubanzi bebhanti / imithombo kwaye libalisa umsebenzi owaziwayo we-SteamCMD ukunciphisa izilumkiso ezingezizo.
Ayisiyonto yokukhusela umlilo, ukucoca izithuthi okanye ukhuseleko lweDDoS. Isilumkiso asichazi umhlaseli okanye siqinisekise ukuba kwenzekile ukuhlaselwa.
Xa ulumkisiwe, thelekisa lo msebenzi kunye neenkqubo ezikhutshelweyo, ezikhuselweyo nezinye. Hlola iirekhodi ezifanelekileyo ngaphambi kokutshintsha izilungiso zokhuseleko okanye zenethiwekhi.

data.value:

2. Uxwebhu olusemthethweni: https://wiki.factorio.com/Multiplayer#Server_settings

data.name: Content.F83D1D2838B71617191E
data.value:
Khetha iprofayile ye-Rust uze ujonge ihlabathi layo, ubunikazi, umdlalo, umbuzo, kunye nezilungiso zomhlobo ngaphambi kokuqala kokuqala.
I-IDENTITY YESERVER I-Synix inika ixabiso le-+server.identity elixhaswayo kwi-identity yeseva. Gcina izibonelelo ezahlukileyo kunye neempawu zomzekelo ohlukeneyo ukuze zingabelani ngokungacwangciswanga imihlaba okanye ulungelelwaniso.
I-RUST+ Lungiselela i-App Port ekhethekileyo exhaswayo yenkonzo ehamba nayo, emva koko landela iimfuno zeRust zokudibanisa kunye nenethiwekhi. I-endpoint yayo yahlukile kumdlalo womdlali kunye nolawulo lwe-RCON olukhethiweyo.
Jonga izibuko ezizenzekelayo ezilungiselelwe kunokuba ukope umgaqo ukusuka kwenye iseva yeRust. Khusela iziqinisekiso zeRCON kwaye ungazipapashi ukuze uncede abantu bajoyine.
IVANILLA NE-OXIDE UVanilla usebenzisa iifayile zomncedisi osemthethweni. Ukukhetha i-Oxide yongeza isakhelo esisemthethweni esixhaswayo emva kweefayile zeSteam. Ufakelo lwesakhelo alukhethi okanye luvavanye iiplagi nganye.
Sebenzisa ukuhamba komsebenzi kwendawo okuxhaswa nguMlawuli weMod & Plugin ukuze ufake i-Oxide / uMod efunyenweyo. Iiplagi zisadinga iinguqulelo ezihambelanayo nemithombo ethembekileyo.
I-Synix iphinda isebenzise ixesha lokuqhuba le-Oxide elixhaswayo emva kohlaziyo lwe-Rust okanye ukuqinisekiswa xa kukhethwe loo nkqubo. Ukubuyela kwiifayile ezisemthethweni zeVanilla, tshintsha ukhetho lwesakhelo uze uqhube i-Update okanye i-Validate workflow exhaswayo.
Ngaphambi kokuba utshintshe isakhelo okanye umdlalo, gcina ihlabathi, ulungelelwaniso, kunye nedatha yeplugin. Hlola zombini umdlalo kunye ne-Oxide logs emva kokuqalisa kwakhona; Ukukhuphela isakhelo ngempumelelo akubonisi ukuba zonke iiplagi zilayishwe ngokuchanekileyo.

Uluhlu lweeseva kunye nezilungiselelo kwiSynixData\servers.json zigcinwa kwaye zilayishwe kwakhona xa ufaka iSynix kwakhona.

data.name: Uninstall.Review
data.value: Jonga iifayile kunye neefolda ukuze ususe apha ngezantsi. Iindawo ezikhuselweyo azibandakanyi. Ukucima kuyinto engunaphakade, kwanokuba ukucima usetyenziso kungaphumeleli kamva.

data.name: Uninstall.Confirm
data.value: Ndiye ndenza isipele koko ndikudingayo kwaye ndifuna ukucima ezi folda ngokusisigxina.

data.name: Uninstall.Stop
data.value: Vala iSynix uze umise zonke iiseva zomdlalo ngaphambi kokuba ususe idatha yomncedisi.

data.name: Uninstall.Changed
data.value: Iirekhodi zeseva zitshintshile. Phinda ujonge iifolda ngaphambi kokuba ususe nantoni na.

data.name: Uninstall.Failed
data.value: Ukususwa kwamiswa. Kusenokwenzeka ukuba ezinye iifayile sele zisusiwe. I-Synix isakhiwe. Jonga iifolda eziseleyo ngaphambi kokuba uzame kwakhona.

data.name: Uninstall.BackupsOption
data.value: Susa kwakhona ii-backups zeseva ezidwelisiweyo kunye neefayile zokubuyisela

data.name: Uninstall.NoBackups
data.value: Azikho i-backups ezifunyenweyo kwiindawo ezaziwayo ze-Synix.

data.name: Uninstall.KeptLocations
data.value: Iindawo ezigcinwe (ngaphandle kwee-backups ezikhethwe ngokucacileyo apha ngasentla):

data.name: Uninstall.CloseApp
data.value: Vala i-Synix phambi kokuyikhupha. Iiseva zemidlalo zinokuqhubeka zisebenza xa kukhutshwa usetyenziso kuphela.

data.name: History.Unavailable
data.value: Imbali yayingenakufundwa okanye igcinwe. Jonga ukufikelela kwifolda kunye nendawo yediski ekhululekile.

data.name: History.Retention
data.value: Kugcinwe phakathi kweeseshoni zeSynix. Ukufikelela kwi-{0} izithuba zakutshanje ngomncedisi ngamnye. Amaphasiwedi kunye nemiyalelo yokuqalisa ayivumelekanga.

data.name: BackupHealth.Notice
data.value: Ngokusekelwe kwiifayile nakwiziqinisekiso, hayi ukuhlolwa kokungagungqi okutsha. I-backups endala kuneentsuku ze-7 ziphakanyisiwe.

data.name: Appearance.Description
data.value: Khetha umxholo, umbala wokugxininisa kunye nesimbo sokulawula. Utshintsho lusebenza ngoko nangoko kwaye lugcinwa ngokuzenzekelayo.

data.name: Settings.Privacy.ActivityCount.Description
data.value: Ngokukhethwa kukho: thumela ikhowudi yeseshoni engacwangciswanga kwi-synix.info yonke imizuzu ye-10 ngelixa i-Synix isebenza, kubandakanywa kwimvelaphi. Akukho datha yomncedisi ithunyelwayo. Iimali ziphela emva kwemizuzu ye15. Ngokuzenzekelayo. Unokuyicima apha.

data.name: RemoteManager.Description
data.value: Hlanganisa le khompyutha ukuze ubone, uqalise, uyeke, uqalise kwakhona uze wenze isipele seeseva ezivela kwiwebhusayithi yeSynix. Ukufikelela ekude akuvumelekanga de uvume ukudibanisa apha.

data.name: RemoteManager.Instructions
data.value:
Ngena kwiwebhsayithi uze ufake le khowudi. Vuma kuphela igama lakho lomsebenzisi apha.
Gcina iSynix ivulekile okanye inciphe. Unxibelelwano oluthe cwaka luyakuphulaphula ukubhalisa. Iinkcukacha zeseva zihlaziywa rhoqo kwimizuzwana eli-10 ngelixa zibukwa. Ukungabikho kwee-pair kukhubaza ukufikelela okukude ngaphandle kokumisa iiseva.

data.name: RemoteManager.WaitingClaim
data.value: Ndilinde iakhawunti yakho ukuze ndicele ukudibanisa...

data.name: RemoteManager.CodeExpired
data.value: Ikhowudi iphelelwe lixesha. Yenza ikhowudi entsha yokudibanisa.

data.name: RemoteManager.ClaimFormat
data.value: Ulawulo lokucela iakhawunti: {0} Vuma kuphela ukuba eli ligama lakho lomsebenzisi.

data.name: RemoteManager.CheckFailed
data.value: Ayikwazi ukujonga ukudibanisa. Jonga unxibelelwano lwakho lwe-intanethi.

data.name: RemoteManager.Unavailable
data.value: Andikwazi ukunxibelelana nomphathi weSynix. Nceda uzame kwakhona.

data.name: RemoteManager.IdentitySoftware
data.value: Ubume bekhompyutha: isitshixo sesoftware esikhuselwe yiWindows (iTPM ayifumaneki)

data.name: RemoteManager.RemovalPending
data.value: Ukuxhomekeka kwindawo ethile. Zama kwakhona ukususa xa uqhagamshelwe.

data.name: RemoteManager.SaveFailed
data.value: Ufikelelo olukude lukhubazekile. Izilungiselelo zokudibanisa azinakulondolozwa.

data.name: RemoteManager.PairingRemoved
data.value: Ukudibanisa kwiiwebhusayithi kususwe. Ukufikelela ekude akuvumelekanga.

data.name: RemoteManager.FinishUnpair
data.value: Qhagamshela kwi-Intanethi uze ugqibe ukususa isibini esidala kuqala.

data.name: RemoteManager.RecoveryInstructions
data.value: Yenza igama lokugqitha lethutyana apha. Ngena kwiwebhusayithi ngalo kunye nendlela yakho ekhoyo ye-2FA okanye isitshixo sokungena (passkey), uze ukhethe igama lokugqitha elitsha. Ukuba zombini iindlela ziyafuneka, zombini zihlala zinyanzelekile. Igama lokugqitha lethutyana lisebenza kube kanye kuphela kwaye liphelelwa emva kwemizuzu eyi-10. Igama lokugqitha lakho langaphambili lihlala lisebenza de kugqitywe ukubuyiselwa kweakhawunti.

data.name: RemoteManager.RecoveryExpired
data.value: Ukubuyiselwa kwemali kuphelelwe lixesha okanye kurhoxisiwe. Qala kwakhona.

data.name: RemoteManager.RecoveryLimited
data.value: Zininzi kakhulu izicelo. Zama kwakhona kamva.

data.name: Status.Activity.ReconnectedByPath
data.value: [SYNIX] Ixhunyiwe kwakhona kwiseva eqhuba "{0}" efumaneka kwifolda yayo yofakelo (PID: {1}).

data.name: Settings.Backup.Transfer.RemoteAccessNotice
data.value: Ukudibanisa ukufikelela kude akuhambisi. Ukuba usebenzisa ukufikelela ekude, qhagamshela ikhompyutha entsha kunye neakhawunti yakho kwi manager.synix.info emva kokubuyisela i-Synix.
